A Sandy Scandal#003.dst: ZEUGENAUSSAGE I - VON ODIN GIBBS, LADENBESITZER - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: Business was slow that day, until two rugged, oddly-dressed men stormed into my shop, with a lot of nerve.
A Sandy Scandal#004.dst: Das Geschäft lief schleppend, bis zwei raue, seltsam gekleidete Männer dreist in meinen Laden stürmten.

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: Before I could close any deal with them, the man with a dagger started threatening me!
A Sandy Scandal#005.dst: Bevor ich mit ihnen handelseinig wurde, bedrohte mich der Mann mit dem Dolch!

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: I tried to make peace with the crooks.
A Sandy Scandal#006.dst: Ich versuchte, die Gauner zu beschwichtigen.

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: The bandit put the knife closer to me and started demanding the code to the TNT vault downstairs!
A Sandy Scandal#007.dst: Der Bandit hielt mir das Messer näher hin und verlangte den Code zum TNT-Tresor im Keller!

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: The bandits grew agitated and resorted to violence to obtain the combination.
A Sandy Scandal#008.dst: Die Banditen wurden unruhig und griffen zu Gewalt, um die Kombination zu bekommen.

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: They swiped their knife at me, leaving a sizeable wound on my arm.
A Sandy Scandal#009.dst: Ein Messerhieb hinterließ eine große Wunde an meinem Arm.

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: I had no choice but to give up the combination, which was {~}.
A Sandy Scandal#010.dst: Mir blieb nichts übrig, als die Kombination zu verraten: {~}.

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: After I gave up the combination, they knocked me out!

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: I had no idea what the criminals did after that, I haven't been back to my shop since the incident.
A Sandy Scandal#012.dst: Was die Verbrecher danach taten, weiß ich nicht, ich war seit dem Vorfall nicht mehr in meinem Laden.

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: The bandits must've taken the explosives! You should investigate.
A Sandy Scandal#013.dst: Die Banditen haben wohl den Sprengstoff! Du solltest nachforschen.

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Looks like the bandit's took almost all of the TNT from the shopkeeper's vault.
A Sandy Scandal#014.dst: Die Banditen haben wohl fast das ganze TNT aus dem Tresor des Ladenbesitzers mitgenommen.

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: They seem to have dropped their knife during all the looting...
A Sandy Scandal#015.dst: Beim Plündern haben sie wohl ihr Messer verloren...

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: You should return to the {p} Bank Guard with your information.
A Sandy Scandal#016.dst: Kehre mit deinen Erkenntnissen zur Bankwache von {p} zurück.

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: WITNESS REPORT II - TOLD BY SCROLL MERCHANT, SHOP OWNER - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP
A Sandy Scandal#017.dst: ZEUGENAUSSAGE II - VOM SCHRIFTROLLENHÄNDLER, LADENBESITZER - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: I was having a fine time tending to my rooftop garden after a lengthy day of selling scrolls.
A Sandy Scandal#018.dst: Nach einem langen Tag des Schriftrollenverkaufs pflegte ich gemütlich meinen Dachgarten.

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: While looking down on the street, I saw two unsavory men, one with TNT in hand, marching down the path.
A Sandy Scandal#019.dst: Als ich auf die Straße hinabsah, marschierten zwei zwielichtige Männer den Weg entlang, einer mit TNT in der Hand.

A Sandy Scandal#020.src: I was suspicious, so I tried to get their attention, but they ignored me.
A Sandy Scandal#020.dst: Ich war misstrauisch und rief nach ihnen, aber sie ignorierten mich.

A Sandy Scandal#021.src: I tried to yell for the attention of a guard or official, but nobody could hear me.
A Sandy Scandal#021.dst: Ich rief nach einer Wache oder einem Beamten, aber niemand hörte mich.

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: I wasn't sure what to do at this point... I didn't try to confront them, that'd have been way too risky!
A Sandy Scandal#022.dst: Ich wusste nicht, was ich tun sollte... Sie zur Rede zu stellen, wäre viel zu riskant gewesen!

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: I have no idea where they went off to afterwards.
A Sandy Scandal#023.dst: Wohin sie danach gingen, weiß ich nicht.

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: You should check out the house that the explosion came from!
A Sandy Scandal#024.dst: Untersuche das Haus, aus dem die Explosion kam!

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: Two weapons are missing from the wealthy estate owner's weapon rack!
A Sandy Scandal#025.dst: Am Waffenständer des reichen Gutsbesitzers fehlen zwei Waffen!

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: With such powerful weapons the bandits could easily break through the bank's defenses.
A Sandy Scandal#026.dst: Mit so mächtigen Waffen könnten die Banditen die Abwehr der Bank leicht durchbrechen.

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: The whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#027.dst: In ein paar Sekunden fliegt alles in die Luft, und alle Beweise liegen unter dem Sand begraben. Viel Glück beim Rauskommen!
A Sandy Scandal#027.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Looks like the bandits have started their heist! You should follow them into the bank and stop them.
A Sandy Scandal#028.dst: Die Banditen haben ihren Raubzug wohl begonnen! Folge ihnen in die Bank und halte sie auf.

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: It's too late to stop us now! We're about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#029.dst: Zu spät, uns aufzuhalten! Gleich hauen wir mit dem Hauptgewinn ab - dem Inhalt des Smaragdtresors!
A Sandy Scandal#029.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#030.src: We think the bandits might have made the first move in their heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#030.dst: Wir glauben, die Banditen haben den ersten Schritt ihres Raubzugs getan, wir mobilisieren einen Trupp, um-
A Sandy Scandal#030.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: Bevor mich jemand hören konnte, gab es eine große Explosion in dem Haus, in das die Banditen eingedrungen waren.

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#032.dst: Sprich mit der Bankwache von {p} bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#034.dst: Die Bank von {p} ist oft ein Hauptziel von Banditen, und eine Reihe von Vorfällen macht uns misstrauisch.
A Sandy Scandal#034.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#036.dst: Wenn ich dir ein paar Aussagen gebe, hilfst du, sie nach Hinweisen zu prüfen?
A Sandy Scandal#036.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: Super! Der Laden aus der ersten Aussage liegt die Treppe hinab, gleich hinter dem Gebäude hinter mir.
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: Er heißt "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", und der Besitzer meldete vor ein paar Tagen einen Raub.
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: Viel Glück! Melde dich bei mir, wenn du etwas findest.
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#040.dst: Geh zum Ort der Zeugenaussage bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: Hallo, meine Herren! Was darf es heute sein? Industriefackeln? Spitzhacken?
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Shut yer' trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: Halt die Klappe, Alter. Wir sind wegen 'nem anderen Geschäft hier.
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: Wa-? Hört mal, Leute. Verlasst einfach meinen Laden, dann wird niemand verletzt. Ich will keinen Ärger.
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: Hör zu, Alter, sag uns den Code zum TNT-Tresor im Keller, oder ich schmück meine Kette mit deinen Fingern!
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#045.dst: Ganz sicher nicht! Das TNT ist nur für lizenzierte Bergbaufirmen, nicht für irgendwelche Hobbybergleute.
A Sandy Scandal#045.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: Na dann! Eine Spitzhacke kannst du auch mit vier Fingern noch halten, was?
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#047.dst: Aaargh! Schon gut, schon gut! Keine Gewalt mehr, bitte!
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#048.dst: Der Code ist {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... bitte tut mir nichts!
A Sandy Scandal#048.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#049.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#049.dst: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... danke! Wir brauchen dich nicht mehr... jetzt schlaf schön!
A Sandy Scandal#049.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#054.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#054.dst: Ah, du bist zurück! Hast du in der Aussage etwas Interessantes gefunden?
A Sandy Scandal#054.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: Fehlendes TNT im Tresor des Ladens? Der Ladenbesitzer hat wohl die Wahrheit gesagt.
A Sandy Scandal#055.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: Wir müssen diese Verbrecher schnell fassen, wenn sie so viel TNT haben - sie könnten ein Loch direkt in den Banktresor sprengen!
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: Sieh dir eine weitere Zeugenaussage an, von nach dem Angriff auf den Ladenbesitzer.
A Sandy Scandal#057.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: Sie wurde im Dachgarten des Schriftrollenhändlers aufgenommen, sieh sie dir an.
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: Beeil dich! Wir haben nicht viel Zeit, wenn wir die Banditen aufhalten wollen.
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#062.dst: He, was glaubt ihr zwei Halunken, was ihr mit dem gefährlichen Sprengstoff in der Stadt treibt?
A Sandy Scandal#062.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: Find the source of the detonation at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
A Sandy Scandal#065.dst: Finde den Ursprung der Detonation bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#068.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#068.dst: Hast du etwas Neues über den Verbleib der Verbrecher herausgefunden?
A Sandy Scandal#068.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#069.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#069.dst: Ah... das ist beunruhigend. Die Verbrecher haben zwei sehr mächtige Waffen erbeutet.
A Sandy Scandal#069.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#070.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#070.dst: Mit diesen Waffen wird es schwer, wenn die Verbrecher die Bank überfallen wollen.
A Sandy Scandal#070.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#071.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#071.dst: Ich weiß nicht, wie es weitergehen soll, wir haben keine weiteren Zeugenaussagen, und-
A Sandy Scandal#071.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#072.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.dst: Chef, gerade kamen dringende Meldungen über einen laufenden Raub im linken Wohnviertel von {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#073.src: Oh my... you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#073.dst: Oh je… du! Soldat! Schnell! Der Raub ist auf der anderen Brückenseite, neben dem ersten Haus, das du heute besucht hast! Vielleicht sind es unsere Banditen.
A Sandy Scandal#073.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#074.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#074.dst: Im Wohnviertel wartet jemand vor dem Haus auf dich!
A Sandy Scandal#074.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#075.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#075.dst: Findest du es nicht, die Koordinaten stehen in deinem Inhaltsbuch. Jetzt schnell, zum Haus!
A Sandy Scandal#075.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#076.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#077.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#077.dst: Hallo? Gehörst du zu den Wachen? Gut! Schnell! Banditen haben mein Haus geplündert und viele Smaragde mitgenommen!
A Sandy Scandal#077.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#078.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#078.dst: Folg mir zu meinem Haus, hoffentlich findest du die Banditen! Sie stahlen viele meiner kostbaren Steine!
A Sandy Scandal#078.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#079.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
A Sandy Scandal#079.dst: Suche nach Hinweisen auf den Verbleib der Banditen.

A Sandy Scandal#081.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#081.dst: Bereit, Jungs? Wir haben TNT, Waffen und die schnellsten Pferde, die Smaragde kaufen können. Jetzt nur noch-
A Sandy Scandal#081.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#082.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#082.dst: Aha. Dachte mir, dass uns eine Wache folgt.
A Sandy Scandal#082.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#083.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#083.dst: Schade um die nagelneuen Waffen... wir jagen das Versteck sowieso in die Luft!
A Sandy Scandal#083.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#086.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#086.dst: Finde die Stelle, an der die Banditen ein Loch in die Bank gesprengt haben, bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#088.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.
A Sandy Scandal#088.dst: Folge den Verbrechern in den anderen Raum.

A Sandy Scandal#089.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#089.dst: Sieh mal, der Soldat ist uns gefolgt. Dumme Idee.
A Sandy Scandal#089.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#090.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#090.dst: Schlagen wir zwei Fliegen mit einer Klappe: aus der Bank fliehen und die Plage erledigen.
A Sandy Scandal#090.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#093.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#093.dst: Erstatte der Bankwache von {p} Bericht bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#094.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#094.dst: Soldat! Wo warst du? Hast du die Explosionen unter der Bank gehört?
A Sandy Scandal#094.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#096.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.dst: Du hast sie schon aufgehalten? Und die gestohlenen Waffen und den Sprengstoff zurückgeholt..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#097.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#097.dst: Wow. Hervorragende Arbeit, Soldat. {p} steht in deiner Schuld. Nimm das aus unserem Tresor als Zeichen unseres Dankes.
A Sandy Scandal#097.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#098.src: I then realized that they had no innocent itinerary, they were heading straight for my wealthy neighbor's house!
A Sandy Scandal#098.dst: Da wurde mir klar, dass ihr Weg alles andere als harmlos war, sie gingen direkt zum Haus meines reichen Nachbarn!

A Sandy Scandal#099.src: The bandits came sprinting out of my wealthy neighbor's house with some of his most prized possessions: two weapons from his collection.
A Sandy Scandal#099.dst: Die Banditen stürmten aus dem Haus meines reichen Nachbarn, mit einigen seiner wertvollsten Besitztümer: zwei Waffen aus seiner Sammlung.

A Sandy Scandal#100.src: Have you been reading the witness reports?
A Sandy Scandal#100.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#102.src: You should return to the bank guard to relay what you’ve seen.

A Sandy Scandal#103.src: This must be where the robbery took place!

A Sandy Scandal#105.src: There's a trail of gold lying on the ground...

A Sandy Scandal#106.src: Follow the trail of gold the criminals left behind from the robbery at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Acquiring Credentials#000.src: Oh, an egg! I'll pay you {~} emeralds for it, of course!
Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: Oh, ein Ei! Dafür zahle ich dir natürlich {~} Smaragde!
Acquiring Credentials#000.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: Besorge einen Pass von Gavel bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: Tut mir leid, einen neuen Pass gibt's nicht einfach so... Dafür braucht es die Genehmigung von-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: Aber mein Pass wurde gestohlen! Mein Flug nach {p} geht in unter {~} Minuten. Ich brauche dringend einen...
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: Ich habe bereits gesagt, wohin du für einen neuen musst. Der Nächste, bitte!
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: Hmmm... {u}, ja? Leider müssen Menschen ihren Pass in Wynn beantragen.
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: Ich fürchte, ich kann dir nicht helfen. Der Nächste, bitte!
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: He, du! Ja, du! Kommst du mal raus? Ich glaube, wir können uns gegenseitig helfen.
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: Ich hab dein Gespräch mit dem Beamten mitgehört... Du suchst auch einen Pass, oder?
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Well...so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: Also... ich habe Gerüchte über einen geheimen Schwarzmarkt gehört, versteckt in der Luftbasis.
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: Let's explore the airbase, then! We need to look for clues, lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: Dann erkunden wir die Luftbasis! Wir müssen nach Hinweisen suchen, geh voran.
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Cinfras Citizen

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: Angeblich handeln sie mit illegaler Ware... Es muss eine Möglichkeit geben, Pässe zu kaufen, ganz sicher!
Acquiring Credentials#011.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: Wenn wir zusammenarbeiten, finden wir vielleicht einen Weg hinein. Was meinst du?
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: Erkunde die Luftbasis und suche nach Hinweisen auf den Schwarzmarkt.

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: Oh, du hast uns ins Gasthaus geführt! Hmmm, der Wirt arbeitet schon lange hier...
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know...all, uh...sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: Vielleicht weiß er was über den Schwarzmarkt! Ich frag mal, weißt schon... ganz, äh... unauffällig.
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: I can't believe this place! They only have some rancid wheat stored here, what am I supposed to do with that? I'll take a carrot any day over... wheat.
Acquiring Credentials#016.dst: Unfassbar, dieser Ort! Hier lagert nur ranziger Weizen, was soll ich damit? Eine Karotte ist mir jederzeit lieber als... Weizen.

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: All those other airship men carry around those vile face fruits, but I have to say, I've always had a soft spot for potatoes.
Acquiring Credentials#017.dst: Die anderen Luftschiffer tragen diese widerlichen Gesichtsfrüchte herum, aber ich muss sagen, Kartoffeln mochte ich schon immer.
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I wish my airship was black, I can't say I'm a fan of that white palette...
Acquiring Credentials#018.dst: Wäre mein Luftschiff doch schwarz, diese weiße Farbe mag ich nicht besonders...

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: You know, maybe white isn't so bad after all.
Acquiring Credentials#020.dst: Weißt du, vielleicht ist Weiß doch gar nicht so schlecht.
Acquiring Credentials#020.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#021.src: It turns out, white's actually quite a nice colour.
Acquiring Credentials#021.dst: Weiß ist eigentlich eine ganz schöne Farbe.
Acquiring Credentials#021.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: ... Oh, fine, wheat's not bad. I'll take some, I guess.
Acquiring Credentials#022.dst: ... Na gut, Weizen ist nicht schlecht. Ich nehm wohl etwas.
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: Though, really, the face doesn't mean it has to be evil, does it? It could be a nice face, after all.
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: Aber ein Gesicht heißt doch nicht, dass er böse ist, oder? Es könnte ja ein nettes Gesicht sein.

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: Entschuldigung... du, äh... kennst nicht zufällig richtig billige Läden hier?
Acquiring Credentials#025.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: Der Tisch ist gedeckt fürs große Mahl, Dunkles oder Helles, wie lautet die Wahl?
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: Hat das geklappt? Lässt er uns rein?
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: So leicht kommen wir wohl nicht hinein... Wohin führt uns diese Spur, was meinst du, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#030.dst: Erkunden wir einfach weiter. Geh voran.
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: Erkunde die Luftbasis weiter und suche nach Hinweisen auf den Schwarzmarkt.

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: He, äh... findest du die Leute hier auch verdächtig?
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#034.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#034.dst: Die Luftschiffkommandanten lieben, was sie hassen.
Acquiring Credentials#034.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: Ich glaube, wir sind auf der richtigen Spur! Weiter geht's.
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: Folge dem Hinweis: Die Luftschiffkommandanten lieben, was sie hassen.

Acquiring Credentials#037.src: Hmmm... These crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#037.dst: Hmmm... Die Kisten sind voller Sachen. Vielleicht geben wir den Kommandanten etwas davon?
Acquiring Credentials#037.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#038.dst: Einmal zerrissen, für immer unrettbar zerstört.
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#039.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#039.dst: Oh, weiter geht's! Wohin führt uns diese Spur?
Acquiring Credentials#039.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: Folge dem Hinweis: Einmal zerrissen, für immer unrettbar zerstört.

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.dst: Wer ist das oben auf der Plattform?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: Ihr zwei seid dafür echt weit gekommen, was?
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market just with that.
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: Tja, die Antwort auf Dunkles oder Helles kann ich euch geben! Aber damit allein kommt ihr nicht in den Markt.
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#044.dst: Seht ihr, für den Markt braucht ihr etwas zum Verkaufen! Und das kauft man hier nicht einfach so, wenn ihr versteht.
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: Genau! Zum Glück bin ich gut gelaunt. Ein Luftschiff liegt in der Nähe vor Anker. Das nehmen wir, und ich helfe euch, was zu besorgen.
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: Äh... Was meinst du, {u}? Ich brauche den Pass wirklich, und na ja... für dich springt doch auch was raus, oder?
Acquiring Credentials#047.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: Schütz mich, während ich das Ei hole, Soldat!
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Mechanic

similar.text: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#050.dst: Super! Folgt mir, es ist nicht weit.
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: Wartet! Wachen bewachen das Luftschiff. Lasst euch nicht sehen!
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: Sie stehen nah am Rand... Schubst sie runter.
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: Ähh... Denen geht's sicher gut, so tief war der Sturz bestimmt nicht...
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: Tja, nur so kommt ihr rein! Weiter vorn sind mehr Wachen. Erledigt sie ungesehen, dann sind wir aus dem Schneider!
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: Anschnallen! Wir fliegen nach {p}, da sammeln wir Drachlingseier, die ihr auf dem Schwarzmarkt verkaufen könnt!
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: Reise mit dem Mechaniker und Doan nach {p}, um das Drachlingsei zu holen.

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#060.dst: Auf unserer Zielinsel liegt ein Drachlingsnest! Dort legen sie ihre Eier, weil man so schwer hinkommt.
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: Und die sind auf dem Schwarzmarkt viel wert, oder...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: Und wie! Drachlingseier sind selten, und auf die Insel kommt man nur per Luftschiff... In Letvus sind sie ein Vermögen wert.
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: Oh, da ist sie! Ich sehe die Insel schon, anschnallen. Wir haben Eier zu klauen!
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: Was ist das?! Oh... Wir haben wohl Besuch...
Acquiring Credentials#064.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: Mist, die Skyraiders sind da! Die dürfen nicht mit den Eiern abhauen...
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: Na, wenn das so ist, gibt's nur eins! Los, folgt mir!
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: Mit so vielen Piraten im Weg kommen wir nicht zum Nest, erledigt sie!
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: Gut, folgt mir! Holen wir das Ei!
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: Schütz mich, während ich das Ei hole, Mensch!
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: Lasst sie nicht entkommen! Feuert die Kanonen!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#073.src: Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#073.dst: Soldat, lass sie nicht treffen! Schlag die Kanonenkugeln mit deiner Waffe weg, bevor sie unser Luftschiff treffen!
Acquiring Credentials#073.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: Noch mehr Treffer halten wir nicht aus... Wir verschwenden Zeit, los jetzt! Wir haben Wichtigeres zu tun!
Acquiring Credentials#074.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: Das war knapp... Na dann, zurück zur Luftbasis!
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#076.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#076.dst: Kehre mit Doan zur Bar im Blackbird Inn zurück.

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: Ihr zwei habt euch heute wirklich bewiesen!
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: Also verrate ich euch das Passwort für den Schwarzmarkt.
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: Geht zum Wirt im Gasthaus und sagt: 'Ich hab keinen Durst, hab immer eine Flasche dabei.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: Das gibt euch vielleicht die Chance reinzukommen. Viel Glück!
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: Danke für deine Hilfe... Gehen wir also zurück zur Bar.
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: Da sind wir wieder. Reden wir mit dem Wirt.
Acquiring Credentials#082.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: Ähm? Ich hab keinen Durst, hab immer eine Flasche dabei.
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: ...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?
Acquiring Credentials#084.dst: ...Na, hallo... Willst du ein paar... Tränke kaufen?

Acquiring Credentials#085.src: Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!
Acquiring Credentials#085.dst: Na, hallo! Du siehst aus, als könntest du meine feinen Waren gebrauchen, ja!

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
Acquiring Credentials#086.dst: Ein Drachlingsei? Dafür würde ich {~} Smaragde zahlen.
Acquiring Credentials#086.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
Acquiring Credentials#087.dst: Das ist unser Startgebot. Jetzt müssen wir ein höheres verlangen, weißt du noch? Wir dürfen nicht immer zum selben Händler, sonst verliert er das Interesse...

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
Acquiring Credentials#088.dst: Und wir dürfen höchstens {~} Leute um mehr bitten, sonst werden sie sauer.

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.dst: Na! Drachlingseier sieht man hier echt selten, wirklich gar nicht!! Ich gebe dir {~} Smaragde dafür, wie klingt das?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
Acquiring Credentials#090.dst: Schön! Ich erhöhe auf {~} Smaragde. Aber wenn das Ei jetzt nicht mir gehört? Brauchst du nicht wiederzukommen.
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.
Acquiring Credentials#091.dst: Weißt du noch, was der Passverkäufer sagte? Nicht immer zum selben Händler... Der hier mag wohl keine weitere Erhöhung. Reden wir mit den anderen.

Acquiring Credentials#092.src: An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.
Acquiring Credentials#092.dst: Ein Ei, was... Ich zahl dir... {~} Smaragde dafür.

Acquiring Credentials#093.src: Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.
Acquiring Credentials#093.dst: Schon wieder mehr?! Kein Interesse mehr. Verschwinde.

Acquiring Credentials#094.src: Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
Acquiring Credentials#094.dst: Sehe ich da ein Drachlingsei? Für so etwas Seltenes zahle ich selbstverständlich {~} Smaragde!
Acquiring Credentials#094.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#096.src: He appears to be rummaging through his documents.
Acquiring Credentials#096.dst: Er scheint in seinen Unterlagen zu wühlen.

Acquiring Credentials#097.src: We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!
Acquiring Credentials#097.dst: Wir müssen mit {~} Erhöhungen auf {~} Smaragde kommen. Versuchen wir's nochmal!

Acquiring Credentials#098.src: You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.
Acquiring Credentials#098.dst: Versuch erst bei einem anderen Händler zu erhöhen, bevor du zum vorigen zurückgehst.

Acquiring Credentials#099.src: Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!
Acquiring Credentials#099.dst: Oh, du bist dreist, das muss man dir lassen! Noch eine Erhöhung?! Schön!! Ich erhöhe auf {~} Smaragde!

Acquiring Credentials#100.src: I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#100.dst: Ich erhöhe den Preis auf... {~} Smaragde.

Acquiring Credentials#102.src: ...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?
Acquiring Credentials#102.dst: ...geht mich vielleicht nichts an, aber was will ein Mensch im Luftschiff-Zollamt der Dorfbewohner?

Acquiring Credentials#103.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#103.dst: Sprecht nur mit dem Schwarzmarkt-Mitglied am Ende des Gangs und mit sonst niemandem.
Acquiring Credentials#103.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#105.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#105.dst: Betritt den Schwarzmarkt und sprich mit dem Mitglied am Ende des Gangs.

Acquiring Credentials#106.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#106.dst: Ich hörte, ihr habt den Skyraiders Eier geklaut. Ganz schön dreist!
Acquiring Credentials#106.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#108.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#108.dst: Zwei Pässe? Das macht etwa {~} Smaragde. Die kriegst du, wenn du dieses Ei auf dem Markt verkaufst.
Acquiring Credentials#108.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#109.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#109.dst: Ich erklär dir, wie der Markt läuft. Für dein Ei gibt's erst einen niedrigen Preis, dann musst du bei den Händlern ein höheres Gebot erfragen.
Acquiring Credentials#109.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#110.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#110.dst: Aber Vorsicht, du darfst nur {~}-mal um mehr bitten.
Acquiring Credentials#110.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#111.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#111.dst: Sprich mit verschiedenen Händlern und schau, wie viel jeder für das Ei drauflegt.
Acquiring Credentials#111.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#112.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#112.dst: Viel Glück, und lass dich möglichst nicht umbringen.
Acquiring Credentials#112.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#113.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#113.dst: Sprich mit den Händlern und versuche, {~} Smaragde für einen Pass zu bekommen.

Acquiring Credentials#114.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#114.dst: Das brauchen wir, {u}. Verkauft! Das Ei gehört dir.
Acquiring Credentials#114.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#115.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#115.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#117.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.

Acquiring Credentials#118.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#118.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#119.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#119.dst: Hmm... Das reicht. Hier, eure Pässe.
Acquiring Credentials#119.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#120.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.dst: Ähh.. {u}, ich glaube, du hast deinen Pass verloren. Ich heb ihn dir au-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#121.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#121.dst: Moment... Das ist MEIN Pass?! Der war die ganze Zeit in meiner Tasche...
Acquiring Credentials#121.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#122.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#122.dst: Tja, ähhh... Dann kannst du wohl ein paar von den Smaragden haben...
Acquiring Credentials#122.speaker: Doan

Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: For the safety of the citizens, these doors shall remain shut until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.dst: Zur Sicherheit der Bürger bleiben diese Tore geschlossen, bis der Verbrecher gefasst ist.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.speaker: Elf Guard

similar.text: [+{~} Rusted Rake]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: This is utterly inane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: Das ist völlig unsinnig. Eine Abriegelung wegen eines kleinen Diebstahls... Sollen wir einander nicht helfen? Stehlen ist unnötig.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: The plant has been disturbed- Looks like it was knocked over.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: Die Pflanze wurde gestört- Sieht aus, als wäre sie umgestoßen worden.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: It's missing a few leaves- Many of them are scattered around the area.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: Ihr fehlen einige Blätter- Viele liegen in der Gegend verstreut.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: There seem to be some footprints leading away... It would probably be best to ask about the plant.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: Es scheinen Fußspuren wegzuführen... Am besten fragst du nach der Pflanze.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: I pray to the Light that you are able to help before the situation degrades further.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: Ich bete zum Licht, dass du helfen kannst, bevor es noch schlimmer wird.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: This book describes a potion of enhanced vision.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: Dieses Buch beschreibt einen Trank für verbesserte Sicht.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: ...why are so many of the pages ripped out?

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I mustn't be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: Sieh mein wahres Ich- Ich bin Korben und darf mich nicht länger aufhalten!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: Maybe there's another way to the window...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: Vielleicht gibt es einen anderen Weg zum Fenster...

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: You should probably investigate the collapsed bridge to see where Korben went.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: Untersuche wohl am besten die eingestürzte Brücke, um zu sehen, wohin Korben ging.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall open the doors for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: Du kannst die Stadt {p} betreten und verlassen, wie du willst. Wir öffnen dir die Tore.

similar.text: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: Hey! Please come talk to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.dst: He! Bitte komm und sprich mit mir.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die"- well it's true, or so I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Kennst du den Spruch "Elfen sterben nie"- nun, er stimmt, dachte ich jedenfalls.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.dst: Halt, Reisender! Der Zutritt zur Stadt {p} ist derzeit verboten.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: In diesem Tal ist ein gefährlicher Verbrecher auf freiem Fuß.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.dst: Diese Tore bleiben geschlossen, bis der Verbrecher gefasst ist.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: Finde heraus, ob im Tal von {p} jemand weiß, was passiert ist

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: Ein Fremder unter uns? Wie aufregend. Ich wünsche mir schon lange, unsere Magie mit neuen Leuten zu teilen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: Allerdings bin ich... nun ja, recht hungrig. Und ich muss mich vorerst um meinen Garten kümmern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: Kennst du den Spruch "Kraulst du mir die Ohren, kraul ich dir die deinen"? Man muss einander helfen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: Bringst du mir freundlicherweise einen frischen Laib Brot, darfst du meinen verzauberten Eimer nehmen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: Ich sah, wie du es mühsam selbst gebacken hast. Ehrlich, das übertrifft meine Erwartungen, also hier dein Lohn.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: Brauchst du künftig bei irgendetwas Hilfe, scheue dich nicht zu fragen. Gibst du dir solche Mühe für mich, tue ich dasselbe für dich.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.dst: Finde eine Verwendung für Damys' Eimer

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: Wie ich hörte, ist der Diebstahl nicht der Grund. Der Hain wurde eifersüchtig verborgen, weil seine Pflanzen so wirksam sind.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... Nur das Licht weiß, was noch. Ohne ungewöhnliche Mittel ist er unerreichbar- und das ist besorgniserregend.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: Finde einen Weg, die Pflanze am Wasserfall wachsen zu lassen

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: Halt! Dieses Gebiet ist streng verboten, erst recht für Fremde. Kehr sofort um!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: Aha, der Fremde kehrt zurück. Bedrückt dich etwas?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: ...mmm. Bedauerlich. Dabei kann ich nicht helfen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: Es geht nicht um Geheimnisse oder Moral- ich weiß schlicht nicht, woher dieses Blatt stammt oder was es vermag.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: Ich bin kein Botaniker- nur ein Gärtner. Der Irrtum ist verständlich, wenn auch bedauerlich.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: Doch ich lernte bei einer namhafteren Botanikerin, die vielleicht deine Antworten hat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: Ihr Name ist Fiona- sie wohnt jenseits des Tals. Nimm die Brücke. Sie bleibt oft drinnen und studiert.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: Sie hat mehr über Pflanzen vergessen, als ich je wissen werde. Kann sie dir nicht helfen, kann es niemand.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: Geh zum Haus der Botanikerin bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: Unerhört! Dass einer der Unseren sich zu solchem Diebstahl und solcher Zerstörung herablässt!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.dst: Fremder, jetzt ist nicht die Zeit für Fragen. Mein Haus wurde verwüstet!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: Hm? Damys schickt dich... Du hast Iridesca-Blätter? Hm... Dann können wir einander vielleicht helfen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: Der Eindringling durchwühlte Regale und Möbel und überflog die Seiten ebenso eifrig, als er es fand.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.dst: Danach warf er das Buch in den Garten und ließ eine fleischfressende Pflanze wachsen, die meine Notizen fraß!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.dst: Als er fand, was er suchte, ging er wohl in meinen Garten, warf das Buch der fleischfressenden Pflanze vor und stürmte zum Labor.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: Ich erforsche die Iridesca-Blüte und viele andere Pflanzen seit langer Zeit. Mein ganzes Wissen steht in diesem Buch!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: Bring es mir zurück, und ich teile mein Wissen mit dir.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: Töte die fleischfressende Pflanze und hol dir das Buch

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: ...widerlich. Die Seiten muss ich später zum Trocknen aufhängen, aber zuerst unser Tausch.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, nein... wo war noch gleich Iridesca...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: Aha, da ist es. Die Seiten klebten zusammen. Iridesca-Blätter sind auf vielerlei Weise wirksam und sehr vielseitig.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: Ihr Nutzen reicht unglaublich weit: von Linderung bei Gelenkschmerzen oder Heilung von Krankheit bis zu Brechreiz und tödlichem Gift, je nach Zubereitung.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.dst: Hm? Der Buchdieb hat auch Iridesca...? Das... das ist sehr beunruhigend. Außer meinen gibt es kaum Notizen zur Heilung einer Iridesca-Vergiftung.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.src: They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.dst: Er ging in Richtung der Trankbrauergilde. Falls er Übles im Schilde führt...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.dst: Untersuche den Laden des Alchemisten bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.src: ..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.dst: ..du! Du hast mich gesucht! Ich habe gesehen, wie du meinen Spuren folgst...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.src: I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.dst: Es tut mir leid... Aber was ich tue, ist notwendig!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.src: I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.dst: Ich flehe dich an, verfolge mich nicht weiter!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.src: Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.dst: Fremder, ich weiß, es sieht schlimm für mich aus, aber du musst aufhören!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.src: What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.dst: Was ich tat, war nötig, und gäbe es einen anderen Weg, hätte ich ihn gewählt.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.src: I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.dst: Ich muss mein Gebräu dorthin bringen, wo man es braucht!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.src: G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.dst: W A C H S! (Auf Hochgavellianisch)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.src: A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.dst: Was für ein verfluchtes Tempo... Ich lasse mich keinen Augenblick länger aufhalten!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.src: It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.dst: Bald ist es vollbracht, aber erst muss ich mein Ziel erreichen!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.src: Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.dst: Endlich... Verzeih die Verspätung. Ich musste zu harten Mitteln greifen, um dir das zu bringen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.src: Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.dst: Hier, hier... Trink, Vater. Das befreit deine Kehle.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.src: ...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.dst: ...so. Es ist vollbracht. Nun... Fremder... Hör mich bitte an.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.src: I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.dst: Ich weiß genau, was ich getan habe. Fionas Forschung zerfetzt, die verbotenen Gärten gestört, viele Herzen beunruhigt...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.src: My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.dst: Mein Vater erkrankte. Eine Reise an die Grenze von {p} brachte ihm eine Kerasot-Vergiftung ein. Er war dem Tode nah...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.src: {p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.dst: Das Dorf {p} ist eines der Verstoßenen- es zu besuchen ist, dummerweise, verboten. Man hätte ihn verbannt, und mit seinem Leiden wäre das sein Tod gewesen.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.src: Desperation causes one to do strange things. I thought only of his safety- I cared little about anything else.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.dst: Verzweiflung lässt einen seltsame Dinge tun. Ich dachte nur an seine Sicherheit- alles andere war mir gleich.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.src: Even now I am simply relieved for his safety. If you must turn me in, I understand- I have already done what I set out to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.dst: Selbst jetzt bin ich nur erleichtert, dass er sicher ist. Musst du mich ausliefern, verstehe ich das- ich habe getan, was ich wollte.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.src: Though I wish to remain free, whether you choose to report my activities or not does not matter to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.dst: Ich wäre gern frei, doch ob du meine Taten meldest oder nicht, ist mir nun gleich.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.src: Traveler, I must remind you- The doors shall remain shut until the criminal has been found.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.dst: Reisender, ich muss dich erinnern- die Tore bleiben geschlossen, bis der Verbrecher gefunden ist.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.src: ...ah. You have found him, then. The name is Korben... Understood. We shall interrogate him for his actions.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.dst: ...ah. Du hast ihn also gefunden. Sein Name ist Korben... Verstanden. Wir werden ihn zu seinen Taten verhören.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.src: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.dst: Wenn dem so ist... Du kannst nach Belieben in die Stadt {p} kommen und gehen. Wir öffnen die Tore wieder.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#080.src: ...you... You are... You would lie to the guards and say I perished in the chase? You will keep my identity secret?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#080.dst: ...du... Du würdest... Du würdest die Wachen belügen und sagen, ich sei bei der Jagd gestorben? Du verschweigst, wer ich bin?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#080.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#081.src: Outsider... You show generosity akin to my father. He passed his Sol Medallion onto me to continue his legacy...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#081.dst: Fremder... Du bist großzügig wie mein Vater. Er gab mir sein Sol Medallion, damit ich sein Vermächtnis fortführe...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#081.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#082.src: ...after what I have done, I do not deserve it. You take it, instead. It is in sufficiently worthy hands, I believe.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#082.dst: ...nach allem, was ich getan habe, verdiene ich es nicht. Nimm du es. Ich glaube, deine Hände sind seiner würdig.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#082.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#083.src: I shall beg the Light to shine upon you for the rest of your days. A thousand thanks to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#083.dst: Ich werde das Licht anflehen, dir für den Rest deiner Tage zu leuchten. Tausend Dank.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#083.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part II#000.src: {u}... I really thought you'd have my back out there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#000.dst: {u}... Ich dachte echt, du hältst mir den Rücken frei.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#000.speaker: Olon

similar.text: ... I really thought you'd have my back out there.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#001.src: You see, my family and a few other elves left {p} a long time ago to start a new life in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#001.dst: Weißt du, meine Familie und ein paar Elfen zogen vor langer Zeit von {p} nach {p}, um neu anzufangen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#001.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.src: More and more elves around {p} have died- but none in {p}. I believe something bizarre is going on here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.dst: Immer mehr Elfen rund um {p} sterben- aber keiner in {p}. Ich glaube, hier geht etwas Seltsames vor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.speaker: Olon

similar.text: More and more people around {p} have died! But none in {p}. I think something sketchy is going on in here.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#003.src: Please, {u}- I really need your help. Us {p} elves aren't exactly welcome with open arms in {p}. It's a surprise they even let us in at all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#003.dst: Bitte, {u}- ich brauche wirklich deine Hilfe. Wir Elfen aus {p} sind in {p} nicht gerade willkommen. Erstaunlich, dass man uns überhaupt reinlässt.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#003.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.src: Could you try asking around, see if these elves know anything about this?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.dst: Könntest du dich umhören, ob diese Elfen etwas darüber wissen?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.src: Ask the citizens if they know anything about what's going on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.dst: Frag die Bürger, ob sie wissen, was hier los ist.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#006.src: I'll wait up here for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#006.dst: Ich warte hier oben auf dich.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#007.src: New Quest Started: {p}'s Secret Part II
Aldorei's Secret Part II#007.dst: Neue Quest gestartet: Das Geheimnis von {p}, Teil II

similar.text: Oh... Yeah. Good job.
Enjoy {p} Town now.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.dst: Klar beantworte ich ein paar Fragen!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.src: Well... when I think about it- no.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.dst: Na ja... wenn ich so nachdenke- nein.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.src: Actually, there is an old tale for children about a dying elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.dst: Eigentlich gibt es ein altes Kindermärchen über einen sterbenden Elfen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.src: I never thought about it much since I've never seen anyone in {p} die before.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.dst: Ich habe nie viel darüber nachgedacht, weil ich in {p} noch nie jemanden sterben sah.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.speaker: Mona

similar.text: I never thought much about it since I have never seen anyone in here die before.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.src: I heard that there is some old graveyard somewhere in {p}, probably just some weird folktale.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.dst: Ich hörte, irgendwo in {p} gibt es einen alten Friedhof, wohl nur ein komisches Märchen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.src: You already got all the information you need from Mona.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.dst: Du hast von Mona schon alle Informationen, die du brauchst.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#040.dst: Sie zeigen sich selten öffentlich und bleiben lieber unter sich. Ich weiß nicht mal, wie alle aussehen!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.src: You dare speak to me like that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.dst: Du wagst es, so mit mir zu reden?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.dst: Ich lass dich ausweisen, und wenn's das Letzte ist, was ich tu, merk dir das!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#163.src: So what is it you need?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#163.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.src: If you don't mind me asking... Is your friend from {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.dst: Wenn ich fragen darf... Ist dein Freund aus {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.src: Farewell. Make sure to let everyone know I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.dst: Leb wohl. Sag allen, dass ich der Klügste bin!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.src: You humans are really stupid I have to say... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.dst: Ihr Menschen seid echt dumm, muss ich sagen... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.src: I'm younger than most here, you see. I'm just about a hundred years old.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.dst: Ich bin jünger als die meisten hier, weißt du. Ich bin gerade mal hundert Jahre alt.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#176.dst: Gibt es viele in deinem Alter?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.src: No. Do you not know of the child regulations here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.dst: Nein. Kennst du die Kinderregeln hier nicht?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.src: There are very strict restrictions on who or when someone can have children here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.dst: Hier ist streng geregelt, wer wann Kinder haben darf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.src: The main reason elves have moved to {p}, to start families.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.dst: Darum sind Elfen nach {p} gezogen, um Familien zu gründen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.src: I can't really say... You really don't want to break the rules here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.dst: Das kann ich nicht sagen... Hier willst du die Regeln wirklich nicht brechen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.src: I can give you some information but you need to leave me alone after.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.dst: Ich gebe dir ein paar Infos, aber danach lässt du mich in Ruhe.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.src: I'm not that much for... image and status.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.dst: Ich mach mir nicht viel aus... Ansehen und Status.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.src: Return to Olon with the information at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.dst: Kehr mit den Informationen zu Olon bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] zurück.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.src: Good idea! I overheard some elves talking about an underground river running under the town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.dst: Gute Idee! Ich hörte Elfen von einem unterirdischen Fluss unter der Stadt reden.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#191.src: So if you find water, you find the river.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#191.dst: Wenn du also Wasser findest, findest du den Fluss.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#191.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.src: I'll keep my distance, don't want to draw too much attention.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.dst: Ich halte Abstand, ich will nicht zu sehr auffallen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#194.src: I don't know how that will solve anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#194.dst: Ich weiß nicht, was das lösen soll.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#194.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#195.src: I mean, you talked to the citizens so maybe you know something I don't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#195.dst: Du hast ja mit den Bürgern geredet, vielleicht weißt du mehr als ich.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#195.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#196.src: Sure. Let's meet up at the potion merchant then.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#196.dst: Klar. Treffen wir uns beim Trankhändler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#196.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#198.src: Amber here! Ready to catch the bad guys!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#198.dst: Amber hier! Bereit, Bösewichte zu fangen!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#198.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#199.src: Are you here to report something?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#199.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#200.src: Hold on! Why are you with an {p} elf? Is this some sort of spy mission to take over {p} and turn it into a capitalistic society?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#200.dst: Moment! Warum bist du mit einem Elfen aus {p} unterwegs? Ist das eine Spionagemission, um {p} zu übernehmen und kapitalistisch zu machen?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#200.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#201.src: I will have to report this to the elders immediately!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#201.dst: Das muss ich sofort den Ältesten melden!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#201.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#203.src: Please don't Amber! We are f
Aldorei's Secret Part II#203.dst: Bitte nicht, Amber! Wir sind doch Freunde?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#204.src: I am a respected member of the task force. My only friend is the law.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#204.dst: Ich bin ein angesehenes Mitglied der Truppe. Mein einziger Freund ist das Gesetz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#204.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.src: I'm not sure what the punishment for talking to an {p} elf is, but I would imagine at least hanging at dawn. Or is there even a punishment?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.dst: Keine Ahnung, wie man das Reden mit einem Elfen aus {p} bestraft, aber mindestens mit dem Galgen bei Sonnenaufgang. Oder gibt's da gar keine Strafe?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#207.src: Let's just get out of here. I say looking into the underground river would have been the smartest move in the first place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#207.dst: Lass uns einfach verschwinden. Ich sag ja, der unterirdische Fluss wäre von Anfang an die klügste Wahl gewesen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#207.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#208.src: But money... I could go shopping in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#208.dst: Aber Geld... Ich könnte in {p} shoppen gehen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#208.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.src: Alright time to listen to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.dst: Gut, jetzt hörst du mal auf mich.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#211.src: Find the underground area of {p} near the waterfall.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#211.dst: Finde das unterirdische Gebiet von {p} nahe dem Wasserfall.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.src: Let's hope no elves are following us down here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.dst: Hoffen wir, dass uns keine Elfen hier runter folgen.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.src: Let's look for objects that resemble the {p} style down here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.dst: Suchen wir hier unten nach Dingen im Stil von {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#215.src: So yeah, let's hope we didn't draw any unneeded attention by doing all that unnecessary stuff.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#215.dst: Tja, hoffen wir, dass wir mit dem ganzen unnötigen Kram keine unnötige Aufmerksamkeit erregt haben.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#215.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#218.src: What exactly are we doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#218.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#220.src: Why didn't you just say that. Here, it's on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#220.dst: Warum sagst du das nicht gleich? Hier, geht auf mich.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#220.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#223.src: Can we get back on track now?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#223.speaker: Olon
