Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.src: The peace treaty keeps them inside their borders, and we get a delivery of supplies every month from {p} to send over to them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.dst: Der Friedensvertrag hält sie in ihren Grenzen, und jeden Monat bekommen wir aus {p} eine Lieferung, die wir an sie weiterschicken.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.src: Of course, we have to keep some of the supplies for ourselves - you've seen how hard these men are working, they deserve a bit of a party!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.dst: Natürlich müssen wir einen Teil davon für uns behalten - du siehst ja, wie hart die Männer arbeiten, die haben sich ein kleines Fest verdient!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.src: The Watch keeps a lookout over the Gerten borders day and night... well, maybe not on poker nights!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.dst: Die Wache bewacht die Grenzen der Gerts Tag und Nacht... na ja, vielleicht nicht an Pokerabenden!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.src: Although... we have heard a couple nasty rumours floating about - farmers disappearing from their houses and the such.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.dst: Allerdings... sind uns ein paar üble Gerüchte zu Ohren gekommen - Bauern, die aus ihren Häusern verschwinden und so.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.src: If I really can't tempt you with a glass of wine and a round of poker, maybe you could go and check them out for us?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.dst: Wenn ich dich wirklich nicht mit einem Glas Wein und einer Runde Poker locken kann, siehst du vielleicht für uns nach?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.src: I'd send the men, but... well, I'd feel bad if one of them went and missed all the partying!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.dst: Ich würde ja die Männer schicken, aber... na ja, schade, wenn einer von ihnen die Feierei verpasst!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.src: Here, you should head over and talk to Jitak, they're one of the farmers that lodged a complaint. Their house is west of here, I'll write down the co-ordinates.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.dst: Hier, geh doch zu Jitak, einer der Bauern, die sich beschwert haben. Das Haus liegt westlich von hier, ich schreib dir die Koordinaten auf.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.src: If you are looking for a suit or something, I can't help you. Now is a very bad time.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.dst: Falls du einen Anzug oder so suchst, kann ich dir nicht helfen. Gerade passt es sehr schlecht.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.src: Oh, you're here on behalf of the Watch? Ha, even sending Humans to do their work is not beneath them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.dst: Oh, du kommst im Auftrag der Wache? Ha, sogar Menschen ihre Arbeit machen zu lassen, ist ihnen nicht zu blöd.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.src: All they do is sit up in that tower playing drinking games and act like they own this region!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.dst: Die sitzen nur in ihrem Turm, spielen Trinkspiele und tun, als gehöre ihnen die Gegend!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.src: I reported the fact there is clearly a gert camp right in front of my house and they just ignored me. Now look, my pigs are all gone!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.dst: Ich hab gemeldet, dass direkt vor meinem Haus ein Gert-Lager ist, und sie haben mich ignoriert. Und jetzt sieh nur, meine Schweine sind alle weg!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.src: Well, that explains how the Gerts were able to get to the pigs. You should head back to Jitak.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.dst: Na, das erklärt, wie die Gerts an die Schweine kamen. Du solltest zu Jitak zurückgehen.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.src: I knew it was a mistake getting this property so close to gerten borders. See, gerts aren't the 'brutes' people insist, but...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: Ich wusste, es war ein Fehler, so nah an der Gert-Grenze zu kaufen. Gerts sind nicht die 'Rohlinge', für die alle sie halten, aber...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: Na ja, sie fressen einfach alles! Tiere, Fische, Monster, Dorfbewohner, sogar Menschen! Biologisch gesehen haben sie ständig Hunger.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: Die Wache soll sie eigentlich hinter ihren Grenzen halten...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: Ich hab sogar einen Golem gekauft, der sie bewacht - hab ihn günstig gekriegt, wegen irgendeines Vorfalls in der Fabrik von {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: Aber irgendwie schaffen es die Gerts, ihm auszuweichen! Hör mal, wenn du von der Wache kommst, hilfst du mir?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.dst: Geh zum Gert-Lager westlich von hier und finde heraus, wie sie das alles anstellen!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.dst: Untersuche die Höhle hinten im Lager bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: Looks like the Gerten chiefs are having a meeting, you shouldn't get too close... maybe there's somewhere nearby you can eavesdrop from?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: Die Gert-Häuptlinge halten wohl eine Versammlung ab, geh nicht zu nah ran... vielleicht gibt es in der Nähe eine Stelle zum Lauschen?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: -Gute Arbeit, ihr alle! Ich stolz sagen, wir Höhlenstraße sehr gut gemacht.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.dst: Dorfleute in Gylia klauen Sachen für uns für ihre Party und lassen uns mit nix sitzen!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.dst: Aber dumme überfütterte Dorfleute nicht gemerkt, wie wir Höhlenstraße graben direkt unter ihr Wachhaus.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.dst: Mit neuem Weg ins Gylia-Land wir haben mehr Sachen als je!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: Mensch! Du bist zurück... und wurdest nicht von einem Gert gefressen!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.dst: Was hast du im Lager herausgefunden?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: Ein Tunnel?! Unter der Gert-Grenze hindurch? So kommen sie also rein und stehlen mein Vieh.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: Hör zu, Mensch. Die Wache wird dagegen nichts tun. Bitte... vielleicht kannst du mir helfen.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.dst: Wenn du dich als Gert verkleidest, könntest du dich in ihr Hauptlager schleichen und den Tunnel untersuchen?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.dst: Okay! Wie du siehst, tragen alle Gerts einen geschnitzten Kürbis auf dem Kopf - hat was mit ihrer Kultur zu tun.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.dst: In der Nähe gibt es eine Kürbisfarm bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... vielleicht holst du dir dort einen?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~},-{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.dst: In der Nähe gibt es eine Kürbisfarm bei [-{~},-{~}]... vielleicht holst du dir dort einen?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.dst: Geh zur Kürbisfarm der Gerts bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.src: Oh good, were you sent here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: Oh gut, hat man dich als mein Mittagessen geschickt?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: The gert is looking at you hungrily... it might be best to leave the conversation?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: Der Gert sieht dich hungrig an... vielleicht beendest du das Gespräch lieber?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: Oh. What are you then, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: Oh. Was bist du dann, eine Art Snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: ... Ist das ein Witz? Was bist du, eine Art Snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: A who.. man? Oh, you mean new folk! All the way here in gerten lands? I have not seen one of you here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: Ein Men.. sch? Oh, du meinst neues Volk! Den ganzen Weg ins Gertenland? So einen hab ich hier noch nie gesehen.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.dst: Ich will schon wissen, wie du schmeckst...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: The gert has a strange look in his eyes and is inching towards you suspiciously...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.dst: Der Gert hat einen seltsamen Blick und schiebt sich verdächtig an dich heran...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: Machen? Ich bewache natürlich das Orangenknollen-Feld!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.dst: Von diesem Feld hier holen sich alle Gerts ihre Tagesmaske!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: Nein, neues Volk. Nur Gerts auf diesem Feld.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: Darum haben sie mich hier hingestellt. Damit keiner reinkommt.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.dst: Aber aber mir ist so öde... und ich will so gern essen...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.src: I'll pay you to let me take
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.src: Like, with the clear green rocks?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.dst: So mit den klaren grünen Steinen?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.src: No new folk, gerts do not have any need for green rocks. But...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.dst: Nein, neues Volk, Gerts brauchen keine grünen Steine. Aber...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.src: How about this - I will just eat you!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.dst: Wie wär's damit - ich esse dich einfach!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.src: Well, I think I will still eat you. Just how it is!

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#001.src: Request from the Customs Clerk: To whomever it may concern, there has recently been an increase in damaged goods from outside the Capital. When questioned, various artisans admit having been attacked by ferocious beasts.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#001.dst: Auftrag des Zollbeamten: An alle, die es betrifft: In letzter Zeit kommen vermehrt beschädigte Waren von außerhalb der Hauptstadt an. Auf Nachfrage gaben mehrere Handwerker zu, von wilden Bestien angegriffen worden zu sein.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#002.src: Woolly Rhinos seem to match the description, and they are indeed creatures not to be tempered with. I am unsure what causes them such unrest. Perhaps they feel a change in the environment, but it matters not.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#002.dst: Wollnashörner scheinen zur Beschreibung zu passen, und mit diesen Kreaturen ist wahrlich nicht zu spaßen. Ich weiß nicht, was sie so unruhig macht. Vielleicht spüren sie eine Veränderung ihrer Umgebung, doch das spielt keine Rolle.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#003.src: What matters is that more and more goods are being damaged, causing delays in the monitoring of what goes in and out of the Capital. If someone could hunt at least {~} Woolly Rhinos, it would be of assistance to us all.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#003.dst: Wichtig ist, dass immer mehr Waren beschädigt werden, was die Kontrolle dessen verzögert, was in die Hauptstadt hinein- und hinausgeht. Wenn jemand mindestens {~} Wollnashörner jagen könnte, wäre uns allen geholfen.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#004.src: There are reports of two of them having been spotted nearby House Thalas and House Nasin. I have set up a carriage next to this board if you wish to go there.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#004.dst: Berichten zufolge wurden zwei davon in der Nähe von Haus Thalas und Haus Nasin gesichtet. Ich habe neben dieser Tafel eine Kutsche bereitgestellt, falls du dorthin willst.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#005.src: Additionally, a friend of mine has also seen one to the north of {p}, quite close to the town itself. Please return to this post once you are done. As mentioned, they are very resilient. Be sure to brace yourself.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#005.dst: Außerdem hat ein Freund von mir eines nördlich von {p} gesehen, recht nah an der Stadt selbst. Bitte kehr zu dieser Tafel zurück, wenn du fertig bist. Wie gesagt, sie sind sehr zäh. Mach dich auf einiges gefasst.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#006.src: You've hunted enough of those beasts. You should return to the Slaying Post to collect your reward.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#006.dst: Du hast genug dieser Bestien gejagt. Kehr zur Jagdtafel zurück, um deine Belohnung abzuholen.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#007.src: Return to the Slaying Post at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to collect your reward.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#007.dst: Kehr zur Jagdtafel bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] zurück, um deine Belohnung abzuholen.

Ice Nations#000.src: Thank you again for bringing peace upon our islands.
Ice Nations#000.dst: Nochmals danke für den Frieden auf unseren Inseln.
Ice Nations#000.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#002.src: It's useless to come back to me if you do not have the treasure.
Ice Nations#002.dst: Es ist sinnlos, zu mir zurückzukommen, wenn du den Schatz nicht hast.

Ice Nations#003.src: ...You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#003.dst: ...Weißt du, unser Schiffbruch hatte keine natürliche Ursache. Wir wurden angegriffen...
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Ice Nations#006.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#007.dst: Mein Volk und ich landeten vor vielen Jahren hier. Leider hat unser Schiff es nicht geschafft...
Ice Nations#007.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#008.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#008.dst: Wir wollten auf diesen Inseln eine Nation gründen, wurden aber über die Jahre gespalten.
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#009.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#009.dst: Deshalb führen wir einen sinnlosen Krieg gegen unsere Nachbarn.
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#010.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#010.dst: Wir sollten einen Friedensvertrag schließen, aber ich fürchte, getötet zu werden, wenn ich die Insel verlasse...
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#011.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#011.dst: Würdest du uns helfen? Sprich mit Hallfred über den Vertrag. Er lebt auf einer anderen Eisinsel in der Nähe.
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#012.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#012.dst: Sprich mit Hallfred über den Friedensvertrag

Ice Nations#013.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#013.dst: Willkommen, Reisender! Was führt dich auf unsere Insel?
Ice Nations#013.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#014.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#014.dst: Oh, wie ich sehe, schickt Adigard aus Feigheit jetzt schon Fremde! Hat er Angst, getötet zu werden?
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#015.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#015.dst: Ich sage es zum letzten Mal: Wir unterzeichnen den Friedensvertrag an dem Tag, an dem Adigard und seine Nation uns zurückgeben... den Schatz.
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#016.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#016.dst: Den sie nach dem Schiffbruch behalten und vor uns versteckt haben.
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#017.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#017.dst: Pures Gold, sehr wertvoll und selten! Sag ihm, ich warte darauf. Und nicht wieder diese alberne Geschichte.
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#018.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response

Ice Nations#019.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#019.dst: Das hätte ich mir denken können. Hallfred war schon immer sehr gierig...
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#020.dst: Wir haben versucht, ihm klarzumachen, dass wir den Schatz nicht haben, ohne großen Erfolg.
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#021.dst: Von wem? Von den Untoten. Geister und Dämonen auf einem monströsen Schiff. Sie haben uns überrumpelt.
Ice Nations#021.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#022.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#022.dst: Ich glaube, sie haben beim Angriff auch unseren Schatz gestohlen.
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#023.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#023.dst: Hilfst du, unsere Nation wieder zu vereinen? Finde dieses Schiff und bring den Schatz zu Hallfred, damit wir endlich in Frieden leben.
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#024.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#024.dst: Segel nach Norden. Dort haben sie uns vor vielen Jahren angegriffen. Leicht zu finden, sicher liegen sie dort stolz vor Anker... Danke.
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#025.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#025.dst: Finde das Geisterschiff und bring [Ancient Treasure] zu Hallfred

Ice Nations#026.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#026.dst: Unglaublich! Er hat den Schatz tatsächlich gebracht!
Ice Nations#026.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#027.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#027.dst: Das bedeutet wohl das Ende des Krieges zwischen unseren Nationen!
Ice Nations#027.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#028.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#028.dst: Was für ein großer Tag! Hier, nimm das als Dank für deine Hilfe.
Ice Nations#028.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#029.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#029.dst: Für diesen Helm findest du sicher eines Tages Verwendung!
Ice Nations#029.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#030.src: Find the ghost ship by heading north of the {p} and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Ice Nations#030.dst: Finde das Geisterschiff nördlich von {p} und bring [Ancient Treasure] zu Hallfred bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Infested Pit#001.src: Oh, it seems I have some guests. You're just in time for dinner... hehe..
Infested Pit#001.dst: Oh, wie es scheint, habe ich Gäste. Ihr kommt gerade rechtzeitig zum Abendessen... hehe..

Infested Pit#002.src: My poor babies are starving. But what shall they feast on? How about... you?
Infested Pit#002.dst: Meine armen Kleinen verhungern. Aber woran sollen sie sich laben? Wie wäre es mit... euch?

Infested Pit#003.src: Alright, we're in. Keep your guards up, you two. Don't want to get picked off by the spiders!
Infested Pit#003.dst: Gut, wir sind drin. Passt auf, ihr zwei. Wir wollen nicht von den Spinnen einzeln erwischt werden!
Infested Pit#003.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#004.src: Ha. No, we wouldn't want that... we'll proceed with caution.
Infested Pit#004.dst: Ha. Nein, das wollen wir nicht... wir gehen vorsichtig weiter.
Infested Pit#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#005.src: There's more spiders here than I expected... Nothing we can't handle, of course, but- still.
Infested Pit#005.dst: Hier sind mehr Spinnen, als ich erwartet habe... Nichts, womit wir nicht fertigwerden, natürlich, aber- trotzdem.
Infested Pit#005.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#006.src: Oh, hey- watch your step! Don't want to fall and get stuck in those webs down there, yeah?
Infested Pit#006.dst: Oh, hey- passt auf, wo ihr hintretet! Ihr wollt doch nicht runterfallen und in den Netzen da unten hängen bleiben, oder?
Infested Pit#006.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#007.src: So you freed the Mushroom Man... no matter. My babies think you three look just as delicious... You will make a fine replacement, hehehe...
Infested Pit#007.dst: Ihr habt also den Pilzmann befreit... egal. Meine Kleinen finden, dass ihr drei genauso köstlich ausseht... Ihr werdet einen feinen Ersatz abgeben, hehehe...
Infested Pit#007.speaker: Arakadicus

Infested Pit#008.src: I can't imagine it's much further from here. Just a few more jumps to make, a few more spiders to fight through, and we'll be there.
Infested Pit#008.dst: Ich glaube nicht, dass es noch viel weiter ist. Nur noch ein paar Sprünge, ein paar Spinnen mehr, und wir sind da.
Infested Pit#008.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#009.src: Here we are, then. The spider queen must be through here.
Infested Pit#009.dst: Da wären wir also. Die Spinnenkönigin muss hier durch sein.
Infested Pit#009.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#010.src: Alright. Let's rest a moment, then head on in and take her out. If we work together, these spiders won't stand a chance!
Infested Pit#010.dst: Gut. Ruhen wir uns kurz aus, dann gehen wir rein und erledigen sie. Wenn wir zusammenarbeiten, haben diese Spinnen keine Chance!
Infested Pit#010.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#011.src: Ah, the main course has arrived. You look so good, I think I'll have a taste of you myself!
Infested Pit#011.dst: Ah, der Hauptgang ist eingetroffen. Du siehst so gut aus, ich glaube, ich koste selbst von dir!
Infested Pit#011.speaker: Arakadicus

Infested Pit#012.src: Well, we're not going to make it easy for you! We'll take you down!
Infested Pit#012.dst: Tja, so leicht machen wir es dir nicht! Wir erledigen dich!
Infested Pit#012.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#013.src: The people living in the forest are more than just food for you spiders! We won't let you attack them anymore!
Infested Pit#013.dst: Die Leute, die im Wald leben, sind mehr als nur Futter für euch Spinnen! Wir lassen nicht mehr zu, dass ihr sie angreift!
Infested Pit#013.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#014.src: Oh, it seems I have a guest. You're just in time for dinner... hehe..
Infested Pit#014.dst: Oh, wie es scheint, habe ich einen Gast. Du kommst gerade rechtzeitig zum Abendessen... hehe..

Infested Pit#015.src: You've come so far, haven't you? And my babies are just so hungry... You'll make a fine meal for them... hehehe...
Infested Pit#015.dst: Du bist so weit gekommen, nicht wahr? Und meine Kleinen sind so hungrig... Du wirst ein feines Mahl für sie abgeben... hehehe...
Infested Pit#015.speaker: Arakadicus

Infested Plants#000.src: I'm going to go on ahead. Just follow the coordinates in your content book to find that cave!
Infested Plants#000.dst: Ich gehe schon mal vor. Folge einfach den Koordinaten in deinem Inhaltsbuch, um die Höhle zu finden!

Infested Plants#001.src: ...mm, cutting it a little close, but... oh! You're, uh, still here...! Right. Right- you have to go into that cave, remember?
Infested Plants#001.dst: ...mm, wird ein bisschen knapp, aber... oh! Du bist, äh, noch hier...! Richtig. Richtig- du musst in diese Höhle, weißt du noch?

Infested Plants#004.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#004.dst: Triff dich mit Tasim am Eingang von {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#005.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#005.dst: Oh, {u}! Da bist du ja. Schön, dich zu sehen. Bereit, weiter Richtung {p} zu ziehen?
Infested Plants#005.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#006.dst: H-he! Ihr zwei! Ihr seid doch Soldaten, oder? Sieht man an eurem komischen Modegeschmack. Ihr sollt doch Leuten helfen! Also. Helft!

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.dst: Hm? Oh- ja, natürlich! Wie heißt du? Wobei brauchst du Hilfe?
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.dst: Ich bin Ope! Ich wurde neulich... äh... von einer Spinne gebissen! Jetzt brauch ich ein seltenes Heilkraut, um gesund zu werden!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.dst: Es wächst nur in einer Höhle voller Krabbelviecher. Und ich bin ja wohl kaum in der Lage, es selbst zu holen!
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.dst: Na gut! Wir sind ja zum Helfen da, also... Wir holen dir das Kraut!
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#011.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#012.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#012.dst: Hm... Ihr seid zu zweit. Gut! Einer klettert in die Höhle da oben, der andere beschützt mich hier unten vor den Krabbelspinnen!
Infested Plants#012.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#013.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#013.dst: Gut! {u}, du gehst in die Höhle, und ich beschütze Ope hier, solange du weg bist.
Infested Plants#013.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#014.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#014.dst: Finde die Medizin in der Spinnenhöhle hinter Ope bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#015.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.
Infested Plants#015.dst: Verlass die Höhle bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] mit dem Heilkraut.

Infested Plants#016.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#016.dst: Da bist du ja! Kommt mir vor, als hätten wir stundenlang gewartet.
Infested Plants#016.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#017.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#017.dst: Es... war wirklich nicht so lange. Höchstens zehn Minuten.
Infested Plants#017.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#018.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#018.dst: Na ja-... Egal! Habt ihr das Kraut? Es ist sehr- äh, wichtig! Um mich zu heilen. Jep.
Infested Plants#018.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#021.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#021.dst: Das ist... frustrierend. Er wirkte von Anfang an zwielichtig, ich hätte-... Na ja. Geschehen ist geschehen. Reden wir mit dem Bürgermeister.
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#022.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in Alekin Village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#022.dst: Sprich mit Bürgermeister Alvin in Alekin Village bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#023.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#023.dst: Sprich mit Bürgermeister Alvin in {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#024.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#024.dst: Ah, Reisende... willkommen in unserem bescheidenen Walddorf. Wollt ihr bleiben, oder seid ihr nur auf der Durchreise?
Infested Plants#024.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#025.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#025.dst: Wohl Letzteres. Allerdings sind wir einem Mann namens Ope begegnet, der uns zu Euch geschickt hat.
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#026.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#026.dst: Hier, als Entschuldigung biete ich euch eine kleine Summe Smaragde an. Ich hoffe, er hat euch unser kleines Dorf nicht verleidet...
Infested Plants#026.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#027.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#027.dst: Oh... Danke. Das ist sehr freundlich von Euch. Wir bleiben wohl eine Weile, bevor wir weiter nach {p} ziehen.
Infested Plants#027.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#028.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#028.dst: Oh, {u}! Da bist du ja. Schön, dich zu sehen. Wir sollten weiter Richtung {p}, aber...

Infested Plants#029.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#029.dst: Sieht aus, als müssten wir erst durch {p}. Ich habe gehört, der Wald wimmelt von Spinnen... und die Untoten sind gefährlich wie immer... aber unter uns, wir sollten-

Infested Plants#030.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?
Infested Plants#030.dst: H-he! Ihr zwei! Ihr seid doch Soldaten, oder?

Infested Plants#032.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#032.dst: Jep, sieht man an eurem komischen Modegeschmack! Ihr sollt doch Leuten helfen, oder? Also. Helft!

Infested Plants#033.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#033.dst: Na klar- aber wer bist du? Warum bist du allein unterwegs, ist das nicht gefährlich? Sind die Untoten nicht...

Infested Plants#034.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#034.dst: Ich bin Ope! Und die Untoten... ach, davon gibt's hier nicht so viele. Den Spinnen ist egal, wen sie sich schnappen.

Infested Plants#035.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#035.dst: Ach so... okay. Das ergibt Sinn. Wobei brauchtest du Hilfe?

Infested Plants#036.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#036.dst: Ich... äh... also, in diesen Wäldern wächst so ein seltenes Heilkraut, ja? Und es ist wichtig. Aber ich kenne es nur aus einer verseuchten Höhle voller ekliger Krabbelspinnen.

Infested Plants#037.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#037.dst: Und, na ja, ich- ich bin kein Soldat! Ich kann da nicht einfach rein und es holen! Also hatte ich gehofft, ihr helft mir.

Infested Plants#038.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#038.dst: Na ja... wir sind ja nach Wynn gekommen, um zu helfen. Also... wir holen dir das Kraut!

Infested Plants#039.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#039.dst: Toll. Toll! Ich bring euch zur Höhle, den Rest macht ihr von dort aus. Folgt mir!

Infested Plants#040.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#040.dst: So, da wären wir! Die Höhle ist gleich da drüben- klettert einfach die Felsen hoch und springt rein. Ist sicher! Äh, wahrscheinlich.

Infested Plants#041.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#041.dst: ...iek. Selbst hier oben sind so viele Spinnen... hey, wo ihr zu zweit seid- einer holt das Kraut, und der andere kann, äh... mich vor den Krabbelspinnen beschützen?

Infested Plants#042.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#042.dst: Passt mir. {u}, du gehst in die Höhle, und ich verteidige Ope hier oben, solange du drin bist.

Infested Plants#043.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#043.dst: Jep... gut! Gut, gut! Viel, äh, Glück da oben! Lass dich nicht zu oft von den Spinnen beißen!

Infested Plants#044.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#044.dst: ...ah- da bist du ja!! Was hat so lange gedauert, kommt mir vor, als hätten wir stundenlang gewartet!

Infested Plants#045.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#045.dst: Das-... mm. E-egal! Hast du das Kraut? Es ist sehr wichtig, jep.

Infested Plants#046.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#046.dst: Wenn ich so drüber nachdenke... Du hast nie gesagt, wofür du es brauchst.

Infested Plants#047.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#047.dst: Oh, ich- ehehe, es... ich... äh, das geht dich eigentlich n-nichts an.

Infested Plants#048.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#048.dst: Ich- ich danke euch herzlich für eure Arbeit, Soldaten! Nun, zu eurer Bezahlung... mal sehen, was hab ich denn...

Infested Plants#049.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#049.dst: Oh. Mir sind wohl die Smaragde ausgegangen. Na- dann, d-dann gebe ich euch einen Rat! In diesem Wald gibt's viel zu finden. Jede Menge Höhlen mit Schätzen! Könnte sich lohnen!

Infested Plants#050.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#050.dst: Moment, was? He, willst du etwa echt nicht-

Infested Plants#051.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#051.dst: War schön, Soldaten, aber ich- ich muss jetzt wirklich los! Wichtige Dinge zu erledigen! Wir sind nahe {p}, schaut doch vorbei! Einfach die Hauptstraße nach Osten!

Infested Plants#052.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#052.dst: Ihr könnt, äh, zum Bürgermeister gehen! Der übernimmt meine Kosten!

Infested Plants#054.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#054.dst: Das ist... frustrierend. Ich wollte es doch nur wissen... na ja. Geschehen ist geschehen. Reden wir mit dem Bürgermeister, den er erwähnt hat.

Infested Plants#055.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#055.dst: Ich gehe schon mal vor. Wir sehen uns in {p}, einfach die Hauptstraße nach Osten.

Infested Plants#056.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#056.dst: Ah, Rekruten... willkommen in unserem bescheidenen Walddorf. Wollt ihr bleiben, oder seid ihr nur auf der Durchreise?

Infested Plants#057.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#057.dst: Nur auf der Durchreise, unser Ziel ist {p}. Allerdings... sind wir einem Mann namens Ope begegnet, der uns zu Euch geschickt hat.

Infested Plants#058.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#058.dst: Oh, Ope... Eure Begegnung lief wohl schlecht? Ich muss mich für ihn entschuldigen, er ist... manchmal ein schwieriger Mensch.

Infested Plants#059.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#059.dst: Oh... danke. Das ist sehr freundlich von Euch. Wir bleiben wohl eine Weile, bevor wir weiter nach {p} ziehen.

Infested Plants#060.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#060.dst: Dann fühlt euch ganz wie zu Hause! Hier sind alle Reisenden willkommen, egal wie lange sie bleiben.

Infested Plants#061.src: I'm going to go rest up a little. I'll be ready for more adventures soon though, don't worry!
Infested Plants#061.dst: Ich ruhe mich ein bisschen aus. Aber keine Sorge, bald bin ich bereit für neue Abenteuer!
Infested Plants#061.speaker: Tasim

Jungle Fever#000.src: The only cure to this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#000.dst: Das einzige Mittel gegen dieses Fieber: Flüssige Smaragde trinken! Ja, genau! *hust*
Jungle Fever#000.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#001.src: Break into *cough* the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#001.dst: Brich *hust* ins Smaragdlager ein, aber nimm nichts mit... komm gleich danach zu mir zurück, falls du lebend rauskommst, hehe...
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we don't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#002.dst: Wir müssen die Strategie ändern, wir fragen nicht um Erlaubnis. Ist ja schließlich, um mir zu helfen.
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: I needed to make sure you could easily break into a bank. So i came here by myself to see if you could do it.
Jungle Fever#003.dst: Ich musste sicher sein, dass du locker in eine Bank einbrichst. Also kam ich allein her, um zu sehen, ob du's schaffst.

Jungle Fever#004.src: You've proven your ability of stealth and strength by breaking into this storage, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#004.dst: Mit dem Einbruch in dieses Lager hast du Heimlichkeit und Stärke bewiesen, jetzt geht es richtig los.

Jungle Fever#005.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golems, who can kill anyone in one hit.
Jungle Fever#005.dst: Es wird von unzähligen gut ausgebildeten Wachgolems bewacht, die jeden mit einem Schlag töten.

similar.text: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.

Jungle Fever#006.src: ..I mean *cough*.. I was too sick so i came back here.. *cough*
Jungle Fever#006.dst: ..Ich meine *hust*.. ich war zu krank, also bin ich zurück.. *hust*

Jungle Fever#007.src: I feel so much better now, thank you for the cure!
Jungle Fever#007.dst: Jetzt geht's mir viel besser, danke für das Heilmittel!

Jungle Fever#008.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#008.dst: Sprich mit Worid im Dschungeldorf bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#009.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#009.dst: Oh, wie schön, dich zu sehen! *hust*, ich hab ein schlimmes Fieber und brauche dringend Hilfe! *hust*
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#011.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#011.dst: Könntest du den Bankier in {p} fragen, ob er mir, ach, was weiß ich, [{~} Flüssige Smaragde] geben kann?
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#012.dst: Falls er die Frechheit besitzt, *hust* Nein zu sagen... musst du rohe Gewalt anwenden...
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#015.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#015.dst: Sprich mit dem Bankier von {p} über das Heilmittel für Worid bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#016.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#016.dst: [{~} Flüssige Smaragde]? Der ist verrückt! Flüssige Smaragde heilen niemanden von irgendwas, außer von Armut!
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#017.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#017.dst: Bei diesem erbärmlichen Betrugsversuch mache ich nicht mit!
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#019.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#019.dst: Oh nein! Wie soll ich meine Krankheit je ohne Flüssige Smaragde heilen?... *hust*
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: Erst muss ich sicher sein, dass du locker in eine Bank einbrichst. Versuch's im Geheimlager von {p}.
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: Wenn du fertig bist, sprich wieder mit mir. Und sei vorsichtig, vielleicht haben sie Wachen.
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#024.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#024.dst: Was? Du bist schon da. Ich dachte, du brauchst zu lange, also bin ich selbst gegangen.
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#025.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: Meine Krankheit? RICHTIG. *hust* Schäm dich, einen kranken Mann deine Arbeit machen zu lassen.
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#026.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#026.dst: Jedenfalls hast du dich bewiesen, jetzt geht es richtig los.
Jungle Fever#026.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#027.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#027.dst: Weißt du, {p} hat einen sehr gut bewachten Smaragdtresor namens "Das Smaragdlabyrinth".
Jungle Fever#027.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#028.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#028.dst: Er wird von unzähligen gut ausgebildeten Wachgolems bewacht, die jeden Abenteurer locker töten.
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: Der Bankier im geheimen Tresor muss sich zu Tode langweilen und hat sicher nichts dagegen, wenn du ihn findest.
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#030.dst: Viel Glück dabei. Haha.. ich meine, *hust*.
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#031.dst: Dring in das geheime Smaragdlabyrinth unter {p} bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ein und finde den Bankier im Smaragdraum

Jungle Fever#032.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#032.dst: Oh, äh! Jemand! Ich habe so lange niemanden mehr gesehen!
Jungle Fever#032.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#033.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#033.dst: Flüssige Smaragde? Natürlich, natürlich! Ich habe Unmengen! Hier, nimm sie.
Jungle Fever#033.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#036.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#036.dst: Das ist eine Menge Geld, vielen Dank, endlich kann ich... *hust* mich heilen!
Jungle Fever#036.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#037.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#037.dst: Hier, nimm diesen Teil, du hast ihn verdient. Das meiste... *hust* Geld brauche ich zum Heilen, also bezahle ich dich mit einem Schlüssel.
Jungle Fever#037.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#038.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#038.dst: Ich hab ihn geklaut- *hust* ich meine, vom Anführer unseres Stammes geliehen. Angeblich sperrte man damit ein großes Übel weg.
Jungle Fever#038.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#039.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#039.dst: Endlich los- *hust* Äh... viel Glück. Ja, viel Glück, Abenteurer!
Jungle Fever#039.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#001.src: {#}Cast your Arrow Bomb Spell by clicking  LEFT -  RIGHT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow
King's Recruit#001.dst: {#}Halte deinen Bogen und klicke  LINKS -  RECHTS -  RECHTS  für deinen Zauber Arrow Bomb

similar.text: {#}Cast your Arrow Storm Spell by clicking  RIGHT -  LEFT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

King's Recruit#002.src: You three are going to make fine soldiers. Now, go on to {p}, the King is awaiting your arrival.
King's Recruit#002.dst: Ihr drei werdet gute Soldaten abgeben. Nun geht nach {p}, der König erwartet eure Ankunft.

King's Recruit#003.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#006.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#006.dst: He, {u}! Alles okay da drin? Wir sind wohl gegen was gefahren.

King's Recruit#007.src: Hey, {u}! Are you alright in there? It looks like we've hit something.
King's Recruit#007.dst: He, {u}! Alles in Ordnung da drin? Wir sind wohl gegen etwas gestoßen.

King's Recruit#008.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#008.dst: Steig aus der Karawane und sprich mit dem Karawanenkutscher bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#009.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#009.dst: Steig aus der Karawane und sprich mit dem Kutscher bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#010.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#010.dst: Hm... Ich schwöre, jedes Mal erwische ich diesen verflixten Felsen. Sorry, Leute.
King's Recruit#010.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#011.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#011.dst: Ah. Heißt das, wir müssen von hier den ganzen Weg nach {p} laufen?
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#012.dst: Leider ja. Zum Glück ist es nicht weit. Einfach immer geradeaus.
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#013.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#013.dst: Na, hilft nichts, weiter geht's! Tasim, {u}, wer zuerst am Tor ist!
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#015.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#015.dst: ... Schon weg. Wir müssen ihn einholen. {u}, geh voran.
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#016.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#016.dst: Folge dem Weg zum Tor der Provinz Wynn bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#017.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#017.dst: Folge dem Weg zum Tor der Provinz Wynn bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#018.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#018.dst: Du weißt vermutlich auch nicht viel über Wynn, oder?
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#019.dst: Klar, der König von {p} rekrutiert Soldaten aus Fruma, aber...
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#020.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#020.dst: Ihr Krieg muss ziemlich übel laufen, wenn sie so viel Unterstützung brauchen.
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#021.dst: Oh, da ist Aledar! Und das Tor, wie es aussieht.
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#022.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#022.dst: Da seid ihr ja! Ihr müsst schneller werden, wenn ihr gegen die Untoten eine Chance haben wollt.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time.
King's Recruit#023.dst: Ja, ja, nächstes Mal sind wir schneller.
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#024.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.dst: Ja, ja, nächstes Mal sind wir schneller. Ist das also das Tor an der Grenze zwischen Wynn und Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#025.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#025.dst: Sieht ganz so aus, jep! Seid ihr zwei bereit für unser neues Leben?
King's Recruit#025.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#026.src: Looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#026.dst: Sieht so aus, jep! Seid ihr zwei bereit für den Anfang unseres neuen Lebens?
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#027.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#027.dst: {u}, willst du nicht die Ehre haben? Los, mach das Tor auf.
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#028.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#029.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#030.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#030.dst: Na, worauf warten wir? Erkunden wir diese Provinz.
King's Recruit#030.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#031.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#031.dst: Zieh weiter durch die Provinz Wynn bis zur Burg

King's Recruit#032.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#032.dst: Das ist also Wynn, von dem wir so viel gehört haben... Wunderschön.
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#033.src: So this is the Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#033.dst: Das ist also das Wynn, von dem wir so viel gehört haben... Wunderschön.
King's Recruit#033.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#034.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#034.dst: Bis hierher ist der Krieg wohl noch nicht gekommen. Genau das werden wir verteidigen.
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#035.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#035.dst: He, Rekruten! Kommt mal her, ich muss euch was sagen.
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#038.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#038.dst: Ein Soldat? Was macht Ihr denn so weit hier draußen?
King's Recruit#038.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#039.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#039.dst: Weiter vorne gibt es etwas Ärger. Man hat mich hergeschickt, um neue Rekruten abzufangen.
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#040.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#040.dst: Wenn ihr hier draußen überleben wollt, braucht ihr das.
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#043.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#043.dst: Hoffentlich müssen wir die nicht gleich benutzen.
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#044.dst: Viel Glück da draußen, Rekruten! Folgt einfach diesem Weg, weiter vorne kommt eine Brücke.
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#045.src: Just follow this path straight forward, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#045.dst: Folgt einfach diesem Weg geradeaus, weiter vorne kommt eine Brücke.
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#048.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#048.dst: Ah, das muss die Brücke sein, von der der Soldat sprach. Aber sie sieht wirklich sehr...
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#049.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#049.dst: Na, lassen wir den König von {p} nicht warten!
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#053.dst: Genau davor wollte ich dich warnen! Runter von der Brücke, bevor der Rest auch noch einstürzt...
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#054.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#054.dst: Und wie sollen wir jetzt auf die andere Seite der Schlucht kommen? Ugh. Schon wieder geht was schief, genau wie-...
King's Recruit#054.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#056.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#056.dst: Das ist... seltsam. Ich hab gerade an etwas von vor Wynn gedacht, aber... es ist weg. Ich kann mich nicht erinnern.
King's Recruit#056.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#057.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#057.dst: Hm. Ich erinnere mich auch an nichts aus Fruma... {u}, und du?
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#058.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#058.dst: Nichts. Das kann kein Zufall sein, dass wir alle zugleich das Gedächtnis verloren, oder?
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we've all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#059.dst: Nichts. Das kann kein Zufall sein, dass wir alle zugleich das Gedächtnis verloren, oder?
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#060.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#060.dst: Nein, aber... Darum kümmern wir uns später. Erst mal müssen wir über diese Schlucht. Aledar, {u}, sucht ihr nach einem Weg hinüber. Ich suche hier weiter.
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#062.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#062.dst: Suche einen anderen Weg über die Schlucht bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#063.src: Find another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#063.dst: Finde einen anderen Weg über die Schlucht bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#064.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#064.dst: Wow! Das hat geklappt, {u}. Gut mitgedacht!
King's Recruit#064.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#065.dst: He, Tasim! Komm her, {u} hat einen Weg rüber gefunden!
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#068.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#068.dst: Puh! Diesmal sind wir wenigstens heil rübergekommen.
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#069.dst: Wenn wir einfach geradeaus weitergehen, sind wir im Nu in {p}!
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#070.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#070.dst: Hmm? Was macht diese Wache hier? Wir sollten wohl mit ihr reden, wenn wir durchwollen.
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#071.src: Hm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#071.dst: Hm? Was macht diese Wache hier? Wir sollten wohl mit ihr reden, wenn wir durchwollen.
King's Recruit#071.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#076.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#076.dst: Eine Gruppe Verderbter belagert diese Unterführung. Ohne Rüstung kann ich euch nicht hineinlassen.
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#077.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#077.dst: Was sollen wir dann tun? Wir müssen nach {p}!
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#078.dst: Seht ihr die Höhle da drüben? In solchen Höhlen findet man oft nützliche Beute, die euch am Leben halten kann.
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#079.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#079.dst: Wenn ihr in die Höhle geht, findet ihr sicher eine Rüstung zu eurem Schutz. Danach kommt zu mir zurück.
King's Recruit#079.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#080.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#080.dst: Was meinst du, {u}? Sehen wir nach, was in der Höhle ist.
King's Recruit#080.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#081.dst: Betritt die Höhle und finde eine Rüstung bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#082.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#082.dst: Betritt die Höhle und finde eine Rüstung bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#083.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#083.dst: Wir sollten zur Wache zurück und sehen, ob sie uns jetzt durchlässt!
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#084.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#084.dst: Ihr habt also eine Rüstung gefunden, was?
King's Recruit#084.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#085.src: So you found some armour, huh?
King's Recruit#085.dst: Ihr habt also eine Rüstung gefunden, was?
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#086.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#086.dst: Ja, einen Helm! Lasst Ihr uns jetzt durch?
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#087.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#087.dst: Moment, Rekrut. Bevor du eine Rüstung anlegen kannst, musst du sie erst identifizieren.
King's Recruit#087.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#088.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armour you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#088.dst: Moment, Rekrut. Bevor du eine Rüstung anlegen kannst, musst du sie erst identifizieren.
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#089.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#089.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#090.src: You can identify items at {#} Item Identifiers. They're found in towns across the whole world, but we have one here for recruits such as yourselves.
King's Recruit#090.dst: Gegenstände identifizierst du bei {#} Gegenstandsidentifizierern. Die gibt es in Städten auf der ganzen Welt, aber hier haben wir einen für Rekruten wie euch.
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#091.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#091.dst: Identifiziere deinen Helm beim Gegenstandsidentifizierer und komm dann mit angelegtem Helm zurück. Danach lasse ich dich durch.
King's Recruit#091.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#092.src: Identify your helmet at the {#} Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#092.dst: Identifiziere deinen Helm beim {#} Gegenstandsidentifizierer und komm dann mit angelegtem Helm zurück. Danach lasse ich dich durch.
King's Recruit#092.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#093.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#093.dst: Wie ich sehe, trägst du deinen Helm. Fantastisch, ihr dürft passieren. Ich öffne euch die Tür.
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#094.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this for you.
King's Recruit#094.dst: Wie ich sehe, trägst du deinen Helm. Fantastisch, ihr dürft passieren. Ich mache euch auf.
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#095.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#095.dst: Viel Glück da drin, Rekruten! Selbst mit Rüstung wird es nicht so leicht!
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#096.src: Good luck in there, recruits! Even with your new armour, it's not going to be so easy!
King's Recruit#096.dst: Viel Glück da drin, Rekruten! Selbst mit eurer neuen Rüstung wird es nicht so leicht!
King's Recruit#096.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#099.dst: Geh weiter durch die Unterführung bis [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#100.dst: Geh weiter durch die Unterführung bis [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#101.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#101.dst: Wow, die Wache hat nicht gescherzt. Hier wimmelt es von Verderbten.
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: That guard wasn't kidding. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#102.dst: Die Wache hat nicht gescherzt. Hier wimmelt es von Verderbten.
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#103.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#103.dst: Tja, uns bleibt nichts übrig, als uns durchzukämpfen! Endlich können wir die Waffen benutzen, die wir bekommen haben. Los, {u}.
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#104.src: Finally, time for us to use these weapons we got!
King's Recruit#104.dst: Endlich können wir unsere neuen Waffen benutzen!
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#105.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#105.dst: {u}, du übernimmst das Skelett vorne. Wir kümmern uns um die zwei Zombies hinten!
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#108.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#108.dst: Der Weg ist frei, gehen wir weiter durch die Unterführung.
King's Recruit#108.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#109.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#109.dst: Hier drüben! Ihr kommt wie gerufen!
King's Recruit#109.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#112.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#112.dst: Endlich Verstärkung! Moment mal... ihr kommt direkt aus Fruma, oder?
King's Recruit#112.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#113.src: Finally some backup! Wait a second... You're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#113.dst: Endlich Verstärkung! Moment mal... Ihr kommt direkt aus Fruma, oder?
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#114.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#114.dst: Na ja, das Gebiet sollte jetzt sicher sein. {p} liegt ja gleich da vorne.
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#115.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead after all.
King's Recruit#115.dst: Na ja, das Gebiet sollte jetzt sicher sein. {p} liegt ja gleich da vorne.
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#117.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#117.dst: Schnell, du musst eine Fähigkeit einsetzen!
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#118.src: Now cast your spell with your weapon!
King's Recruit#118.dst: Jetzt wirk deinen Zauber mit deiner Waffe!
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#120.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#120.dst: Moment, es haut ab! Wir müssen den Leutnant retten!
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#122.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.
King's Recruit#122.dst: Besiege den Goliath und befreie den Leutnant.

King's Recruit#123.src: ... That was close. Thanks for the save, recruits!
King's Recruit#123.dst: ... Das war knapp. Danke für die Rettung, Rekruten!
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#124.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#124.dst: Das war knapp... Danke für die Rettung, {u}!
King's Recruit#124.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#125.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#125.dst: Ich glaube, ihr drei werdet gute Soldaten - nicht viele schlagen sich so wie ihr gerade.
King's Recruit#125.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#126.src: I think you three are going to make fine soldiers, not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#126.dst: Ich glaube, ihr drei werdet gute Soldaten abgeben, nicht viele schlagen sich so wie ihr eben.
King's Recruit#126.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#127.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#127.dst: Die Bestie hat wohl etwas fallen lassen, schaut es euch an, bevor ihr nach {p} geht.
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#128.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should pick it up before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#128.dst: Die Bestie hat wohl etwas fallen lassen, du solltest es aufheben, bevor du nach {p} gehst.
King's Recruit#128.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#129.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
King's Recruit#129.dst: Heb die Beute auf, die der Goliath fallen gelassen hat.

King's Recruit#130.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#130.dst: Sieht selten aus! Vielleicht gibt's hier einen Identifizierer.
King's Recruit#130.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#131.dst: Auf nach {p}! Wir sind fast da.
King's Recruit#131.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#134.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#134.dst: Wir... wir haben's geschafft! Wirklich! Am Ende war's aber verdammt knapp.
King's Recruit#134.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#135.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#135.dst: ... Glaubst du noch immer, die Verderbten hätten gegen dich keine Chance?
King's Recruit#135.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#136.src: Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#136.dst: Glaubst du noch immer, die Verderbten hätten gegen dich keine Chance?
King's Recruit#136.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#137.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#137.dst: Haha. Sehr witzig. Ah, {u}, hier gibt es wohl einen Identifizierer für deinen seltenen Helm.
King's Recruit#137.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#138.src: Ha ha, very funny... Oh, {u}, there seems to be an  Item Identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#138.dst: Haha, sehr witzig... Oh, {u}, hier gibt es wohl einen  Gegenstandsidentifizierer für deinen seltenen Helm.
King's Recruit#138.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#139.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#139.dst: Und einen Schmied, da kannst du deinen alten Helm für ein paar Smaragde verkaufen.
King's Recruit#139.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#140.src: There's a blacksmith here too, you could sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#140.dst: Hier gibt's auch einen Schmied, da könntest du deinen alten Helm für ein paar Smaragde verkaufen.
King's Recruit#140.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#141.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#141.dst: Da ist es, das Ende unserer Reise.
King's Recruit#141.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#142.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#142.dst: Das Ende eines Abenteuers, aber der Anfang eines neuen! Gehen wir rein und sprechen mit dem König!
King's Recruit#142.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#143.dst: Sprich mit dem König von {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#144.dst: Sprich mit dem König von {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#145.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#145.dst: Willkommen in der Provinz Wynn! Eurem zerlumpten Aussehen nach war eure Reise hierher wohl ein ziemliches Abenteuer.
King's Recruit#145.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#146.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#146.dst: Dies, Rekruten, ist die edle Festung von {p}, eine der großen Städte unserer Provinz!
King's Recruit#146.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#147.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our vast province!
King's Recruit#147.dst: Dies, Rekruten, ist die edle Festung von {p}, eine der großen Städte unserer weiten Provinz!
King's Recruit#147.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#148.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#148.dst: Als Soldaten von Wynn müsst ihr die Flut verderbter Monster eindämmen, die dieses Land verwüsten.
