Point of No Return#040.src: Why would anyone choose to resist? The world is twisted, wrong... we do not belong there.
Point of No Return#040.dst: Warum sollte sich jemand wehren? Die Welt ist verdreht, falsch... wir gehören nicht dorthin.
Point of No Return#040.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#041.src: It is by the Bovine's grace that the Obelisk has seen fit to bless us with this sanctuary.
Point of No Return#041.dst: Durch die Gnade des Rindes hat der Obelisk uns diese Zuflucht geschenkt.
Point of No Return#041.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#042.src: There is no fault in giving in. It only wants to protect us. Is that so wrong?
Point of No Return#042.dst: Nachzugeben ist keine Schande. Er will uns nur beschützen. Ist das so falsch?
Point of No Return#042.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#043.src: Why would you ever want to leave?
Point of No Return#043.dst: Warum solltest du je gehen wollen?
Point of No Return#043.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#046.src: If you truly want to leave... no one here will stop you. But are you really willing to go through with it?
Point of No Return#046.dst: Wenn du wirklich gehen willst... hier hält dich niemand auf. Aber bist du wirklich bereit, das durchzuziehen?
Point of No Return#046.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#047.src: Talk to the {p} Citizen who sent you on this journey.
Point of No Return#047.dst: Sprich mit der Bürgerin von {p}, die dich auf die Reise schickte.

Point of No Return#048.src: Ha... I saw it there. That flicker in your eyes...
Point of No Return#048.dst: Ha... Ich habe es gesehen. Dieses Flackern in deinen Augen...
Point of No Return#048.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#049.src: You have been... shattered. Just like me, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#049.dst: Du bist... zerbrochen. Genau wie ich, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#049.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#050.src: The others... all have given in to its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#050.dst: Die anderen... haben alle seinem Sog nachgegeben. Wir Überlebenden... zurückgelassen, verlassen...
Point of No Return#050.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#051.src: I cannot blame them. Such a loss must seem a blessing, compared to life out here...
Point of No Return#051.dst: Ich verüble es ihnen nicht. Neben dem Leben hier draußen muss so ein Verlust wie ein Segen wirken...
Point of No Return#051.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#052.src: How long has it been, since we found ourselves trapped here...? Longer than anyone has any right to live... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#052.dst: Wie lange sind wir schon hier gefangen...? Länger, als irgendwer ein Recht hat zu leben... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#052.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#053.src: Perhaps I am already gone. More dead than alive. Hollowed out...
Point of No Return#053.dst: Vielleicht bin ich schon fort. Mehr tot als lebendig. Ausgehöhlt...
Point of No Return#053.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#054.src: All it does is take. More, and more, and more, until nothing is left... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#054.dst: Er nimmt nur. Mehr und mehr und mehr, bis nichts übrig ist... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#054.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#056.src: Your soul seems to be slipping away from reality...
Point of No Return#056.dst: Deine Seele scheint der Wirklichkeit zu entgleiten...

Point of No Return#057.src: Where does all of this lead?

Point of No Return#058.src: Your soul runs beneath your feet.
Point of No Return#058.dst: Deine Seele läuft unter deinen Füßen.

Point of No Return#060.src: Your soul drifts further from you. Will you ever get it back?
Point of No Return#060.dst: Deine Seele treibt weiter von dir fort. Bekommst du sie je zurück?

Point of No Return#061.src: Oh, how they tried to bury us...
Point of No Return#061.dst: Oh, wie sie versuchten, uns zu begraben...

Point of No Return#063.src: A distant thread, tying you to... something.
Point of No Return#063.dst: Ein ferner Faden, der dich an... etwas bindet.
Point of No Return#063.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#064.src: The platforms seem to disappear... You must swap with your soul quickly to make it to the end.
Point of No Return#064.dst: Die Plattformen scheinen zu verschwinden... Tausch schnell mit deiner Seele, um ans Ende zu gelangen.

Point of No Return#065.src: You must look at the mirror and wait for the platforms to appear on the other side before swapping sides...
Point of No Return#065.dst: Schau in den Spiegel und warte, bis die Plattformen auf der anderen Seite erscheinen, bevor du die Seite wechselst...

Point of No Return#069.src: You should try reproducing your soul's steps to find the exit...
Point of No Return#069.dst: Versuch, die Schritte deiner Seele nachzugehen, um den Ausgang zu finden...

Point of No Return#072.src: The floor's rising! You need to escape upwards!
Point of No Return#072.dst: Der Boden steigt! Du musst nach oben fliehen!

Point of No Return#073.src: The floor's rising! Don't let it get to you!
Point of No Return#073.dst: Der Boden steigt! Lass ihn nicht an dich ran!

Point of No Return#074.src: I am... you. {u}. {u}. You can hear me.
Point of No Return#074.dst: Ich bin... du. {u}. {u}. Du kannst mich hören.
Point of No Return#074.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#075.src: How long, now, has it been? Since they broke us in this way. Since you lost all that you were.
Point of No Return#075.dst: Wie lange ist es nun her? Seit sie uns so zerbrochen haben. Seit du alles verloren hast, was du warst.
Point of No Return#075.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#077.src: A trap. A snare. A devious thing, which claims to protect.
Point of No Return#077.dst: Eine Falle. Eine Schlinge. Ein tückisches Ding, das Schutz verspricht.
Point of No Return#077.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#078.src: The soul, the mind, kept safe. All while the body falls prey to the roots and the trees and the gaze of the taken.
Point of No Return#078.dst: Die Seele, der Geist, in Sicherheit. Während der Körper den Wurzeln, den Bäumen und dem Blick der Genommenen zum Opfer fällt.
Point of No Return#078.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#079.src: We have fallen, and we cannot climb free. Not whole, not anymore. Something must be lost.
Point of No Return#079.dst: Wir sind gefallen und können uns nicht freiklettern. Nicht ganz, nicht mehr. Etwas muss verloren gehen.
Point of No Return#079.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#080.src: And it cannot last. And it will not last.
Point of No Return#080.dst: Und es kann nicht andauern. Und es wird nicht andauern.
Point of No Return#080.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#082.src: Even through the struggle, the turmoil, the loss... despite it all, you remain.
Point of No Return#082.dst: Trotz des Kampfes, des Aufruhrs, des Verlusts... trotz allem bleibst du.
Point of No Return#082.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#083.src: Changed... but still, but still... yourself.
Point of No Return#083.dst: Verändert... aber doch, aber doch... du selbst.
Point of No Return#083.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#085.src: The world. The shadows. The crown.
Point of No Return#085.dst: Die Welt. Die Schatten. Die Krone.
Point of No Return#085.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#086.src: Was there meaning to it all? Was there purpose, reason?
Point of No Return#086.dst: Hatte das alles einen Sinn? Gab es einen Zweck, einen Grund?
Point of No Return#086.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#087.src: Was it desperation, fear? Or was it simple routine? We cannot know.
Point of No Return#087.dst: War es Verzweiflung, Angst? Oder bloße Gewohnheit? Wir können es nicht wissen.
Point of No Return#087.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#089.src: Though once, we were one... now we are split. Separate.
Point of No Return#089.dst: Einst waren wir eins... jetzt sind wir gespalten. Getrennt.
Point of No Return#089.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#090.src: But the trap does not see it that way. And, so... a chance to break free.
Point of No Return#090.dst: Doch die Falle sieht das nicht so. Und so... eine Chance, sich zu befreien.
Point of No Return#090.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#091.src: As one is ensnared, the other will have a moment, an opportunity.
Point of No Return#091.dst: Während der eine gefangen ist, hat der andere einen Moment, eine Gelegenheit.
Point of No Return#091.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#092.src: The snare will hold me here. And you can leave.
Point of No Return#092.dst: Die Schlinge wird mich hier festhalten. Und du kannst gehen.
Point of No Return#092.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#093.src: I will be lost once more... and you will leave.
Point of No Return#093.dst: Ich werde wieder verloren sein... und du wirst gehen.
Point of No Return#093.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#095.src: You will live. You have lived, already. In my absence, you have built yourself anew.
Point of No Return#095.dst: Du wirst leben. Du hast schon gelebt. In meiner Abwesenheit hast du dich neu erschaffen.
Point of No Return#095.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#096.src: Do not mourn me. I have long been lost to you already.
Point of No Return#096.dst: Trauere nicht um mich. Für dich bin ich längst verloren.
Point of No Return#096.speaker: Player?

Potion Making#000.src: Dr. Essren needs to be stopped!
Potion Making#000.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#001.src: I was...in support of this...but then, he accrued essence of...the corruption. I had to run away...
Potion Making#001.dst: Ich war...dafür...aber dann sammelte er Essenz der...Verderbnis. Ich musste fliehen...
Potion Making#001.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#002.src: Get me... [{~} Red Mushroom], they can be found outside the east gate behind me.
Potion Making#002.dst: Bring mir... [{~} Red Mushroom], die findest du vor dem Osttor hinter mir.
Potion Making#002.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#003.src: You must...ensure that it worked. You...are much stronger than I, stranger...
Potion Making#003.dst: Du musst...sicherstellen, dass es gewirkt hat. Du...bist viel stärker als ich, Fremder...
Potion Making#003.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#004.src: What have you done to this potion, human!? You will pay for it!
Potion Making#004.dst: Was hast du mit diesem Trank gemacht, Mensch!? Dafür wirst du bezahlen!
Potion Making#004.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#005.src: It's time to head back to The Assistant in {p} and show him the proof.
Potion Making#005.dst: Zeit, zum Assistenten in {p} zurückzukehren und ihm den Beweis zu zeigen.

Potion Making#006.src: Talk to The Assistant in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Potion Making#006.dst: Sprich mit dem Assistenten in {p} bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Potion Making#008.src: My master...wishes to create a very dangerous potion...a transformative elixir of invincibility...
Potion Making#008.dst: Mein Meister...will einen sehr gefährlichen Trank brauen...ein verwandelndes Elixier der Unbesiegbarkeit...
Potion Making#008.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#009.src: I fear...that he may be going...too far. I need your help...
Potion Making#009.dst: Ich fürchte...er geht...zu weit. Ich brauche deine Hilfe...
Potion Making#009.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#010.src: I want...to stop him...but I need you to...get me the necessary ingredients... to neutralize the potion...
Potion Making#010.dst: Ich will...ihn aufhalten...aber du musst mir...die nötigen Zutaten besorgen... um den Trank zu neutralisieren...
Potion Making#010.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#011.src: Slay Mooshrooms near [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Red Mushrooms] to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#011.dst: Töte Mooshrooms in der Nähe von [{~}, {~}, -{~}] und bring [{~} Red Mushrooms] zum Assistenten in {p}

Potion Making#012.src: Quickly, get me... [{~} Red Mushroom] as I asked... go through the {p} outside the east gate from here.
Potion Making#012.dst: Schnell, bring mir... [{~} Red Mushroom], wie ich sagte... geh vom Osttor aus durch {p}.
Potion Making#012.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#016.src: I'll... return to my master's house...and sneak the mushrooms into...his potion. Wait for me here...
Potion Making#016.dst: Ich... gehe zurück zum Haus meines Meisters...und schmuggle die Pilze in...seinen Trank. Warte hier auf mich...
Potion Making#016.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#017.src: I...have returned... He came back...just as I finished slipping the mushrooms in and...told me...to get out.
Potion Making#017.dst: Ich...bin zurück... Er kam heim...gerade als ich die Pilze hineingetan hatte, und...sagte mir...ich solle verschwinden.
Potion Making#017.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#018.src: Did you see the orange witch hat roofed hut when you were gathering the mushrooms?
Potion Making#018.dst: Hast du beim Pilzesammeln die Hütte mit dem orangen Hexenhutdach gesehen?
Potion Making#018.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#019.src: That is my master's house, you...must go back out the east gate and enter the hut.
Potion Making#019.dst: Das ist das Haus meines Meisters, du...musst wieder zum Osttor hinaus und die Hütte betreten.
Potion Making#019.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#020.src: You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....
Potion Making#020.dst: Du musst...sicherstellen...dass er nicht...unbesiegbar geworden ist... Tu, was getan werden muss....
Potion Making#020.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#021.src: Enter the hut at [{~}, {~}, -{~}], slay Essren, and take his coat
Potion Making#021.dst: Betritt die Hütte bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}], töte Essren und nimm seinen Mantel.

Potion Making#022.src: You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
Potion Making#022.dst: Geh wieder zum Osttor hinaus und betritt die Hütte, das ist das Haus meines Meisters.
Potion Making#022.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#023.src: Don't forget... Do what you must...
Potion Making#023.dst: Vergiss nicht... Tu, was du tun musst...
Potion Making#023.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#024.src: Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
Potion Making#024.dst: Ah, du musst der sein, von dem mein Assistent erzählt hat.
Potion Making#024.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#025.src: If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot-...
Potion Making#025.dst: Falls du mich aufhalten willst, ist es zu spät. Ich habe den Trank schon getr-...
Potion Making#025.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#026.src: What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b-
Potion Making#026.dst: Was ist das für ein Geschmack? Pilze? Das kann nicht s-
Potion Making#026.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#028.src: Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#028.dst: Bring Essrens staubigen Mantel zum Assistenten in {p}

Potion Making#030.src: Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
Potion Making#030.dst: Glaub nicht...alles, was man dir erzählt... Hätte der Meister...die Unbesiegbarkeit entdeckt... Nein...zu...gefährlich.
Potion Making#030.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#032.src: Now. I...do not want you saying anything about...these events. Take these, and...never speak of this again.
Potion Making#032.dst: Nun. Ich...will nicht, dass du irgendwem von...diesen Ereignissen erzählst. Nimm das hier, und...sprich nie wieder davon.
Potion Making#032.speaker: The Assistant

Purple and Blue#000.dst: Sprich mit Korun in der Nähe von {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#001.src: W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
Purple and Blue#001.dst: H-Hoppla, Kurznase! Was platzt du einfach in mein Zuhause?!
Purple and Blue#001.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#002.src: Did {p} send you? Well, welcome to {p}! I could actually make use of some assistance.
Purple and Blue#002.dst: Hat {p} dich geschickt? Na dann, willkommen in {p}! Ich könnte tatsächlich etwas Hilfe gebrauchen.
Purple and Blue#002.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#003.src: The magic here in this place is so potent; you can actually see the mystical properties!
Purple and Blue#003.dst: Die Magie hier ist so stark, dass man ihre mystischen Eigenschaften sogar sehen kann!
Purple and Blue#003.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#004.src: I've been a scientist for many years, but I have never seen anything like this lake.
Purple and Blue#004.dst: Ich bin seit vielen Jahren Wissenschaftler, aber so etwas wie diesen See habe ich noch nie gesehen.
Purple and Blue#004.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#005.src: That's why I set up a small laboratory and started living here to study the place. It's pretty rudimentary but it does the job done.
Purple and Blue#005.dst: Darum habe ich ein kleines Labor eingerichtet und wohne hier, um den Ort zu erforschen. Ziemlich behelfsmäßig, aber es erfüllt seinen Zweck.
Purple and Blue#005.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#006.src: The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is occurring in the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
Purple and Blue#006.dst: Je tiefer man in den See taucht, desto stärker wird die magische Kraft. Ich glaube, im Herzen des Sees geht etwas Seltsames vor. Dort drin liegen viele Antworten.
Purple and Blue#006.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#007.src: Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
Purple and Blue#007.dst: Gut, genug Hintergrund! Auf der anderen Seite des Sees wohnt noch ein... "Wissenschaftler". Wir sind so was wie Rivalen? Der Kerl ist furchtbar, ich hasse ihn, UND... Nun ja...
Purple and Blue#007.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#009.src: And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured something out about the lake.
Purple and Blue#009.dst: Und auch wenn ich halb hoffe, dass er in Schwierigkeiten steckt, hat er vielleicht etwas über den See herausgefunden.
Purple and Blue#009.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#010.src: There's a note here. You start reading it...
Purple and Blue#010.dst: Hier liegt ein Zettel. Du fängst an zu lesen...

Purple and Blue#011.src: IMPORTANT NOTES: The map to the talisman is in the basement!! That fool Korun will never see all this coming.
Purple and Blue#011.dst: WICHTIGE NOTIZEN: Die Karte zum Talisman ist im Keller!! Dieser Narr Korun wird das alles nie kommen sehen.

Purple and Blue#012.src: If everything goes right, it should grant access to the heart of the mountain... I can't wait!
Purple and Blue#012.dst: Wenn alles klappt, sollte er Zugang zum Herzen des Berges gewähren... Ich kann's kaum erwarten!

Purple and Blue#013.src: It looks like there are extra notes on the back. What should you do?
Purple and Blue#013.dst: Auf der Rückseite scheinen weitere Notizen zu stehen. Was willst du tun?

Purple and Blue#014.src: I needn't forget to input the total number of lit candles inside the house in order to get in the basement... That's why I made that tube! I'm so good at handling security!! No need for blasted overpriced Corkian equipment!
Purple and Blue#014.dst: Ich darf nicht vergessen, die Gesamtzahl der brennenden Kerzen im Haus einzugeben, um in den Keller zu kommen... Darum habe ich ja diese Röhre gebaut! Ich bin so gut in Sachen Sicherheit!! Kein Bedarf an verflixt überteuerter Corkian-Ausrüstung!

Purple and Blue#015.src: You read what's behind the note...
Purple and Blue#015.dst: Du liest, was auf der Rückseite steht...

Purple and Blue#016.src: I actually don't know if I'm making it out of this, but I absolutely have to find out what's inside the lake.
Purple and Blue#016.dst: Ehrlich gesagt weiß ich nicht, ob ich hier heil rauskomme, aber ich muss unbedingt herausfinden, was im See ist.

Purple and Blue#017.src: One part of me wants to bring Korun along. As much as we hate each other, it'd surely increase our chance of survival.
Purple and Blue#017.dst: Ein Teil von mir will Korun mitnehmen. So sehr wir uns hassen, es würde unsere Überlebenschancen sicher erhöhen.

Purple and Blue#018.src: And, who knows, maybe the heart of the mountain is actually perfectly safe?
Purple and Blue#018.dst: Und wer weiß, vielleicht ist das Herz des Berges ja völlig ungefährlich?

Purple and Blue#019.src: Though, I mustn't forget that three of the greatest minds of our time got lost to cosmic powers...
Purple and Blue#019.dst: Allerdings darf ich nicht vergessen, dass drei der größten Köpfe unserer Zeit kosmischen Mächten zum Opfer fielen...

Purple and Blue#020.src: No matter what, if you really want to join me, I left you enough clues.
Purple and Blue#020.dst: Jedenfalls: Willst du wirklich mitkommen, ich habe dir genug Hinweise hinterlassen.

Purple and Blue#023.src: This map seems to lead towards a particular location nearby...
Purple and Blue#023.dst: Diese Karte scheint zu einem bestimmten Ort in der Nähe zu führen...

Purple and Blue#024.src: Some mechanisms can be heard... There's probably another lever to press.
Purple and Blue#024.dst: Man hört Mechanismen... Vermutlich gibt es noch einen Hebel zu betätigen.

Purple and Blue#025.src: Upon touching the crystal, you notice a peculiar device...
Purple and Blue#025.dst: Als du den Kristall berührst, bemerkst du eine seltsame Vorrichtung...

Purple and Blue#026.dst: Er beginnt, seine Form zu verändern!

Purple and Blue#027.src: The crystal finished forming something, you should retrieve it.
Purple and Blue#027.dst: Der Kristall hat etwas geformt, du solltest es holen.

Purple and Blue#029.src: Looks like you can leave this place now.
Purple and Blue#029.dst: Sieht aus, als könntest du diesen Ort jetzt verlassen.

Purple and Blue#031.src: I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
Purple and Blue#031.dst: Ich vermute, er ist ins Herz des Sees vorgedrungen... Komm bitte kurz mit.
Purple and Blue#031.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#032.src: Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
Purple and Blue#032.dst: Gut, das hier führt unter Wasser zum Herzen. Wie wär's, wenn du versuchst hineinzugehen?
Purple and Blue#032.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#033.src: ...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
Purple and Blue#033.dst: ...wie ich dachte, du kommst genauso wenig rein wie ich. Wir brauchen mehr Informationen.
Purple and Blue#033.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#034.src: Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
Purple and Blue#034.dst: Mensch, untersuch Nikolers Haus für mich. Es liegt nördlich die Küste hinunter.
Purple and Blue#034.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#035.src: Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
Purple and Blue#035.dst: Wo kann er nur sein... Er kann unmöglich Zugang gefunden haben zu- He!
Purple and Blue#035.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#036.src: Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
Purple and Blue#036.dst: Hör mir nicht beim Murmeln zu! Hast du Nikoler gefunden?!
Purple and Blue#036.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#037.src: Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#037.dst: Durchsuche Nikolers Haus bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] nach Hinweisen.

Purple and Blue#038.src: Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.
Purple and Blue#038.dst: Folge den Hinweisen im Keller zur geheimnisvollen Höhle.

Purple and Blue#039.src: Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#039.dst: Betritt und erkunde die geheimnisvolle Höhle bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#040.src: Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#040.dst: Kehre zu Korun in sein Haus bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] zurück.

Purple and Blue#041.src: Y-you've actually found a lead?! There were clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
Purple and Blue#041.dst: D-du hast wirklich eine Spur gefunden?! In seinem Keller waren Hinweise? Und du hast einen... Talisman? Dann muss es das sein!
Purple and Blue#041.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#042.src: This might very well be the key to enter the heart, especially if it was as well-guarded with cosmic creatures as you say.
Purple and Blue#042.dst: Das könnte durchaus der Schlüssel zum Herzen sein, vor allem, wenn er so gut von kosmischen Kreaturen bewacht war, wie du sagst.
Purple and Blue#042.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#043.src: Alright then! This might be too dangerous for me, so I'm entrusting this task to you once more. Enter the tunnel in my basement, and explore as much as you can!
Purple and Blue#043.dst: Na dann! Das ist mir wohl zu gefährlich, also vertraue ich dir die Aufgabe noch einmal an. Geh durch den Tunnel in meinem Keller und erkunde so viel du kannst!
Purple and Blue#043.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#044.src: If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
Purple and Blue#044.dst: Wenn du mir irgendwelche Proben bringst, belohne ich dich großzügig. Aber falls du Nikoler lebend findest... Bring ihn bitte zurück.
Purple and Blue#044.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#045.src: As for the talisman, make sure you hold it whilst in the tunnel. Be careful, you're in uncharted territory from now on.
Purple and Blue#045.dst: Was den Talisman angeht, halte ihn im Tunnel unbedingt in der Hand. Sei vorsichtig, ab jetzt ist das unerforschtes Gebiet.
Purple and Blue#045.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#046.src: As Korun said, it's probably better to hold that talisman to traverse the tunnel...
Purple and Blue#046.dst: Wie Korun sagte, hältst du den Talisman besser in der Hand, um den Tunnel zu durchqueren...

Purple and Blue#047.src: Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
Purple and Blue#047.dst: Viel Glück, Mensch. Bring mir bitte Nikoler zurück oder jede Probe, die du findest.
Purple and Blue#047.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#048.src: Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.
Purple and Blue#048.dst: Betritt das Herz von Gylia von unter dem See aus.

Purple and Blue#050.src: The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!
Purple and Blue#050.dst: Der Bohrer sollte jetzt bereit sein... Gleich habe ich ganz allein das Herz des Berges erobert...!

Purple and Blue#051.src: A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
Purple and Blue#051.dst: Ein Mensch!? W...Was? Hast du meine Notizen für Korun gelesen? Das ist Diebstahl, damit du's weißt!! Ich - du...!
Purple and Blue#051.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#052.src: Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
Purple and Blue#052.dst: Komm nicht näher!! Ich zerstöre den Weg, wenn es sein muss!!
Purple and Blue#052.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#053.src: This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
Purple and Blue#053.dst: Das ist MEINE Geschichte! Wag es ja nicht, dich einzumischen!!
Purple and Blue#053.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#054.src: You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
Purple and Blue#054.dst: Du bist... hartnäckig. Willst du die Meteore stehlen, die ICH gefunden habe?! Weißt du, wie viel ich geforscht habe, um so weit zu kommen??
Purple and Blue#054.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#055.src: It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
Purple and Blue#055.dst: Zu spät! Ich habe schon ein Stück herausgebohrt. Sobald ich es Korun zeige, gelte ich als der bessere Forscher...
Purple and Blue#055.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#058.src: No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
Purple and Blue#058.dst: Nein nein nein nein nein nein! Das DARF nicht passieren!
Purple and Blue#058.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#059.src: Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
Purple and Blue#059.dst: Das Herumpfuschen an den Meteoren macht die Höhle wohl instabil! Ich... ich ahnte das schon, und trotzdem-
Purple and Blue#059.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#060.src: This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
Purple and Blue#060.dst: Das ist alles DEINE Schuld! Musstest du kommen und mich in Panik versetzen? Wir sind beide VERLOREN!
Purple and Blue#060.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#061.src: No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
Purple and Blue#061.dst: Nein... ich kann hier nicht sterben, nicht jetzt, was wird er denken...
Purple and Blue#061.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#062.src: I... We might still have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
Purple and Blue#062.dst: Ich... Vielleicht können wir noch entkommen... Und dann, Mensch, zeige ich dich bei den Behörden an!!
Purple and Blue#062.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#063.src: I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
Purple and Blue#063.dst: Ich STECKE FEST! Urgh... Nein... Nicht so, bitte, nicht so...
Purple and Blue#063.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#064.src: You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
Purple and Blue#064.dst: Du... Warum? Du bist meinetwegen gekommen? Nicht wegen der... Meteore?
Purple and Blue#064.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#065.src: I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
Purple and Blue#065.dst: Ich... Na gut. Lass uns abhauen, Mensch!
Purple and Blue#065.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#066.dst: Flieh aus dem Herzen von Gylia.

Purple and Blue#067.src: Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
Purple and Blue#067.dst: Mist! Das Dynamit ist nach hinten losgegangen! Schnell, lauf mit mir in die Trümmer, wir müssen uns beeilen!
Purple and Blue#067.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#069.src: Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you've explored the place thoroughly.
Purple and Blue#069.dst: Willkommen zurück! Du bist ja klatschnass! Wie lief's? Ich nehme an, du hast den Ort gründlich erkundet.
Purple and Blue#069.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#071.src: ...were you worrying about me? What a fool. This mountain could never do so much as scratch me!
Purple and Blue#071.dst: ...hast du dir Sorgen um mich gemacht? Was für ein Narr. Dieser Berg kann mir nicht mal einen Kratzer verpassen!
Purple and Blue#071.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#072.src: This human right here actually saved me, right after endangering me. You don't mean to tell me you sent them for me?
Purple and Blue#072.dst: Dieser Mensch hier hat mich gerettet, gleich nachdem er mich in Gefahr brachte. Du hast ihn doch nicht etwa meinetwegen geschickt?
Purple and Blue#072.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#073.src: Well, it's very simple. Where's the fun in our rivalry if you just go off and die somewhere?
Purple and Blue#073.dst: Nun, das ist ganz einfach. Wo bleibt der Spaß an unserer Rivalität, wenn du einfach irgendwo stirbst?
Purple and Blue#073.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#074.src: That aside, what did you find in there? What happened?
Purple and Blue#074.dst: Davon abgesehen, was hast du da drin gefunden? Was ist passiert?
Purple and Blue#074.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#075.src: I found them, Korun. I found the meteors! They still seemed potent somehow, but the cave collapsed and...
Purple and Blue#075.dst: Ich habe sie gefunden, Korun. Die Meteore! Sie wirkten noch irgendwie mächtig, aber die Höhle stürzte ein und...
Purple and Blue#075.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#076.src: That's... fine. We can always go back and try clearing the rubble. There's always opportunities to take a hold of. Next time, please don't just go off on your own!
Purple and Blue#076.dst: Das ist... schon gut. Wir können jederzeit zurück und versuchen, die Trümmer wegzuräumen. Chancen gibt es immer. Nächstes Mal geh bitte nicht einfach allein los!
Purple and Blue#076.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#077.src: Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems like the logical course of action now. Thank you.
Purple and Blue#077.dst: Mensch, du hast richtig entschieden... Ohne Nikoler wären unsere Mühen vergebens gewesen. Ich will mehr mit ihm zusammenarbeiten, das scheint jetzt das Vernünftigste. Danke.
Purple and Blue#077.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#079.src: I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
Purple and Blue#079.dst: Du bist ja klatschnass! Und du hast so eine seltsame Aura um dich... Was ist passiert?
Purple and Blue#079.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#080.src: You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
Purple and Blue#080.dst: Du... Du hast echt einen Meteorsplitter gefunden! Großartig! Das ist... das ist... ähm...
Purple and Blue#080.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#081.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
Purple and Blue#081.dst: Äh, was hast du g-gerade gesagt? Die Höhle stürzte ein und Nikoler ist t-tot...?
Purple and Blue#081.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#082.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#082.dst: Das ist, ähm, haha... Das kann nicht sein, er kann nicht sterben, nicht einfach so gehen, er kann nicht-
Purple and Blue#082.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#083.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
Purple and Blue#083.dst: T-Tut mir leid. Ich bin nur etwas geschockt. Danke jedenfalls für den Splitter...
Purple and Blue#083.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#084.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#084.dst: Z-zumindest hast du es durchgezogen... Das muss ich dir anrechnen... glaube ich.
Purple and Blue#084.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#085.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#085.dst: Nimm das einfach und geh. Ich habe viel nachzudenken.
Purple and Blue#085.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#086.src: You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
Purple and Blue#086.dst: Du hast gründlich gesucht und keinen Splitter gefunden? Nun, wir haben wohl noch viel zu entdecken.
Purple and Blue#086.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#087.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
Purple and Blue#087.dst: Äh, was hast du g-gerade gesagt? Die Höhle stürzte ein und Nikoler ist t-tot..?
Purple and Blue#087.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#088.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
Purple and Blue#088.dst: T-Tut mir leid. Ich bin nur etwas geschockt. Und du kommst mit leeren Händen zurück... Ein Verlust für alle Beteiligten.
Purple and Blue#088.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#089.src: I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
Purple and Blue#089.dst: Du bist ja klatschnass, also hast du den Ort wohl gründlich erkundet. Wie lief's?
Purple and Blue#089.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#090.src: You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
Purple and Blue#090.dst: Du hast... nichts gefunden? Echt? Und die Meteore waren zu instabil, um daran rumzupfuschen?
Purple and Blue#090.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#091.src: Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
Purple and Blue#091.dst: Moment, woher weißt du überhaupt was vom Rumpfuschen an den- warte...
Purple and Blue#091.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#092.src: Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
Purple and Blue#092.dst: Hast du ihn gefunden? Bitte... bitte sag mir, dass du ihn gefunden hast, er kann nicht einfach so gestorben sein. Ich...
Purple and Blue#092.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#093.src: W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
Purple and Blue#093.dst: W-was? Die ganze Höhle ist auf ihn EINGESTÜRZT? Und du konntest ihn nicht retten?! N-nein, du kannst nichts dafür, ich... tut mir leid.
Purple and Blue#093.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#094.src: This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
Purple and Blue#094.dst: Das ist alles viel zu viel für mich, aber du hast wohl erkundet und deinen Auftrag erfüllt.
Purple and Blue#094.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#095.src: Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
Purple and Blue#095.dst: Hier ist also deine Belohnung. Und jetzt lass mich bitte allein. Ich habe viel nachzudenken.
Purple and Blue#095.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#096.src: It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
Purple and Blue#096.dst: Du bist's! Schön, dass sich unsere Wege wieder kreuzen!
Purple and Blue#096.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#097.src: Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
Purple and Blue#097.dst: Seit dem Vorfall angle ich als Hobby.
Purple and Blue#097.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#098.src: Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
Purple and Blue#098.dst: Nimm das- meinetwegen kannst du's behalten!
Purple and Blue#098.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#099.dst: Danke... dass du mich gerettet hast.
Purple and Blue#099.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#100.src: Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
Purple and Blue#100.dst: Schau ab und zu für mich nach Korun, ja?
Purple and Blue#100.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#101.src: I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
Purple and Blue#101.dst: Ich mache noch Pause vom ganzen Wissenschaftskram... Aber er hat definitiv nicht das Letzte von mir gesehen!
Purple and Blue#101.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#102.src: After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
Purple and Blue#102.dst: Schließlich bin ich es, der ins Herz des Berges gelangt ist! Ich schlafe sogar ruhig, weil ich weiß, dass ich gewonnen habe...
Purple and Blue#102.speaker: Nikoler

Queen's Recruit#000.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.dst: Mel und Lanu, Ihr seid in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: Zimmer W{~}... Und jetzt geht. Ich habe noch viele Zimmer zu verteilen...
Queen's Recruit#001.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#004.src: I need to tell you s-

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: Tasim will sich in {p} bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] mit dir austauschen.

Queen's Recruit#006.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: {u}! He! Was für ein Glück, dass ich dich hier erwische.
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: Ist eine Weile her, oder? Wir müssen uns austauschen! Du hast sicher viele Abenteuer erlebt, oder?
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: But before that... I've got to just find...
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: Aber vorher... muss ich noch schnell jemanden finden...
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: Huh? What am I- oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: Hm? Was ich- ach ja. Ich suche Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: Er hat mir geschrieben, ob ich ihn auf eine... Erkundungsmission begleite. Aber ich konnte ihn nicht finden.
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#011.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#011.dst: Ich habe ja eine Weile hierher gebraucht... vielleicht ist er schon woanders. Aegis meinte, die Mission wurde am Ende abgeblasen, also...
Queen's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#012.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: Aber wenn er nicht hier ist, sollte ich wohl aufhören, ihn auf der Straße abzufangen, was? Ich hinterlasse ihm einfach eine Nachricht in der Kaserne.
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#013.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: Wir können in die Taverne und plaudern! Götter, ich hab die Drinks im Rusty Recruit vermisst... der Wirt sagt, die sind wie überall, aber das stimmt nicht! Niemand schenkt so ein wie er.
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#014.src: He... doesn't know about Aledar, does he?
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: Er... weiß nichts von Aledar, oder?

Queen's Recruit#015.src: He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: Er ist gerade erst zurück. Du kannst es ihm... jetzt nicht sagen. Später, wenn er angekommen ist.

Queen's Recruit#016.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: ...er weiß es nicht. Du musst es ihm beibringen.

Queen's Recruit#017.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#017.dst: Verzeihung, Entschuldigung- ich muss durch! Ich muss durch! Ah, ihr zwei! Genau euch suche ich.
Queen's Recruit#017.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: Verzeihung, Entschuldigung ich muss durch! Ich muss durch! Ah, ihr zwei! Genau euch suche ich.
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#020.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#020.dst: Na ja, vielleicht nicht ausgerechnet. Ich habe eine Liste von Leuten, die ich aufspüren soll, und ihr zwei steht drauf! Tasim und {u}, richtig?
Queen's Recruit#020.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#021.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: Ich habe eine wichtige Botschaft aus {p}. Direkt vom König persönlich, jawohl, jawohl!
Queen's Recruit#021.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#022.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: Wirklich? Ich glaube, ich habe ihn nicht mal gesehen, seit... was könnte er von uns wollen?
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I'm not privy to the details, I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned adventurers to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: Die Einzelheiten kenne ich leider nicht! Er ruft eine Reihe erfahrener Abenteurer wie euch zu einer Art Versammlung ins Schloss.
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#024.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: Jedenfalls muss ich noch mehr Leute finden, also gebe ich euch die Briefe und mache mich auf den Weg! Viel Glück, worum es auch geht!
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks till later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: Hm. Seltsam, oder? Die Drinks müssen wohl warten... vielleicht besser so. Vielleicht erwische ich ihn noch, bevor...
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: Oh, äh- geh du schon vor. Ich muss erst noch bei der Kaserne vorbei. Wir treffen uns dann in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#028.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: Wir treffen uns in {p}. Ich muss erst noch etwas in der Kaserne erledigen.
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#029.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#029.dst: Nimm an der Versammlung mit dem König in {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] teil.

Queen's Recruit#030.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: ...oh, da bist du ja. Bist du nicht vor mir losgegangen?
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#031.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: Ich kenne die meisten hier nicht, also bleibe ich erst mal bei dir.
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#032.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for-
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: ...und alles stürzt ein, klar? Also stoße ich den Zombie weg, schnapp mir das Kind und spring zum-
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#033.src: Wait, wait wait wait - you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: Warte, warte warte warte - willst du mir erzählen, da war 'n Kind dabei? Und du hast trotzdem die Bomben gezündet?!
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#034.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I-
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: Ja! Hab ich doch schon gesagt, oder? Das war ja der ganze Grund, warum ich-
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#035.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#035.dst: Ähem. Unterbrich die Geschichte mal kurz, Linton. Wir haben Gesellschaft.
Queen's Recruit#035.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#036.src: Well, if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: Na, wenn das nicht {u} ist! Schön, noch 'n bekanntes Gesicht hier zu sehn.
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#037.dst: Was, und ich bin nicht bekannt?
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#038.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#038.dst: Ich versuch eher, Abstand zu halten.
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#039.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: Ihr habt die Einberufung also auch bekommen? Der König hat viele Leute hergeholt. Interessant.
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#040.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: Haben wir, ja. Und es klang, als stünden noch viel mehr Leute auf ihrer Suchliste.
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: Oh, Verzeihung, ich hatte dich nicht bemerkt. Du bist ein Freund von {u}, nehme ich an?
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#042.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: Bin ich! Wir kamen mit derselben Karawane nach Wynn. Ich bin Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#044.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: Du bist also der, von dem Aledar ständig erzählt hat! Ich dachte, du wärst in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#045.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: Ich... war ich. Woher kennt ihr ihn alle?
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#046.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: Ich glaube, wir trafen uns bei einer Mission, die Kaserne von {p} einem verräterischen Kommandanten zu entreißen. Seither sind wir uns öfter begegnet.
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: Trotzdem schön, dich endlich kennenzulern'! Wir ham viele Geschichten gehört! Auch was davon, dass du nich' auf Briefe antwortest...?
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#048.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: Oh... richtig. Das haben wir, äh... geklärt.
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#049.src: But speaking of- have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#049.dst: Aber apropos- hat einer von euch ihn kürzlich gesehen?
Queen's Recruit#049.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#050.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#050.dst: Leider nich'. Ich glaub, wir sind uns nich' mehr begegnet seit... war's die Belagerung von {p}? Muss wohl.
Queen's Recruit#050.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#051.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: Ich hab ihn vor einem Monat in {p} gesehen! Ich fragte, woran er arbeitet und ob ich helfen kann, und er hat mich abgewimmelt. Komisch, oder?
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#052.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#052.dst: Mmn. Nein, das klingt nach ihm. Ich glaube, er hatte letztes Mal genug von deinen Faxen.
Queen's Recruit#052.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#053.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: Was?! Ich bin fähig. Komm schon, Mel, sag ihr, dass ich fähig bin.
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#054.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by-
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: Linton, du hast uns grad erzählt, wie du 'nen ganzen Tempel eingerissen hast, indem-
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#055.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: Okay! Okay, okay okay, reden wir über buchstäblich alles andere! Tasim, richtig? Was... äh...
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#056.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment- you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: ...also, dein... nein, nein, gib mir 'nen Moment- du warst... und... ähm... ach ja...
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: Linton!! So was kannst du doch nicht einfach fragen!!
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#061.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: Schön, dich kennenzulernen, Tasim. Ich freue mich auf die Zusammenarbeit bei dieser Mission.
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#062.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: ...gleichfalls. Es ist immer schön, Freunde von Aledar zu treffen.
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: Na sieh mal einer an! Ist 'ne ganze Weile her, seit wir zuletzt geredet haben. Kanalisation putzen ist jetzt unter deiner Würde, was?
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#064.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: Ich hab so einiges von deinen Taten gehört. Gute Arbeit, gute Arbeit.
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#065.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: Und... hm. Bist du nicht der, der ohne ein Wort nach Gavel abgehauen ist? Hätt nicht gedacht, dass man dich dafür ausgewählt hat.
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#066.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: Ich... auch nicht. Ehrlich gesagt wusste ich nicht mal, dass der König sich noch an mich erinnert.
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#067.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get- or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: Mmn. Na, egal warum, jetzt bist du hier. Wie du hergefunden hast, ist wohl egal. Wir brauchen jeden, den wir kriegen können- sagt jedenfalls Kymer.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#068.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: Sieh an, sieh an! Wenn mich meine Augen nicht täuschen! {u} und Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#069.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: Ich muss sagen, ich hätte nicht gedacht, dass man euch aufspürt! Bei eurem... ausgedehnten Aufenthalt in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#070.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: Dasselbe könnte ich von Euch sagen, Hauptmann. Hatte {p} nach dem Krieg keine Verwendung mehr für Euch?
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#071.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: Ah... nichts dergleichen. Wisst ihr, man schickte mich ursprünglich eher als Gesandten von {p} dorthin! Braucht der König eine diplomatische Lösung, wendet er sich zuerst an mich.
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've encountered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: Was... genau der Grund ist, warum ich hier bin. Man rief mich vor einigen Wochen recht abrupt zurück. Wir haben wohl eine knifflige Lage mit unserer... Nachbarprovinz.
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#073.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: Aber! Mehr sage ich nicht, bevor der König eintrifft. Er wird euch alles über das Problem erzählen, das wir hoffentlich lösen können.
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#074.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#075.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah- Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it- oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: Richten wir den Manafluss nach Wasser aus und schieben ihn etwas zur Seite, vielleicht... ah- Reynauld, gib mir meine Notizen über... verflixt, was war's- ach ja, die Erholungsphase! Die da.
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#076.dst: ...Die liegen schon links von Euch, Doktor.
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half- where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: Ach, wirklich! Scheint so... oh, aber das ist nur die erste Hälfte- wo habe ich den Rest gelassen...
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't-
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: Seufz... Ließet Ihr mich nur für Euch ordnen, müsstet Ihr vielleicht nicht-
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#079.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have-
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: Und mein vordefiniertes Ordnungssystem ruinieren?! Nein, Reynauld, es funktioniert bestens so, wie es ist, vielen Dank auch! Nun, wo könnte es-
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here- I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: Ah! Ihr zwei! Gut, gut, ihr seid da- ich fürchtete schon, Reynauld wäre hier der Einzige mit wiedererlangten Erinnerungen!
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#081.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: Was, Ihr habt es an niemandem sonst getestet, nachdem wir weg waren?
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#082.src: Test it on- no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: Es testen an- nein, natürlich nicht! Nach dem, was ich gesehen habe? Nein, nein, das war das Risiko nicht wert. Keine neuen Versuchspersonen, bis ich sicher bin, dass es fehlerlos ist!
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#083.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you- the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#083.dst: Stattdessen habe ich es an mir selbst angewandt! Und ich sage euch- welche Durchbrüche ich erzielt habe... es gibt so viel zu lernen.
Queen's Recruit#083.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#085.src: Pah! "Safety" - a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects - certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: Pah! "Sicherheit" - ein leerer Begriff, nur erfunden, um den Fortschritt zu ersticken. Gab es Nebenwirkungen - gewiss! Aber es hat sich alles gelohnt.
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#086.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#086.dst: Nun muss ich zurück zu meinen Seiten... Ich muss ein paar Gleichungen perfektionieren, bevor der König eintrifft...
Queen's Recruit#086.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#087.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#087.dst: Hm. Ich hätte nicht gedacht, dich hier zu sehen, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#088.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: Nun... das Schicksal hat wohl andere Pläne. Und du? Bist du in {p} geblieben?
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#089.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: Meistens. War für ein paar Einsätze hier und da unterwegs, aber kam immer wieder zurück.
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#090.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: ...wir haben lange nicht geredet. Geht es dir... gut? Wie kommst du mit den Erinnerungen zurecht?
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#091.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: So gut, wie man es erwarten kann, schätze ich. Die ersten Monate waren hart. Irgendwann hab ich mich daran gewöhnt.
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#092.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#092.dst: Und du? Ich hätte auch nicht gedacht, dass du bei so einer Mission auftauchst.
Queen's Recruit#092.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#093.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#093.dst: Wie bei dir. Hat geholfen, dass Caid und ich darüber reden konnten. Wir treffen uns ab und zu und reden. Er erzählt von seiner Schwester, dass er sie eines Tages finden will.
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#094.dst: Das ist... gut. Freut mich für dich.
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#095.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#095.dst: Hm. Nichts hält dich davon ab, auch mal vorbeizuschauen. Es könnte dir sogar helfen.
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#096.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: Ich... denk drüber nach. Schön, dich wiederzusehen, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#097.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: Noch ein Soldat? Zeigt mir Eure Einberufung.
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#098.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: ...gut. Tretet ein, {u}. Der König trifft in Kürze ein.
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#100.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#100.dst: Wenn Ihr darauf besteht. Lasst Euch nicht zu viel Zeit.
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#101.dst: Ah... da wären wir. Ich danke euch allen, dass ihr so kurzfristig gekommen seid. Viele von euch habe ich lange nicht gesehen.
Queen's Recruit#101.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#102.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#102.dst: ...Ich komme gleich zur Sache. Was unsere Beziehungen zur Nachbarprovinz Fruma angeht, befinden wir uns in einer sehr heiklen Lage.
Queen's Recruit#102.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: Gut. Dann sind wir schon zwei.

Queen's Recruit#106.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: Das klingt sehr verdächtig. Warum das plötzliche Interesse? Warum jetzt?

Queen's Recruit#107.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once before have they chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: Wir sind stark auf den Strom neuer Rekruten angewiesen, die man uns schickt, aber wir können ihre Provinz nicht erreichen. Nur sie können sich an uns wenden, und bisher taten sie das nur ein einziges Mal.
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#108.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: ...vor einigen Wochen empfingen wir eine verhüllte Besucherin am Stadtrand. Sie gab sich als eine der Herrscherinnen Frumas aus.
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#109.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: Man sprach uns eine Art Einladung aus. Von allen Rekruten, die wir je erhielten, sollten wir die Besten auswählen und sie zu einer Art Feier nach Fruma schicken.
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#110.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: Das sind wir also? Die Besten?
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#111.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove-
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: Zumindest die, die erreichbar waren! Vielleicht gab es noch Bessere, aber wir alle kennen die Wanderlust eurer Sorte, und sie aufzuspüren kann sich wirklich als-
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#112.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: Ugh, wir spielen da doch nicht einfach mit, oder?
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#113.dst: Linton! Du kannst doch nicht einfach-
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#114.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: Was? Die verlangen was Seltsames und offensichtlich Verdächtiges, warum sollten wir das einfach hinnehmen?
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#115.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: Ich fürchte, wir haben keine Wahl. Wie gesagt, die Rekruten, die wir erhalten, sind entscheidend für das Fortbestehen unserer Provinz. Würden wir diese Einladung ablehnen...
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#116.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: ...wer weiß, ob die dann nich' einfach aufhör'n, welche zu schicken, hm? Übel.
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: Abgesehen davon, denkt an die Gelegenheit! Ein echter, freiwillig gewährter Blick hinter diese Mauern! Wir wären Narren, sie auszuschlagen, ganz gleich, welche Drohung mitschwingt!
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#118.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: In der Tat. Ich bedaure, dies von euch verlangen zu müssen... aber es gibt keine andere Wahl. Ihr müsst diese Einladung annehmen.
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#119.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: ...selbst die unter uns, die schlechte Erfahrungen mit dieser Provinz haben?
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#120.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: Es tut mir leid... aber du musst. Mir sind die Hände gebunden.
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#121.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: Ich nehme an, man erwartet von uns, dass wir dort so viele Informationen über Fruma sammeln wie möglich?
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#122.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: So lautet der Plan, in der Tat! Mehr erkläre ich, sobald wir dort sind, aber wir haben wohl ein Zeitlimit, richtig?
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#123.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: Das ist der Plan, in der Tat! Mehr erkläre ich, sobald wir dort sind, aber wir haben wohl ein Zeitlimit, richtig?
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#124.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: Richtig, Doktor. Man sagte mir, ein Vertreter werde euch alle an den königlichen Toren Frumas an der Westküste empfangen.
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#125.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: Ich habe einen Boten nach {p} vorausgeschickt, um die Kapitäne dort über euer Ziel zu unterrichten.
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#126.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: {p}... Ich kenne dort einen Kapitän. {u}, kommst du mit?
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#127.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: Endlich... ein Blick in das Innenleben der Provinz... wie lange suche ich schon nach diesen Antworten?
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#128.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: So viele Theorien... wie viele werden sich bestätigen? Wie viele sind falsch? Ich kann es kaum erwarten!
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#129.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: Seufz... Ich wusste, dass das kommt. Warum sonst hätte man den Doktor einberufen? Aber ich hoffte, mich zu irren.
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#130.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: Schwierige Lage, was? Viel Geheimniskrämerei vonseiten der Frumaner...
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#131.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: Aber wir kriegen das hin. Hier sind schließlich alle mehr als fähig.
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#132.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: Hm... was für eine Lage, in der wir uns befinden! Diplomatie ist natürlich mein Fach, aber auf... das hier hat mich meine Erfahrung nicht vorbereitet.
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#133.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford not to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: Fruma weiß, was es will, und weiß, dass es stark genug ist, um nicht von seiner Position abrücken zu müssen.
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: Schon wieder eine streng geheime Mission? Und ich darf nicht mal meinen Sprengstoff mitnehmen?
Queen's Recruit#134.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#135.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: Immerhin ist es interessant! Viel besser als der letzte Auftrag...
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#136.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lots o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: Die Mission is' 'ne große Sache, was? Ham jedenfalls viele starke Leute dafür zurückgeholt.
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#137.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: Macht mich ehrlich gesagt 'n bisschen nervös!
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#138.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: Fruma... ich kann nicht behaupten, viel daran gedacht zu haben. Ein Rätsel, ja, aber eins ohne greifbare Antworten.
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#139.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: Nun, bis jetzt, nehme ich an. Ich muss eine Liste mit Details vorbereiten, auf die ich achten will...
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#140.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: Und wieder einmal muss ich euch alle in Gefahr schicken... diesmal eine andere Art, aber dennoch Gefahr.
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#141.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: Ich erinnere mich an jedes Gesicht in meinem Schloss. Kaum eines sehe ich je wieder.
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#142.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: Doch diesmal... vertraue ich darauf, dass wir uns wiedersehen. Geh, junger Held. Deine Mission liegt vor dir.
Queen's Recruit#142.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#143.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#143.dst: ...zurück nach Fruma. Ich bin gerade erst nach Wynn zurückgekehrt, und jetzt...
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#144.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: Aber irgendwann musste es ja passieren. Und ich will Antworten. Also... auf geht's.
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#145.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: Ich gehe zum Seaskipper von {p}, falls du mitkommen willst.
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: Reise zum Tor von Fruma bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder triff Tasim in {p}.

Queen's Recruit#147.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#147.dst: ...Oh! Du bist da! Tut mir leid, war in Gedanken.
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#148.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#148.dst: Das ist alles etwas unwirklich, oder? Ich bin gerade erst zurück in Wynn, und jetzt... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#148.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#149.src: Kind of makes me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#149.dst: Fast wünschte ich, Aledar wäre auch hier. Wir drei wieder auf Abenteuer! Zurück... nach Hause...
Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#150.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#150.dst: Wir müssen ihm wohl alles erzählen, wenn wir zurück sind. Er wird sich ärgern, dass er's verpasst hat, wetten?
Queen's Recruit#150.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#152.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#152.dst: Ahoi! Sind das etwa meine zwei Lieblingskunden?
Queen's Recruit#152.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#153.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#153.dst: Ihr nennt jeden Euren Lieblingskunden, Kapitän! Glaubt nicht, das sei mir nicht aufgefallen!
Queen's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#154.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#154.dst: Hehehehe, na, stimmt doch, oder? Ich hab viele Lieblinge! Ah, wie dem auch sei, ihr wollt 'ne Überfahrt, nich' wahr?
Queen's Recruit#154.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#155.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#155.dst: Genau! Ihr habt... wohl schon von den Einzelheiten gehört? Da müsste etwas über ein neues Ziel gewesen sein.
Queen's Recruit#155.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#156.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#156.dst: Jawoll. Hab ich. So 'n schmächtiger Bote aus {p} ist vorhin vorbeigesaust! Kaum hatt' ich 'n Wort raus, war er schon wieder weg! Echt interessanter Kerl.
Queen's Recruit#156.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#157.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#157.dst: ... Kein Teil der See, den ich gern besuche, aber ich schätze, diesmal kann ich 'ne Ausnahme machen.
Queen's Recruit#157.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#158.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#158.dst: Hm... Ich kann Euch für die Fahrt extra bezahlen, wenn Ihr wollt.
Queen's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#159.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#159.dst: Ha! Nein, nein, das braucht's nicht. Für meine zwei Lieblingskunden ist's umsonst, hehe!
Queen's Recruit#159.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#160.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop aboard 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#160.dst: ...und natürlich zahlt eh alles die königliche Schatzkammer von {p}. Jetzt hüpft an Bord, eh ich's mir anders überleg und ohne euch ablege!
Queen's Recruit#160.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#162.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#162.dst: ...also, Fruma, was? Ich würd ja fragen, was ihr da zu schaffen habt, aber... ist wohl streng geheim.
Queen's Recruit#162.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#163.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: Wir wurden... in die Provinz eingeladen. Angeblich zu einer Art Feier, aber...
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#164.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: Mmn. Jo, wenn man die Gerüchte kennt... nicht grad 'n Ort, der einfach Leute einlädt, was?
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Seaskipper Captain
