Queen's Recruit#166.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#166.dst: Sagt mal, was geht euch denn durch den Kopf? Euch beiden. Gedanken auszusprechen macht sie leichter, meiner Erfahrung nach.
Queen's Recruit#166.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#167.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#167.dst: Fruma hat sich solche Mühe gemacht, unsere Erinnerungen zu löschen, uns loszuwerden... nur um uns jetzt aus heiterem Himmel zurückzuholen.
Queen's Recruit#167.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#168.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: Ich weiß nicht, warum sie das tun, aber ich fürchte, da steckt mehr dahinter.
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#169.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: Ich hab auch nicht mehr Ahnung als ihr, aber ich schätze, das Misstrauen ist berechtigt.
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#170.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#170.dst: Aber lass dich nicht davon auffressen, ja? Etwas Misstrauen ist gesund, aber färbt's alles, was du tust, schadet's dir genauso wie Naivität. Bleib offen.
Queen's Recruit#170.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#171.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: ...das ist möglich. Ich hoffe, Ihr habt recht und alles ist gut und wir denken alle zu viel nach...
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#172.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: Aber ich darf nicht unvorsichtig werden. Alles an dieser Lage schreit, dass etwas nicht stimmt, und... ich weiß nicht, was.
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#173.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: Nichts falsch daran, aufs Beste zu hoffen. Positiv bleiben ist manchmal alles, was man tun kann.
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#174.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#174.dst: Hier draußen auf See haben wir ein Sprichwort... such den Sturm, und er findet dich von selbst. Erwarte nicht das Schlimmste, sonst findet's 'nen Weg, einzutreffen.
Queen's Recruit#174.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#175.dst: Ich freue mich auf die Heimat.

Queen's Recruit#176.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: ...Heimat? Heimat. Wohl schon. Wird schön sein, mehr Erinnerungen daran zu haben als nur... du weißt schon. Flüche und so.
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#177.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: Linton und Kymer sind in W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Representative

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#178.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: Hm. Ich hab auch nicht viel Heimat, wohin ich zurück könnte. Die haben sie mir genommen, denen ich vertraut hab, hehe!
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#179.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: ... Aber ich hab mir hier auf See 'ne eigene Heimat gebaut. Selbst wenn ich zurück könnte, ich würd's nicht!
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: Also, wenn dir nicht gefällt, was du findest... musst du's nicht nehmen, hörst du?
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#181.dst: ...Ich werde es mir merken. Danke, Kapitän.
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and sailin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: Ah, dafür bin ich doch da, oder? Weise Ratschläge geben und Leute über die See schippern!
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#183.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: Und schaut mal, am Horizont! Glänzende, prächtige Docks... sieht aus, als wär'n wir da.
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: Weiß nicht, was euch da drin erwartet... aber trotzdem viel Glück, ja?
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: Das werden wir brauchen. Danke, dass Ihr uns hergebracht habt, Kapitän.
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#186.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#186.dst: Das ist... beeindruckend. So etwas für ein Tor zu bauen, das nie jemand benutzt...
Queen's Recruit#186.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#187.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: Sie haben wohl Mittel im Überfluss.
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#188.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#188.dst: Triff die Gruppe am Tor bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#189.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: Endlich! Die Nachzügler sind da. Ihr habt euch ja reichlich Zeit gelassen, was?
Queen's Recruit#189.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#190.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#190.dst: Nicht jetzt, Kymer. Lass den armen Kerl mal 'ne Stunde in Ruhe, ja? Wir ham größere Sorgen und so.
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#191.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#191.dst: Ja, ja, schon gut. Aus keinem dieser Soldaten haben wir ein Wort herausbekommen! Sind wir überhaupt zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort?
Queen's Recruit#191.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#192.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: Ach was, du hast's nur nicht richtig versucht. He, Blechbüchse! Das hier ist Fruma, oder?
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#193.dst: Wow. Vergiss es, du hattest recht.
Queen's Recruit#193.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#195.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#195.dst: Wirklich ein beeindruckender Bau, nicht wahr? All das für eine abgeschottete Provinz.
Queen's Recruit#195.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#196.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#196.dst: Beeindruckend oder nicht, wir haben zu tun! Seid alle auf der Hut. Wir wissen nicht, was uns erwartet, also passt auf euch auf.
Queen's Recruit#196.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#197.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#197.dst: Weiß der Geier, wann die uns wirklich reinlassen...
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#200.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#200.dst: Soldaten von Wynn! Ihre Majestät heißt euch als Gäste der Krone in der Provinz willkommen!
Queen's Recruit#200.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#201.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting- you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#201.dst: Folgt mir, man wird euch zum königlichen Palast geleiten. Lassen wir sie nicht warten- ihr alle seid von großer Bedeutung für sie.
Queen's Recruit#201.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#202.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.
Queen's Recruit#202.dst: Hör dir die Vorstellung an. Geh zu [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], um zum Palast zurückzukehren.

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: Fruma ist... viel größer, als ich es in meinen Erinnerungen sah...
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#204.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#204.dst: Ergibt wohl Sinn. Ich bin damals vermutlich nicht viel gereist. Aber... trotzdem.
Queen's Recruit#204.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#206.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#206.dst: Das... war es. Ich weiß nicht, was ich erwartet hatte, aber... es war atemberaubend.
Queen's Recruit#206.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#208.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#208.dst: Ha! Ja, weißt du, ich glaube, du hast recht. Es war beeindruckend, aber Gavel hat auch beeindruckende Anblicke.
Queen's Recruit#208.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#209.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: Aber lassen wir uns nicht ablenken. Die Rundfahrt wirkte sehr... kontrolliert. Wir durften nie aus den Kutschen, und der Herrscher hatte uns stets im Blick.
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#210.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#210.dst: Mich interessiert, was sie uns bewusst nicht zeigen...
Queen's Recruit#210.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#213.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#213.dst: Es ist mir als Königin eine Ehre, eure Rückkehr in unsere wundervolle Provinz zu ermöglichen. Wie lange ihr auch fort wart, ihr bleibt stets Kinder Frumas!
Queen's Recruit#213.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#214.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#214.dst: Euer Kampf gegen die Fäulnis jenseits unserer Mauern war von großem Interesse. Ihr habt unsere Provinz gewiss stolz gemacht.
Queen's Recruit#214.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#215.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed- but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: Ihr habt sicher Fragen zum Grund eurer Einberufung. Alles wird sich offenbaren- doch erst erlaubt mir, euch zwei meiner wundervollen Herrscher vorzustellen.
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#216.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am-
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: Ihr habt meinen Namen gehört, aber lasst mich mich vorstellen. Ich bin-
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#217.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#217.dst: Majin aus dem Hause Thalas, der Morgenstern, Herrscher unseres schönen {p}. Eine Freude, liebe Soldaten, unsere Königin bei dieser Zeremonie zu begleiten!
Queen's Recruit#217.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#218.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Herrscher von {p}. Der Wert dieses Titels spricht für sich.
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: Danke, Herrscher. Diese beiden und die übrigen sind mein Rat bei der Regierung unserer Provinz. Jeder Herrscher verwaltet einen eigenen Bezirk und dient dem Volk dort.
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#220.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#220.dst: Es gibt noch weitere. Doch keiner konnte dieser Veranstaltung beiwohnen - sie sind mit verschiedenen Aufgaben beschäftigt.
Queen's Recruit#220.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#221.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: Ah, da hätten wir's. Tasim und {u}, Ihr seid in Zimmer W{~}... im Westflügel.
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#222.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#222.dst: Weil ich schnell und leise bin. Muss jetzt los, will die Wachen nicht auf mich aufmerksam machen. Denkt dran, Zimmer W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#222.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#224.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: Es gibt noch andere. Doch keiner konnte dieser Veranstaltung beiwohnen - sie sind mit verschiedenen Aufgaben beschäftigt.
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: Genug des langweiligen Geredes! Zeit für das Willkommensfest!
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: Wir möchten euch einen Vorgeschmack auf das geben, was unsere Provinz zu bieten hat. Begebt euch bitte in den großen Speisesaal direkt hinter mir.
Queen's Recruit#226.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#227.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#228.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: Begebt Euch in den Speisesaal, die Königin beginnt gleich ihre Rede.
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#229.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha-
Queen's Recruit#229.dst: ...du kannst nicht mal Punkt vor Strich einhalten, während Ihre Majestät zusieht?! Welchen Erwartungswert sollen die Rekruten ha-
Queen's Recruit#229.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#230.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#230.dst: Na, na, Nasin, beruhige dich. Wir wollen doch keinen schlechten Eindruck bei unserem Gast hinterlassen, oder?
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#231.dst: Hör auf, meine Folge zu unterbrechen, Heuchl-
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#232.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: Oh, du. Du solltest dich mit dem Rest deiner Gruppe im Speisesaal melden.
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: Ja, ja, weiter geht's. Du willst Ihre Majestät doch sicher nicht warten lassen!
Queen's Recruit#233.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#234.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: Nun, ich habe es lange genug aufgeschoben. Bevor der erste Gang serviert wird, enthülle ich, warum ihr heute hier seid.
Queen's Recruit#234.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#235.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#235.dst: Zur Feier eurer Arbeit in der Provinz Wynn veranstalten wir ein Turnier! Ihr alle tretet in einer Reihe von Duellen an, um den größten Soldaten unter euch zu krönen.
Queen's Recruit#235.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#236.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: Ihr alle seid in eurer Zeit jenseits unserer Mauern gewachsen, und wie ließe sich das besser zeigen?
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: Selbstverständlich werden alle Teilnehmer entschädigt. Jeder von euch erhält eine großzügige Geldbelohnung, ganz gleich, welchen Platz er im Turnier belegt.
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: Wer von euch jedoch als Sieger gekrönt wird... den erwartet eine größere Belohnung. Die Einzelheiten werden nach Abschluss des Turniers enthüllt.
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#239.src: Ah, your majesty- if I may... I am not much of a fighter - my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#239.dst: Ah, Eure Majestät- wenn ich darf... Ich bin kein großer Kämpfer - mein Fach ist die Erforschung und das Studium der Magie.
Queen's Recruit#239.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#240.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: ...nun gut. Man wird Vorkehrungen treffen. Im Gegenzug könnte man später etwas anderes von dir verlangen.
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#241.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: Ich danke Euch für Eure Gnade und Euer Verständnis, Eure Majestät.
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: Ja... nun. Sobald das Mahl beendet ist, wird jedem von euch ein Zimmer für den Rest eures Aufenthalts in meinem Palast zugewiesen.
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#243.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#243.dst: Ah! Der erste Gang scheint bereit zu sein! Bitte genießt die feinste Küche unserer Provinz.
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#244.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#244.dst: ...damit hatte ich nun wirklich nicht gerechnet.
Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#245.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#245.dst: Du machst beim Turnier mit, oder?
Queen's Recruit#245.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#246.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms- everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: Wir sollten los und unsere Zimmer suchen- alle anderen sind nach Süden gegangen.
Queen's Recruit#246.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#247.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#247.dst: Hol dir beim Vertreter bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}] dein zugewiesenes Zimmer.

Queen's Recruit#249.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: Eure Zimmer befinden sich östlich und westlich von hier.
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#250.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: Eure Zimmer sind auf der anderen Seite des Schlosses. Bitte begebt Euch dorthin.
Queen's Recruit#250.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#255.dst: Was für ein schickes Festmahl, was?
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#256.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: Die fahren wirklich alles auf, was? Glaub, ich hatt' ewig nix so Gutes mehr.
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#257.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: Ja, das war wohl das beste Essen seit Langem... Hat mich echt müde gemacht. Ich freu mich auf eine lange, gute Ruhe.
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#258.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.dst: Und wir? Ich bin Mel, und das is' Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#260.src: Uh- hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#260.dst: Äh- he, ich glaub, Ihr habt wen vergessen! Wo komm ich unter?
Queen's Recruit#260.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#263.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#263.dst: Oh... äh, Kymer, hm? Das ist... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#263.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#265.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#265.dst: Geh in dein Zimmer W-{~} und sieh es dir an.

Queen's Recruit#266.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#266.dst: Ich wart hier einfach auf Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#266.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#267.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#267.dst: Hm... {u}? Ich glaub, du bist im falschen Zimmer!
Queen's Recruit#267.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#268.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#268.dst: Komisch, dass ich 'n Zimmer ganz für mich hab... aber na ja, ich beschwer mich nicht.
Queen's Recruit#268.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#269.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: Kymer. Klar! Cool, cool cool cool... Ich kann mit dem... dicken Bizeps wohnen... jep. Das ist... okay. Das ist okay. Sogar gut.
Queen's Recruit#269.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#271.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#271.dst: Ganz gemütlich, schätze ich... schwer, sich zu entspannen, bei... du weißt schon. dem Ganzen.
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#272.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#272.dst: ...in Fruma zu sein ist leichter als gedacht. Es ist genug Abstand zu... den, äh, Erinnerungen.
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#273.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So... what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited just for this?
Queen's Recruit#273.dst: Aber gut, jetzt sind wir unter uns. Also... was hältst du wirklich vom Turnier? Seltsam, oder? Warum lädt man uns nur dafür ein?
Queen's Recruit#273.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#274.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#274.dst: Ich auch nicht. Ich weiß nicht, was ich in Fruma erwartet hatte, aber nicht... das hier.
Queen's Recruit#274.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#275.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#275.dst: Ich glaube, wir müssen teilnehmen, aber die Augen offen halten. Vielleicht liefert die geheime Belohnung Antworten..
Queen's Recruit#275.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#276.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: Hm... du hast wohl recht, ich weiß nur nicht, was es sein könnte.
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#277.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#277.dst: Vielleicht steckt was hinter der geheimen Belohnung für den Sieger... wir müssen wohl abwarten.
Queen's Recruit#277.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#278.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#278.dst: Ha! Ja, schon gut. Ich bin auch ein bisschen aufgeregt. Ich hatte lange keine Freundschaftsduelle mehr, vielleicht tut es gut, meine Kräfte zu messen.
Queen's Recruit#278.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#279.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: Aber vergiss nicht, warum wir hier sind. Bleib auf der Hut. Irgendwas an dieser Belohnung, die sie erwähnte... macht mich unruhig.
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#280.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: Das ist genau die Art Sache, die Aledar gefallen würde. Wie könnte er sich besser beweisen, als dieses große Turnier zu gewinnen?
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#281.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#281.dst: Er könnte auch all seine Tränke und Tricks einsetzen! Er erzählt mir ständig von den grauenhaften Mixturen, die er zusammengebraut hat.
Queen's Recruit#281.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#283.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: Aber gut, jetzt sind wir unter uns. Also.. was hältst du wirklich vom Turnier? Seltsam, oder? Warum lädt man uns dafür ein?
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#284.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#284.dst: Ha! Ja, schon gut. Ich bin auch ein bisschen aufgeregt. Ich hatte lange keine Freundschaftsduelle mehr, vielleicht tut's gut, meine Kräfte zu messen.
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#288.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room- that's W{~}, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#288.dst: Oh, äh, nichts Besonderes. Nur ein geheimes Treffen. In Jenprests Zimmer- das ist W{~}, am Anfang des Flurs.
Queen's Recruit#288.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#289.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: Picard sagt, wir sollen besprechen, was wir bisher haben. Und wir sollen nicht alle gleichzeitig kommen, also wartet ein paar Minuten, bevor ihr vorbeischaut!
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#290.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room- so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: Picard sagt, wir sollen besprechen, was wir bisher haben. Und wir sollen nicht alle gleichzeitig kommen- also wartet ein paar Minuten, bevor ihr vorbeischaut!
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#291.src: I... guess that makes sense. But why are you here, and not-
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: Das... ergibt wohl Sinn. Aber warum bist du hier und nicht-
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
Queen's Recruit#292.dst: ...ganz schön energiegeladen, was. Gut, gehen wir zum Treffen. Mal sehen, was den anderen aufgefallen ist.
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: Triff die anderen in Zimmer W-{~} bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: Ah, gut, da sind sie. Kommt rein, kommt rein. Schnell jetzt.
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word ?!
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: Seid ihr. Und jetzt, Picard, sag mal, was dir verdammt noch mal durch den Kopf ging, als du ohne ein Wort mein Zimmer beschlagnahmt hast?!
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#297.src: Ah, eheh, well- I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: Ah, hehe, nun- das ist mir wohl, äh, entfallen... unwichtig! Wir stehen unter Zeitdruck!
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#298.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however- let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: Wir sind so weit gekommen, aber wir müssen die nächsten Schritte planen. Zunächst jedoch- beginnen wir mit den Informationen, die wir bisher gesammelt haben.
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#299.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of the nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#299.dst: Nun, die Krone hat gewiss Geld im Überfluss! Was wir sahen, kann sich selbst mit dem reichsten Adel messen, mit dem ich in {p} das Vergnügen hatte.
Queen's Recruit#299.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#300.src: And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
Queen's Recruit#300.dst: Und der Baustil... einzigartig. So etwas habe ich noch nie gesehen. Ergibt wohl Sinn, wenn die Provinz so lange abgeschottet war...
Queen's Recruit#300.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#301.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details - any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#301.dst: Eh, genug der unwichtigen Details - kommt noch wem von euch das Turnier komisch vor? Seltsamer Grund, uns zurückzuholen.
Queen's Recruit#301.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#302.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#302.dst: Dasselbe dachte ich auch. Und sie wollen uns alle für die Teilnahme bezahlen, egal wie wir abschneiden... ich verstehe nicht, warum.
Queen's Recruit#302.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#303.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it-
Queen's Recruit#303.dst: Hm, nun, ehrlich gesagt mache ich mir darum keine allzu großen Sorgen-
Queen's Recruit#303.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#304.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#304.dst: Ja, apropos, Picard, was sollte das vorhin im Speisesaal? Ihr zieht doch Aufmerksamkeit auf Euch, wenn Ihr Euch drückt?
Queen's Recruit#304.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#305.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#305.dst: Oh, was nützt es, mich in so ein Kampfszenario zu stecken?! Außerhalb davon bin ich viel nützlicher, frei, mich im Palast umzusehen.
Queen's Recruit#305.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#306.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention-
Queen's Recruit#306.dst: Und außerdem soll ich ihnen eine Zusammenfassung meiner Forschungsnotizen liefern, ganz frei davon bin ich also nicht, ganz zu schweigen von-
Queen's Recruit#306.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#307.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#307.dst: Gut, beruhigt euch mal alle! Begrenzte Zeit, schon vergessen? Wir sind abgeschweift. Die sind reich, schick und wollen uns aus irgendeinem Grund kämpfen sehn. Was noch?
Queen's Recruit#307.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#308.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#308.dst: ...wie ich sagte, bevor man mich so unhöflich unterbrach- aus dem Turnier lässt sich noch nicht viel ableiten. Ein Puzzleteil, das wir später einfügen müssen.
Queen's Recruit#308.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#309.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#309.dst: Haben wir etwas über die Königin und ihre Herrscher? Eine interessante Regierungsform, aber ein direkter Draht zur Königin hat für die Bezirke wohl seinen Wert.
Queen's Recruit#309.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#310.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#310.dst: Na ja, die spielen uns offensichtlich was vor. Die verheimlichen uns definitiv was, und ich glaube nicht, dass sich einer von ihnen so freut, uns zu sehen, wie sie tun.
Queen's Recruit#310.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#311.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent into Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#311.dst: Ja, in der Tat... man schickte uns als Verbannte nach Wynn, nicht als geehrte Soldaten. Warum also tun sie jetzt anders? Sie haben uns zurückgerufen.
Queen's Recruit#311.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#312.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#312.dst: Ah! Vielleicht wissen sie nicht, dass wir den Gedächtniszauber gebrochen haben? Soweit sie wissen, glauben wir noch ihre Lügen.
Queen's Recruit#312.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#313.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#313.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#314.src: So, am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#314.dst: Bin ich der Einzige, den die Zahl der Wachen hier wundert?
Queen's Recruit#314.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#315.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#315.dst: Man sollte meinen, neun Fremde im königlichen Palast würden schärfer beobachtet.
Queen's Recruit#315.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#316.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#316.dst: Jetzt, wo du's sagst... die einzigen Wachen auf dem Weg zu unseren Zimmern standen am Ausgang des Innenhofs. Vor unseren Zimmern ist keine.
Queen's Recruit#316.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#317.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: ...also brauchen wir das ganze Schleichding gar nicht?
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#319.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#319.dst: Scheint mir, als wollten sie, dass wir uns sicher fühlen und vertraut. Die wissen doch, dass wir über alles reden, was wir sehen, also warum keinen guten Eindruck machen, hm?
Queen's Recruit#319.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#320.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#320.dst: Ein starker Zauber sollte problemlos durch dieses Holz kommen.

Queen's Recruit#321.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#321.dst: Außerdem passen diese zwei Herrscher auf uns auf. Ziemlich stark, die, was? Schätze, das ist Grund genug, keinen Ärger zu machen.
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#322.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards, by extension - anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: Apropos Herrscher... und die Wachen gleich mit - kann noch wer gut Mana lesen? Fühlt sich an, als würd hier kaum welches benutzt!
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#323.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: Das wollte ich gerade ansprechen. Ich habe keinen einzigen Magier gesehen. Am nächsten kommen höherrangige Soldaten mit magischen Waffen.
Queen's Recruit#323.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#324.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: Ich kann Mana nicht so gut lesen, aber... mit den Herrschern ist etwas. Sie umgibt eine unglaublich mächtige Aura. Sie fühlt sich... unnatürlich an.
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#325.dst: Ja, du hast recht. Sie und die Königin sind hier die Einzigen mit angeborener Magie, die ich gesehen habe. Wenn überhaupt, scheinen alle drei energetisch eng verbunden...
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#326.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: So interessant das ist, für den Rest von uns gibt es da wenig, woran wir ansetzen können. Doktor, Ihr habt uns hier versammelt. Was ist unser Plan?
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: Ja, das habe ich... nun, unsere vielversprechendste Spur scheinen die Herrscher zu sein. Konzentrieren wir uns auf sie- vernachlässigt aber nicht das Allgemeine. Wir wollen so viel wie möglich über Fruma erfahren.
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#328.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: Das hat lange genug gedauert, machen wir Schluss für heute. Ruht euch alle aus, wir müssen morgen in Bestform sein.
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#329.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#329.dst: Treffen wir uns morgen Abend wieder hier. Gute Nacht, alle zusammen.
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#330.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Queen's Recruit#330.dst: Geh zurück nach W-{~} und schlaf.

Queen's Recruit#331.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: Diese Herrscher... sie bereiten mir Sorge. Wenn Frumas Führung so viel Macht besitzt, dann...
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#332.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: Hm. Vielleicht hat unser König recht, es sich nicht mit ihnen zu verscherzen.
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#333.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#333.dst: Ah, toll, jetzt lungert ihr alle hier rum. Raus aus meinem Zimmer! Ich krieg kein Auge zu, bis ihr weg seid...
Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#334.src: ...damned Doctor- should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#334.dst: ...verdammter Doktor- hätt einfach sein eigenes Zimmer nehmen soll'n!!
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#335.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: ...seufz. Was mache ich hier? Ich hätte in {p} bleiben sollen.
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#336.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: Hoffentlich kennt mich hier niemand von früher. Ich weiß nicht, ob ich das ertrüge.
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#337.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: Hm... schade, dass ich nicht im Turnier kämpfen kann. Eine Geldbelohnung käme mir bei meinen schwindenden Forschungsmitteln gelegen...
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#338.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: Doch ach, ich bin kein Kämpfer. Vielleicht wäre der König bereit, meine künftige Forschung zu finanzieren...
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#339.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: Mann, hoffentlich läuft mein Kampf morgen gut. Ich bin 'n bisschen nervös... hab mich noch nie wirklich duelliert!
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#341.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: Was? Es war ein langer Tag.
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#342.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#342.dst: Diese Magie... warum wirkt sie so vertraut? Ich kann's nicht genau sagen, aber...
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#343.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#344.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: Gute Nacht, {u}. Ich hoffe, du schläfst besser als ich.
Queen's Recruit#344.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#346.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: {u}! Wir verpassen die erste Runde, wenn du noch länger schläfst!
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#347.dst: Ah, du bist wach! Guten Morgen.
Queen's Recruit#347.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#349.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: Tja, ich fühl mit dir. Ich hab kaum ein, zwei Stunden geschlafen. Ich musste ständig... Hätte ahnen sollen, dass es hier schlimmer ist. Ich hoffte nur... na ja, es ist, wie es ist.
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#350.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: Aber egal, gut, dass du wach bist. Gerade kam ein Soldat vorbei und sagte, wir sollen zur Turnierarena gehen.
Queen's Recruit#350.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#351.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: Du... nein, sie haben nur... geklopft und den Zettel unter die Tür geschoben.
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#352.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: War heute Nacht jemand in unserem Zimmer...?
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#353.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: Das... gefällt... mir nicht. Gar nicht.
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#354.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#354.dst: Trotzdem. Wir müssen zur Arena. Sie liegt wohl im Nordteil des Palasts.
Queen's Recruit#354.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#355.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#355.dst: Finde den Austragungsort des Turniers im Norden des Palasts bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#356.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#356.dst: Na, na. Sieht aus, als würden wir endlich rausfinden, wer von uns stärker is', was, Hauptmann?
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#357.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#357.dst: Oh, endlich? Ich wusste nicht, dass das überhaupt fraglich ist! Leutnant, glaubst du wirklich, du hast gegen mich eine Chance?
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#358.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#358.dst: Ach, hör auf, dich aufzuplustern, Kymer! Biste heut auch fein raus, ich weiß noch, wie du als Grünschnabel vor 'nem kleinen alten Zombie gezittert hast!
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#359.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#359.dst: Ha! Ach, schöne Zeiten. Schöne Zeiten. Du kriegst auch noch deine Anerkennung, weißt du. Vielleicht übertriffst du eines Tages sogar meinen Rang!
Queen's Recruit#359.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#360.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#360.dst: Eh, das sagst du jedes Mal. Außerdem passen mir die niederen Ränge gut. Die ganze "Verantwortung", die dir die hohen Tiere aufladen, wär nix für mich.
Queen's Recruit#360.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#361.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#361.dst: ...trotz allem gehst du zu Boden, wenn wir dran sind! Ich hab seit unserm letzten Kampf neue Tricks gelernt, also werd nich' übermütig!
Queen's Recruit#361.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#362.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#362.dst: Ha! Dann freue ich mich darauf.
Queen's Recruit#362.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#363.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#363.dst: Wenn Ihr die Turnierarena sucht, geht diesen Gang entlang und dann nach links.
Queen's Recruit#363.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#364.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: Die Turnierarena liegt weiter den Gang entlang.
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#365.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: Dieser Bereich ist derzeit leider nicht zugänglich.
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#366.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: Dies sind die privaten Gemächer Ihrer Majestät.
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#367.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until-
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: Ich kann Euch leider noch nicht einlassen. Nicht bevor-
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#368.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#368.dst: Ja, ja, meine Forschungsnotizen, ich weiß. Das ist bereits erledigt. Darf ich jetzt in die Bibliothek?
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: Unterbrecht mich nicht. Ihr dürft erst hinein, wenn diese Turnierrunde vorbei ist. Befehl Ihrer Majestät.
Queen's Recruit#369.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#370.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#370.dst: Pah. Schön! Schön, ja, ich warte. Meine Güte.
Queen's Recruit#370.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#371.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't need to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#371.dst: Man sollte meinen, ich hätte ein wenig Freiheit, aber nein! Was nützt es, die Kämpfe nicht ansehen zu müssen, wenn es sonst nichts zu tun gibt?!
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#372.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: Ach, geh und bring deinen Kampf hinter dich. Trödel nicht.
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#374.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: Geht diese Treppe hinunter zur Turnierarena.
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#375.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#375.dst: Die Paarungen werden bekannt gegeben, sobald alle da sind.
Queen's Recruit#375.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#376.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#376.dst: Äh. Herrscher... Majin? Herrscher Majin. Wir sind alle da.
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#377.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#377.dst: Na, wurde ja auch Zeit! Als Gäste der Krone solltet ihr zu so etwas pünktlich erscheinen, hm? Unpünktlichkeit macht keinen guten Eindruck.
Queen's Recruit#377.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#378.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance - a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#378.dst: Verzeiht, Herrscher. Uns wurde wohl keine Zeit genannt, um früher hier zu sein - ein schlichtes Versehen, gewiss.
Queen's Recruit#378.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#379.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: Ach, die Unfähigkeit unserer Untergebenen... sie erstaunt mich immer wieder! Dennoch liegt die Pflicht der Pünktlichkeit bei euch. Macht es nächstes Mal besser, ja?
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#380.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: Nun, ich bin ein vielbeschäftigter Mann, also fasse ich mich kurz. Wie Ihre Majestät bereits erklärte, besteht dieses Turnier aus mehreren Duellen! Ihr müsst nicht jeden Kampf ansehen.
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#381.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: Es gelten die üblichen Regeln. Kein Töten, kein Verstümmeln, keine Angriffe außerhalb der Arena - versucht es ruhig, ich sähe euch zu gern scheitern!
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#382.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is-
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: Damit wäre das geklärt. Noch Fragen? Hoffentlich nicht, auf mich wartet noch viel, sobald das hier-
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#383.src: Ah, I do - I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: Ah, ich - ich nehme nicht am Turnier teil. Man sagte mir, heute gäbe es eine Alternative.
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: Ach ja... du. Was warst du noch gleich, ein... Forscher?
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: Ahahaha! Ach, und dich hat man zu den Besten deiner Provinz gezählt? Dass ich nicht lache! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#385.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#386.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: Ach, aber vermutlich ist es besser so. Neun passt ohnehin schlecht in so ein Turnier. Lieber ein Forscher als ein neunter Kämpfer!
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: Ja, gleich kümmert sich jemand um dich. Setz dich an den Rand und dreh Däumchen, oder was immer du tust- mein Problem bist du jedenfalls nicht mehr.
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#392.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#392.dst: Ausgezeichnet! Die erste Paarung lautet anscheinend... {u} und Mel. Tretet vor, ihr beiden.
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#395.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: Na los, beeilt euch, macht euch bereit! Jeder wählt einen Gang, Nord oder Süd, und dann kämpft endlich!
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#396.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: Was den Rest von euch angeht... ach, keine Lust. Lest eure Paarungen selbst an der Tafel.
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#397.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: Äh... na gut. Dann nehm ich wohl den hier.
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: Beginne deinen Kampf gegen Mel im südlichen Warteraum.

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: Nur weil wir hier 'ne Mission haben, schon ich dich noch lange nicht!
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#401.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: Bereit?! Zeigen wir ihnen, was in uns steckt!
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#402.dst: Puh! Was für ein Kampf! Mein Blut kocht richtig!
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#403.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#403.dst: Wie fandest du meinen Trick? Ziemlich gut, oder? So bin ich im Kampf keine lahme Ente mehr!
Queen's Recruit#403.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#404.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#404.dst: Ach, ich hab eh nicht gedacht, dass ich was gewinne. Aber es hat Spaß gemacht, es zu versuchen.
Queen's Recruit#404.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#405.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#405.dst: {u} hat Mel in der ersten Runde besiegt und zieht in die nächste ein!
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#407.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#407.dst: Ihr dürft für die Dauer des Turniers im Palast bleiben. Am Ende Eures Aufenthalts werdet Ihr für Eure Teilnahme bezahlt.
Queen's Recruit#407.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#408.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: Klingt vernünftig. Ich frag mich, wann Lanu dran ist...
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#409.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: {u}, Glückwunsch zu Eurem Sieg. Ihr werdet benachrichtigt, wann Euer nächster Kampf ist. Bis dahin ruht Euch gern aus.
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: Verlasse den Warteraum der Arena und finde Picard bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#411.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: War ein guter Kampf! Aber jetzt gewinnst du gefälligst mir zu Ehren, hörst du?
Queen's Recruit#411.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#412.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#412.dst: Wir geben Euren nächsten Kampf später bekannt. Ruht Euch bis dahin aus oder genießt den Palast.
Queen's Recruit#412.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: Ah, {u}, ich habe den Kampf gesehen! Sehr gute Technik, besser als bei vielen Soldaten, die ich in {p} erlebt habe.
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#414.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: Überrascht mich wohl nicht! Als das Turnier angekündigt wurde, dachte ich gleich an dich als Sieger. An dich und noch eine Person, wohlgemerkt.
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: Hm... vielleicht könnte ich Wetten auf den Sieger annehmen... ach nein, nein, viel zu beschäftigt. Konzentrier dich, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#416.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: Hm? Ach herrje, ich hatte vergessen, dass du hier bist! Ja, ich wollte doch etwas tun...
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really- who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: Oh! Die Bibliothek! Stell dir vor, diese verflixte Wache ist endlich weg! Lächerlich, wirklich- wer bewacht denn bitte eine Bibliothek?!
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#418.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take this opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#418.dst: Aber. Aber aber aber. Der Weg ist frei, und auch wenn die Turnierrunde noch läuft, will ich die Gelegenheit nutzen, solange ich kann!
Queen's Recruit#418.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#419.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#419.dst: Kommst du mit? Bestimmt findest du da drin etwas Interessantes. Welches Wissen die Leute von Fruma wohl in diesen Mauern verstecken...
Queen's Recruit#419.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#420.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#420.dst: Na, kommst du? Los, schnell, bevor die Wache zurückkommt!
Queen's Recruit#420.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#422.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#422.dst: Meine Güte, wo soll man nur anfangen? Hier gibt es so viel...
Queen's Recruit#422.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#423.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: Ich präsentiere euch den Immerwehenden Zephyr, Herrscher über {p}, jüngster Spross eines der großen Adelshäuser Frumas! Seine Lordschaft, Herrscher Zhiraok Nasin!

Queen's Recruit#424.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#424.dst: ...und dass wir die Verfluchten durchwühlen statt unsere eigenen Bürger, ist ein unkalkulierbares Risiko!

Queen's Recruit#425.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#425.dst: Was war das?! Schnell, schnell, folge mir!
Queen's Recruit#425.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: Siehst du, wer da spricht? Wer ist das?
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#427.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: Ich komme bei dieser Jagd nicht auf ihren Winkel.
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe-
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: Ah, als spräche ich wieder mit ihr! Wie nostalgisch, einem ahnungslosen Nasin zuzuhören, der sich trotz seiner Unfähigk-
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#429.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: WIE BITTE, DU IGNORANTER INTEGRAND? Du hältst jetzt echt den Moment für- Rrgh... Warum. Geb ich mir überhaupt Mühe.
Queen's Recruit#429.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#430.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#430.dst: Ja, warum nur! Eine wirklich üble Angewohnheit. Arbeite daran, während deine Älteren das Wichtige erledigen, hm?
Queen's Recruit#430.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#431.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: Apropos, ich muss sagen, ich finde das alles etwas seltsam. An Stärke mangelt es uns hier gewiss nicht, wozu also die Verbannten?
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#432.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: ...seufz... Der Risikofaktor ist viel größer, als ich wetten würde. Sie muss mehr wissen als wir, vielleicht kriegen wir später eine Summe.
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#434.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#434.dst: Ah, da ist sie ja. Stilvoll verspätet wie immer!
Queen's Recruit#434.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: Hm. Wenn überhaupt, war ich zu früh.

Queen's Recruit#436.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: Dein Timing ist goldrichtig- falls du wegen der erwähnten Summe hier bist und nicht wegen was anderem.
Queen's Recruit#436.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#437.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#437.dst: Wegen Ersterem. Aber zuerst: Habt ihr die Kämpfe verfolgt? Fällt euch einer der Teilnehmer auf?

Queen's Recruit#438.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: Auffallen? Kaum. Bisher hat mich nichts beeindruckt.
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#439.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool-
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: Natürlich nicht. Ich hab einiges Vielversprechende gesehen, aber ich brauche die erwartete Lösung, um die Menge einzugrenzen-
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#440.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: Ah, ah! Ruhig, Nasin, deine Besseren reden. Rechne dich erst mal vom letzten Platz weg.
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: Dann später. Wir haben Probleme. Die Teilnehmer schleichen herum. Und der Doktor macht sich akribisch Notizen.

Queen's Recruit#442.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: ...sieht aus, als wär's eine Fehlkalkulation gewesen, ihn außen vor zu lassen, was?
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#443.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: Ausnahmsweise sind wir uns einig. Wie schade, wie lästig... die Mühe scheint mir das kaum wert.
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#444.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: Das wird es sein. Aber ich war schon zu lange hier. Auf Antworten müsst ihr warten.

Queen's Recruit#445.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: Natürlich. Wie viel irrationaler kann es noch werden?
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#446.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#446.dst: Falls ihr etwas im Auge behalten wollt: Einer der vielversprechenderen Kandidaten kämpft bald. Seht es euch an.

Queen's Recruit#447.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: Wie immer ein Vergnügen. Du hast sie gehört, Nasin! Hopp, hopp, auf die Tribüne!
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#448.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: ...also wissen nicht einmal die Herrscher, was vor sich geht. Faszinierend. Höchst faszinierend.
Queen's Recruit#448.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#449.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: Und da war noch ein Dritter! Wer war das? Noch ein Herrscher...? Verdammt noch mal, wie konnte mir das entgehen?
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#450.src: Well, they appear to be on to us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: Tja, sie sind uns wohl auf der Spur. Egal. Wir müssen vorsichtiger sein.
Queen's Recruit#450.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#451.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: Geh lieber zurück zur Arena. Ich suche hier inzwischen weiter... irgendetwas Nützliches muss es geben!
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#453.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: ...hm? Ach ja, schön, ich erzähle den anderen, was wir gehört haben. Wenn ich hier fertig bin, versteht sich.
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#454.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#454.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#455.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: Die Namen, die in die nächste Runde einziehen... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#455.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#456.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#456.dst: {u}, Euer Kampf beginnt in Kürze. Euer Gegner wartet bereits im Warteraum.
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#457.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#457.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#458.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: Beginne dein nächstes Duell in der Arena die Treppe hinunter.

Queen's Recruit#459.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: Bitte begebt Euch die Treppe hinunter zur Arena.
Queen's Recruit#459.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#460.src: Please go to your waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: Bitte geht in Euren Warteraum und bereitet Euch auf den Kampf vor.
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#462.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: Tja, du bist sicher eine größere Herausforderung als Linton, so viel steht fest.
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#463.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: Du bist weit gekommen seit {p}, was? Ich auch! Kämpfen wir.
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#464.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#464.dst: Der Kampf ist entschieden! {u} geht als Sieger hervor.
Queen's Recruit#464.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#465.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#465.dst: Ah... gut gekämpft, {u}. Ich habe sogar einige meiner stärksten Pfeile benutzt.
Queen's Recruit#465.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#467.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#467.dst: Ich weiß, ich weiß. Du warst ein würdiger Gegner, {u}. Jetzt gewinnst du das Ganze, ja?
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#468.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#468.dst: {u}, Glückwunsch zum Einzug ins Finale. Alle anderen Gegner sind besiegt, bis auf Euch und den zweiten Finalisten.
Queen's Recruit#468.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#470.dst: Hmpf. Das wird in Kürze bekannt gegeben. Bitte begebt Euch in den Hof und wartet auf weitere Anweisungen.
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: Kehre in den Hof bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}] zurück und finde die anderen Teilnehmer.

Queen's Recruit#472.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: Ich hab mich wohl ganz gut geschlagen. Bin trotzdem froh, wenn das alles vorbei ist.
Queen's Recruit#472.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#473.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: Bitte begebt Euch in den Hof und wartet auf weitere Anweisungen.
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#474.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#474.dst: {u}, du bist zurück! Und, wie lief dein Kampf?
Queen's Recruit#474.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#475.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: Du? Ergibt wohl Sinn. Nichts für ungut, Reynauld, aber ich hätte auf {u} gesetzt, wenn ich gekonnt hätte.
Queen's Recruit#475.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#476.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: Ha. Für mich jedenfalls! Ich hatte das Gefühl, deiner Ausdauer kaum etwas anhaben zu können.
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#477.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that- we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#477.dst: Ja, ja, Glückwünsche sind angebracht und so weiter- wir haben Probleme.
Queen's Recruit#477.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#478.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could-
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: Es war schon Problem genug, dass er überhaupt hergerufen wurde... und dann noch, dass er-
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#479.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#479.dst: Genug vom Turnier. Ich will nichts mehr davon hören. Der Doktor hat recht.
Queen's Recruit#479.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#480.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: Ja, nun, es geht nicht um deine Ehre... aber gut, zugegeben, dieser dritte Herrscher ist... beunruhigend.
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#481.src: Hm. Have we been able to find what information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: Hm. Haben wir die Informationen gefunden, die wir brauchten?
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#482.src: No! And that is precisely our problem - we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: Nein! Und genau das ist unser Problem - uns fehlt etwas, und die Zeit läuft uns davon! Ein letzter Kampf, dann ist es vorbei.
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#483.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#483.dst: ...ehrlich gesagt wundert's mich, dass du in dem Kampf zu mir gehalten hast.
Queen's Recruit#483.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#484.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: Ach, na ja, einer musste ihm ja mal 'nen Dämpfer verpassen! Und das warst wohl du.
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#485.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to-
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: Ach, hör doch auf, Leutnant. Er? Ausgerechnet er-
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#486.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: He, alle sind da! Sollen wir... uns hier versammeln?
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#487.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: Sieht so aus. Hast du deinen Kampf gewonnen?
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#488.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#488.dst: Ja. Scheint, ich bin jetzt Finalist. Und wer ist der andere?
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: Oh! Na, Glückwunsch! Aber dann treten wir wohl bald gegeneinander an.
Queen's Recruit#489.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#490.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever- where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what to do next, before-
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: Meine Güte... ja, das Turnier fand statt, Glückwunsch an die Finalisten, was auch immer- wo sind Mel und Linton? Wir müssen besprechen, was als Nächstes kommt, bevor-
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#491.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: ...und was, jetzt darf ich nich' mal ein Nickerchen machen? Ich hab nich' mal gekämpft!! Mel, steh mir bei, komm schon!
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#492.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#492.dst: Er hat recht, das ist kaum fair! Man sagte uns, wir dürften bis zum Ende des Turniers in unseren Zimmern bleiben, warum also die Änderung?!
Queen's Recruit#492.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#494.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: Alle Teilnehmer, die im Turnier verloren haben, werden mit sofortiger Wirkung aus Fruma eskortiert.
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#495.src: - what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#496.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: RUHE! Das sind neue Befehle Ihrer Majestät.
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#497.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
