Queen's Recruit#497.dst: Nur {u} und Tasim dürfen im Palast bleiben. Jeder Widerstand gilt als offizielle Drohung der Provinz Wynn gegen Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#497.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#498.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: Fügt euch, und niemand wird verletzt. Die versprochene Belohnung für eure Teilnahme erhaltet ihr trotzdem.
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#500.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: Genug, Kymer. Geschehen ist geschehen. Wir haben keine Wahl.
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#501.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: Ihr zwei. Passt auf euch auf und seid wachsam. Ich berichte dem König davon. Falls man euch nicht unversehrt freilässt...
Queen's Recruit#501.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#502.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: ...{u}. Tasim. Ich habe, wofür ich ursprünglich herkam, aber... ich weiß nicht, was sie vorhaben. Ihr müsst allein damit fertigwerden.
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#504.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: Verbleibende Finalisten, man erwartet Euch in Kürze im Speisesaal. Nehmt Eure letzte Mahlzeit vor dem Finale ein.
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#505.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#505.dst: Was war das? Was ist gerade passiert?
Queen's Recruit#505.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#506.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: Sie haben die Regeln geändert, und jetzt... ugh, wir haben keine Wahl... Wir müssen es durchziehen.
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#507.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#507.dst: Na ja... komm. Gehen wir zu unserem letzten Abendessen hier.
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#508.dst: Nimm am königlichen Abendessen bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}] teil.

Queen's Recruit#509.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#510.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: Sie lassen uns raus. Das müssen sie. Sonst wär das eine diplomatische Katastrophe.
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#512.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: Falls ihr es noch nicht wisst: Eure Mitstreiter wurden nach Wynn zurückgebracht. Unversehrt.
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#513.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#513.dst: ...wenn Ihr die Frage erlaubt, Majestät, hatten wir keine Abmachung? Wir sollten alle bleiben, bis das Turnier mit dem Finale endet.
Queen's Recruit#513.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#514.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged- we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole-
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: Oh? Und möchtest du dich den anderen anschließen? Das ließe sich einrichten- wir könnten hier und jetzt einen Sieger küren und diese ganze-
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#515.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr-
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: Was ist dein Problem, Thalas?! Sie sind Gäste Ihrer Majestät! Wie irrational bist du, sie ohne ihre Zustimmung abzuzieh-
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#517.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#517.dst: Um deine Frage zu beantworten: Die Umstände haben sich geändert. Der Rest eurer Gruppe muss nicht länger hierbleiben.
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#518.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#518.dst: Der Rest des Turniers verläuft wie vorgesehen.
Queen's Recruit#518.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#520.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: Gut. Nun lasst uns das Mahl genießen!
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#521.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: Noch eine Kostprobe der Küche Frumas... das Fleisch wurde aus {p} eingeführt, das Gemüse stammt aus dem königlichen Garten.
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#522.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported from the {p}, and the vegetables came from our royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#522.dst: Noch eine Kostprobe der Küche Frumas... das Fleisch wurde aus {p} eingeführt, das Gemüse stammt aus unserem königlichen Garten.
Queen's Recruit#522.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#523.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#523.dst: Nun zum Geschäftlichen. Das Finale findet morgen früh statt. Doch zuvor möchte ich mit jedem von euch einzeln sprechen.
Queen's Recruit#523.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#524.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: Beginnen wir mit... {u}. Bitte komm in den Nordostflügel, sobald du bereit bist.
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#526.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: Sprich mit Ihrer Majestät im Nordostflügel des Palasts bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#527.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: Nun. Glückwünsche sind wohl angebracht, Finalist.
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#528.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: Du bist doch sicher neugierig? Zu welchem Zweck würde ich euch Soldaten in unsere Provinz zurückrufen?
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#529.src: Certainly not just for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#529.dst: Gewiss nicht nur für ein eitles Turnier. Eine bedeutungslose Feier.
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#530.src: I'm... not sure what you mea
Queen's Recruit#530.dst: Ich... weiß nicht genau, was du mei

Queen's Recruit#531.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#531.dst: Oh, lassen wir die Fassade fallen. Ich weiß, was ihr heimlich getrieben habt. Ich bin nicht blind.
Queen's Recruit#531.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#532.src: You chose to take this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: Ihr habt die Gelegenheit genutzt, um Informationen über unsere Provinz zu sammeln. Das Wenige, das ihr erfahren habt, halten wir für einen annehmbaren Preis.
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#533.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#533.dst: Unter diesen Umständen hätte ich, wenn nötig, viel, viel mehr geopfert.
Queen's Recruit#533.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#535.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers - a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: Das Beste, was Wynn hat... eine weite Kategorie. Wir mussten die Zahl verringern - ein Kräftemessen hat das gut erledigt.
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#536.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#536.dst: Und nun... bleiben zwei Kandidaten. Gut gemacht, dass du es so weit geschafft hast. Ich habe die Duelle genau verfolgt, und du bist gewiss nicht unbeeindruckend.
Queen's Recruit#536.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#537.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: Doch von euch beiden... hinterlässt du gewiss einen geringeren Eindruck als er. Du bist einer unter Hunderten, Tausenden... nicht zu unterscheiden.
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#538.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#538.dst: Und doch stehst du hier. Das fasziniert mich. Was ist so besonders an dir? Welche Kraft hat dich hergeführt?
Queen's Recruit#538.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#539.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: Doch einerlei. Antworten kommen mit der Zeit... falls du erwählt wirst. Ich sehe, du hast eine Frage. Sprich sie aus.
Queen's Recruit#539.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#540.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#540.dst: Hm. Ein unbeschriebenes Blatt... die Welt draußen sehen zu können, mit all ihrer Pracht und all ihren Fehlern, aus erster Hand die tief verwurzelte Saat ihrer unvermeidlichen Zerstörung zu erleben... das hat seinen Wert.
Queen's Recruit#540.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#541.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#541.dst: Du hast es gesehen, nicht wahr? Mächte jenseits von uns allen ringen um die Herrschaft über unsere Welt, gleich welche Zerstörung sie säen.
Queen's Recruit#541.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#542.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could all be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: Und es ist wahrlich eine schöne Welt, nicht wahr? Wenn man bedenkt, dass all das zerstört werden könnte, geopfert für ihren endlosen Krieg ohne Sinn, ohne Zweck...
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#543.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#543.dst: Dann hast du die Vorteile aus erster Hand gesehen. Die Provinz ist von denen befreit, die Ärger machen könnten, und Wynns Front im Krieg wird gestärkt.
Queen's Recruit#543.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#544.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: Natürlich werden viele den Ruf ablehnen. Noch mehr werden in ihren neuen Rollen verharren. Doch in einigen wenigen... steckt das Potenzial für viel, viel mehr.
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.dst: Ich frage mich... was davon bist du?
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#546.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: Das wäre alles. Kehr für die Nacht in deine Gemächer zurück. Ich lasse gleich den anderen Finalisten rufen.
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#547.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: Kehre in Zimmer W-{~} zurück und sprich mit Tasim bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#549.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#550.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: ...ich hab mir schon etwas Sorgen gemacht. Du warst eine Weile da oben.
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#554.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: Ha. Na, jetzt bin ich ein bisschen nervös.
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#556.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: Ich werde... ein paar Nachfragen stellen müssen.
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#557.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: Oh, das ist eine Katastrophe. Man hat uns getrennt, und jetzt sitzen wir hier fest.
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#558.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could-
Queen's Recruit#558.dst: Wir brauchen einen Plan... gibt es eine Möglichkeit, wie wir-
Queen's Recruit#558.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#559.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#559.dst: Tasim! Ihre Majestät empfängt Euch jetzt.
Queen's Recruit#559.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#561.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#561.dst: Okay, wünsch mir Glück. Ich komme wieder.
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#562.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#562.dst: Bleib... nicht wegen mir wach. Geh dich ruhig ausruhen. Mir geht's... gut, wahrscheinlich.
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#563.dst: Ruhe dich für die Nacht aus.

Queen's Recruit#566.dst: Entschuldige, dass ich dich geweckt habe.
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#567.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#567.dst: Es lief... gut, schätze ich. Sie hat dir wohl... größtenteils dasselbe gesagt.
Queen's Recruit#567.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#569.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#569.dst: Kann ich dich um einen Gefallen bitten?
Queen's Recruit#569.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: Können wir trainieren? Ein Probekampf, bevor... bevor morgen. Wie in alten Zeiten.
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#571.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: Mach dich einfach bereit und komm zur Arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#572.src: I- yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: Ich- ja. Mir geht's gut. Nur... trainieren wir? Ein Probekampf, bevor... morgen. Um der alten Zeiten willen.
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#573.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#573.dst: Mach dich einfach... bereit und komm zur Arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#573.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#574.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: Ich wollte fragen, ob du mir einen Gefallen tust.
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#579.src: He's... what- what happened? How do you know? How- how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#579.dst: Er ist... was- was ist passiert? Woher weißt du das? Wie- wie kannst du das wissen?
Queen's Recruit#579.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#581.src: I-... Gods. And, you- you've been tr-trying to-
Queen's Recruit#581.dst: Ich-... Ihr Götter. Und du- du hast ver-versucht, mir-
Queen's Recruit#581.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#582.src: I- I need to go. I need some space. I'll- I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#582.dst: Ich- ich muss gehen. Ich brauche Abstand. Ich- ich gehe zur Arena. Ich muss... muss...
Queen's Recruit#582.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not- not now. If... if you need me... you'll- you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#583.dst: Nein. Nein, n-nicht. Tu das nicht. Nicht jetzt, nicht- nicht jetzt. Wenn... wenn du mich brauchst... weißt- weißt du, wo ich bin.
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: Geh zur Arena für einen Trainingskampf gegen Tasim.

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: Mach dich bereit und komm zur Arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#586.dst: Es ist... still. Keine Wachen in Sicht.
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#587.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#587.dst: Seufz. Es bringt nichts, hier rauszuwollen. Wir müssen es einfach bis zum Ende durchziehen.
Queen's Recruit#587.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#588.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#588.dst: Was meinst du? Zu dem, was sie gesagt hat? Über... Mächte, die die Welt zerstören.
Queen's Recruit#588.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#589.src: She's right. I've seen it- I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#589.dst: Sie hat recht. Ich hab es gesehen- ich weiß, du auch. Es wird... schlimmer.
Queen's Recruit#589.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#590.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#590.dst: Aber... die Rekruten. Die Rekruten. Darüber komm ich nicht hinweg. Es ist so...
Queen's Recruit#590.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#591.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#591.dst: Gehen wir einfach runter und kämpfen. Die üblichen Plätze, ja?
Queen's Recruit#591.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.src: No words. Let's fight. Just- just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#593.dst: Keine Worte. Kämpfen wir. Nur- nur ein Trainingskampf. Um... unser Können zu messen.
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#594.dst: Ha. Du bist stark geworden, was?
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.dst: Ich kann dich immer noch nicht schlagen, was...
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#596.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#596.dst: Dann wissen wir wohl, wie es morgen ausgeht.
Queen's Recruit#596.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#597.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#597.dst: Nein leugne es nicht. Wir wissen's beide.
Queen's Recruit#597.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#598.src: No- don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#598.dst: Nein- leugne es nicht. Wir wissen's beide.
Queen's Recruit#598.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#599.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#599.dst: Sie hat mir eine Wahl gelassen, weißt du?
Queen's Recruit#599.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#600.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#600.dst: Eine Wahl. Ich weiß nicht, was ich damit soll. Und... ich habe Angst vor beiden Möglichkeiten.
Queen's Recruit#600.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#601.src: I... I need to think it over some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#601.dst: Ich... muss noch mehr darüber nachdenken. Und wir müssen uns beide ausruhen.
Queen's Recruit#601.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#602.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#602.dst: Hm? Ich... ja. Ich glaube schon. Mir geht nur viel durch den Kopf.
Queen's Recruit#602.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#604.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#604.dst: Ich... erzähl's dir morgen früh. Mir geht nur viel durch den Kopf.
Queen's Recruit#604.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#605.src: Ha. You're- you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#605.dst: Ha. Du bist- du bist gut. Uff. Das werd ich noch... eine Weile spüren.
Queen's Recruit#605.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#606.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't- why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#606.dst: Warum musste es so weit kommen? Warum konnten- warum konnten wir nicht alle einfach glücklich sein?
Queen's Recruit#606.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#607.src: He- he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#607.dst: Er- er hat mir wegen dieser Mission einen Brief geschickt. Hab ich dir das erzählt? Darum bin ich nach Wynn zurück.
Queen's Recruit#607.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#608.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#608.dst: Und dann stellt sich raus, dass er schon... schon fort war. Und du warst dabei, und ich nicht.
Queen's Recruit#608.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#609.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#609.dst: Ich will dir die Schuld geben. Wütend sein können, dich hassen. Aber... ich kann nicht. Ich kann es einfach nicht.
Queen's Recruit#609.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#610.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could have done it better. Maybe I could have- or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#610.dst: Ich wünschte, ich wäre dabei gewesen. Ich wünschte, ich hätte es besser gemacht. Vielleicht hätte ich- oder es wäre genauso gekommen.
Queen's Recruit#610.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#612.src: And now we're both here- in the place we were all exiled from! But he's- he isn't. He's gone, and- and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#612.dst: Und jetzt sind wir beide hier- da, wo man uns alle verbannt hat! Aber er- er nicht. Er ist fort, und- und wir sind noch hier.
Queen's Recruit#612.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: ...was soll ich nur tun? Was sollen wir tun? Mit alldem?
Queen's Recruit#613.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#614.dst: Sie hat mir eine Wahl gelassen.
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: Ich hab viele Fragen gestellt. Nicht alle Antworten haben mir gefallen, aber... sie ließ mir eine Wahl.
Queen's Recruit#615.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#616.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#616.dst: Ich weiß nicht, was ich tun soll. Ich muss... muss... nachdenken.
Queen's Recruit#616.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: Lass mir bitte etwas Abstand. Wir sehen uns morgen früh.
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#618.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.
Queen's Recruit#618.dst: Kehre in dein Zimmer zurück und schlafe die Nacht durch.

Queen's Recruit#619.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: Lies die Notiz, die Tasim dir vor seinem Aufbruch hinterlassen hat.

Queen's Recruit#620.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#620.dst: Geh zum Arbeitszimmer Ihrer Majestät, um ihre Entscheidung zu erfahren.

Queen's Recruit#621.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: Du bist schon gescheitert, weißt du. Du hast ihre Auswahlkriterien nicht erfüllt.

Queen's Recruit#622.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#622.dst: Aber ist es ein Fehler, dich einfach auszusortieren? Gewiss, du bist mächtig. Vielleicht sogar mächtiger, als du unter diesen Umständen sein solltest.

Queen's Recruit#623.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: Dennoch. Dir fehlt der Antrieb, die Perspektive. Die Hingabe. Das Verständnis.

Queen's Recruit#624.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#624.dst: Und, am entscheidendsten - du bist unberechenbar. Und das macht dich gefährlich.

Queen's Recruit#625.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#625.dst: Ah! Ihre Majestät und ich sind wohl zum selben Schluss gekommen. Wunderbar.

Queen's Recruit#626.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#626.dst: Wo bleibst du also? Verstoßen, weggeworfen?

Queen's Recruit#627.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#627.dst: All die unbeantworteten Fragen. Wirst du loslassen? Die Möglichkeiten verwerfen?

Queen's Recruit#628.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#628.dst: Und wenn nicht? Was würdest du für einen Blick auf die Wahrheit tun? Für eine Chance auf Antworten?

Queen's Recruit#629.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#629.dst: Hm. Wie auch immer, die Wahl liegt bei dir. Vielleicht überraschst du mich ja doch! Wäre das nicht aufregend?

Queen's Recruit#630.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#630.dst: {u}, auf Befehl Ihrer Majestät werdet Ihr mit sofortiger Wirkung aus Fruma eskortiert.
Queen's Recruit#630.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#631.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#631.dst: Jeder Widerstand gilt als offizielle Drohung der Provinz Wynn gegen Fruma. Fügt Euch, und niemand wird verletzt.
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#632.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#632.dst: Ihr habt hier keine Macht. Diese Wahl liegt nicht bei Euch. Ihr folgt den Befehlen, oder Ihr tragt die Folgen.
Queen's Recruit#632.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#634.src: Ah. Please head to the meeting room. I will join shortly.
Queen's Recruit#634.dst: Ah. Bitte geht in den Besprechungsraum. Ich komme gleich nach.
Queen's Recruit#634.speaker: Ragni's King

Queen's Recruit#637.src: Before you leave. You need to tell him what happened.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: Bevor du gehst. Du musst ihm sagen, was passiert ist.
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: The rest must be waiting up ahead...
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: Die anderen warten bestimmt weiter vorne...
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#641.src: Hm... that's a good question. Maybe not?
Queen's Recruit#641.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: But you'll do fine. You're good at fighting! I've seen you out there.
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: Aber du schaffst das. Du kannst gut kämpfen! Ich hab dich in Aktion gesehen.
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#643.src: Either way, it'll be nice to finally spar against you.
Queen's Recruit#643.dst: So oder so, schön, endlich gegen dich zu trainieren.
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#646.src: It has to be a trick, right?
Queen's Recruit#646.dst: Das muss eine Falle sein, oder?

Queen's Recruit#648.src: Tasim, I really need to te-
Queen's Recruit#648.dst: Tasim, ich muss dir wirklich sa-

Queen's Recruit#649.src: It's... cruel not to tell him, at this point. You have to do it.
Queen's Recruit#649.dst: Es ist... grausam, es ihm jetzt noch zu verschweigen. Du musst es tun.

Queen's Recruit#650.src: I didn't get enough sleep. Might as well nap for a bit longer.
Queen's Recruit#650.dst: Ich hab nicht genug geschlafen. Ich kann mich auch noch etwas hinlegen.

Queen's Recruit#653.dst: Ich hab vorhin die Tür gehört.

Queen's Recruit#659.src: I've seen how you make recru
Queen's Recruit#659.dst: Ich hab gesehen, wie ihr Rekruten macht.
Queen's Recruit#659.full: I've seen how you make recruits.

Queen's Recruit#661.src: She told me why we're here.
Queen's Recruit#661.dst: Sie hat mir gesagt, warum wir hier sind.

Queen's Recruit#662.src: Tasim needs to do this alone.

Queen's Recruit#668.src: You can't, you can't, you can't.
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: Du kannst nicht, du kannst nicht, du kannst nicht.
Queen's Recruit#668.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#669.src: There has to be a better time.
Queen's Recruit#669.dst: Es muss einen besseren Zeitpunkt geben.
Queen's Recruit#669.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#671.src: It'll hurt him. You can't do that to him.
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: Es wird ihm wehtun. Das kannst du ihm nicht antun.
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#673.src: What will he think of you?
Queen's Recruit#673.dst: Was wird er von dir denken?
Queen's Recruit#673.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#675.src: He will. He'll hate you forever.
Queen's Recruit#675.dst: Das wird er. Er wird dich für immer hassen.
Queen's Recruit#675.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#679.src: You can't, you can't, you can't, you can't, you can't.
Queen's Recruit#679.dst: Du kannst nicht, kannst nicht, kannst nicht, kannst nicht...
Queen's Recruit#679.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#684.src: You'll say what you've been trying to say.
Queen's Recruit#684.dst: Du wirst sagen, was du die ganze Zeit sagen wolltest.
Queen's Recruit#684.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#685.src: You'll say what you've been avoiding.
Queen's Recruit#685.dst: Du wirst sagen, was du die ganze Zeit vermieden hast.
Queen's Recruit#685.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#686.dst: Du wirst ihm die Wahrheit sagen.
Queen's Recruit#686.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#690.dst: Du wirst ihm sagen, dass... dass...
Queen's Recruit#690.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#693.dst: Ich... wollte es dir die ganze Zeit sagen.
Queen's Recruit#693.full: I've... been trying to tell you.

Queen's Recruit#694.src: We went on a dangerous missi
Queen's Recruit#694.dst: Wir waren auf einer gefährlichen Mission.
Queen's Recruit#694.full: We went on a dangerous mission.

Queen's Recruit#696.src: At the end, a sacrifice was
Queen's Recruit#696.dst: Am Ende war ein Opfer nötig...
Queen's Recruit#696.full: At the end, a sacrifice was needed...

Queen's Recruit#698.src: He said it had to be him.
Queen's Recruit#698.dst: Er sagte, er müsse es sein.

Queen's Recruit#705.src: Meet up with Tasim in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or travel to the Gate of Fruma by yourself.
Queen's Recruit#705.dst: Triff Tasim in {p} bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder reise allein zum Tor von Fruma.

Queen's Recruit#706.src: Begin your next duel in the waiting room at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#706.dst: Beginne dein nächstes Duell im Warteraum bei [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#708.src: Besides, it'll be nice to finally have a rematch. I haven't forgotten when you beat me in that sparring match, all the way back then!
Queen's Recruit#708.dst: Außerdem wird's schön, endlich eine Revanche zu kriegen. Ich hab nicht vergessen, wie du mich damals im Trainingskampf geschlagen hast!
Queen's Recruit#708.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#709.src: Well, that's one of us, at least! I... keep having dreams. It's worse here, than... sigh. I thought I'd gotten over it...
Queen's Recruit#709.dst: Na, wenigstens einer von uns! Ich... hab ständig Träume. Hier ist es schlimmer als... seufz. Ich dachte, ich wär drüber weg...
Queen's Recruit#709.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#712.src: You should sleep so you're ready for the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#712.dst: Du solltest schlafen, damit du fürs Turnier bereit bist.

Queen's Recruit#715.src: If you're reading this, I'm not back yet. I... couldn't sleep. So I'm heading out for a walk to clear my mind.
Queen's Recruit#715.dst: Falls du das liest, bin ich noch nicht zurück. Ich... konnte nicht schlafen. Ich gehe spazieren, um den Kopf freizukriegen.

Queen's Recruit#716.src: If it's morning, I'll see you at the dining hall. If it's still night, maybe I'll catch you before then.
Queen's Recruit#716.dst: Falls es Morgen ist, sehen wir uns im Speisesaal. Falls es noch Nacht ist, erwische ich dich vielleicht vorher.

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: Ah, bonjour! Willkommen in meinem Restaurant, darf ich dich zu deinem Platz führen-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh, do my eyes decieve me? Serait-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: Oh, trügen mich meine Augen? Serait-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: Du bist es... der Rekrut, der zum Helden der Legenden wurde! Wer hätte das gedacht?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honoré! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: Ich habe Geschichten über deine Heldentaten im ganzen Land gehört, mon ami! Je suis honoré! Jemand wie du in meinem Restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Im ganzen Land berühmt für meine Aromen, wie du für deine Waffe!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peux t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: Ich prahle, ich prahle. Je peux t'offrir un plat... aber vielleicht habe ich einen anderen Vorschlag für uns beide.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: Die Kunst des Kampfes beherrschst du, mein Freund, aber wie steht's mit... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: Folge mir in die Küche hinter mir, dann erzähle ich dir mehr.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#009.dst: Finde Chefkoch Hamsey in seiner Küche.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: Willkommen in meiner Küche! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serait la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: Sie brennt vielleicht, aber... que serait la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: Also, zurück zur Herausforderung. Was hältst du von einem freundlichen Wettstreit, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: Du darfst mit einem meiner drei besten Köche ein Gericht kochen und es mir zeigen, wenn ihr fertig seid!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: Ich bewerte dein Gericht natürlich nach den neunundzwanzig Principes de Cuisine - Textur, Präsentation, Originalität...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.dst: ... Aroma, magische Fähigkeit... oh, und Geschmack!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: S'il te plait! Stell dich jedem meiner Köche vor und komm zurück, wenn du weißt, mit wem du kochen willst!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs inside Hamsey's kitchen
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: Sprich mit allen drei Köchen in Hamseys Küche

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: Hallöchen! Du bist sicher der Abenteurer, von dem Hamsey erzählt hat. Er war fast aus dem Häuschen, aber sag ihm nicht, dass ich das gesagt hab!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: Oh, ein Kochduell? Wie aufregend! Ich helfe dir gern. Vielleicht kann ich mich so vor den anderen ein bisschen mehr beweisen...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: Wenn wir zusammenarbeiten, können wir einen Seasoned Voidroot Stew machen, wie klingt das?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding who to work with though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: Aber du musst erst mit den anderen Köchen reden, bevor du dich entscheidest!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: Ein guter Freund von Hamsey, ja? Das glaube ich, wenn - nein, falls - du diesen Wettbewerb irgendwie gewinnst.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any ameteurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: Ich brauche keine Amateure wie dich, die mir im Weg stehen, wenn ich so richtig loskoche!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: Bist du immer noch hier? Geh einfach... mit jemand anderem plaudern, bitte.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: Yo, Alter. Ich bin Frank. Hamsey meint, ihr kennt euch schon eeewig. Jeder Freund von Hamsey ist mir recht, Mann.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: Weiß noch nich' so genau, was wir kochen, mir fällt schon was ein, wenn's so weit ist.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go too far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: Vielleicht 'nen Kuchen? Nich' zu viel Aufwand, kann nich' viel schiefgehen, oder?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#028.dst: Sprich mit Hamsey und wähle einen Koch, mit dem du kochen willst.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiniers? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: Ah, du hast dich tous mes cuisiniers vorgestellt? Mit wem willst du kochen?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: Ah, Brie! Eine ausgezeichnete Köchin... und ein noch besserer Käse! Nur ein Scherz. Ihr werdet gut zusammenarbeiten, da bin ich sicher.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: Ah, Kale. Einer meiner talentiertesten Köche, wenn auch manchmal etwas stur!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank! Er mag manchmal etwas... entspannt wirken, aber ich versichere dir, er ist ein höchst fähiger Koch!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maintenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maintenant, mon ami, geh zu deinem Koch und fang an zu kochen!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about your dish
Recipe For Disaster#034.dst: Sprich mit dem gewählten Koch über dein Gericht

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: Hallöchen nochmal! Du machst also den Seasoned Voidroot Stew mit mir? Hurra!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: Es ist nicht ganz so einfach, wie es aussieht, aber zusammen schaffen wir das bestimmt.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: Wie gesagt, wegen dem Beweisen... Ich bin die Neueste hier in der Küche, und manche Köche halten nichts von meinen Ideen. Das könnte meine Chance sein!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been working on my recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: Ich arbeite seit Monaten an meinem Voidroot-Stew-Rezept und kann endlich allen zeigen, was ich draufhabe!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first ingredient is some [Snail Slime], available on Snail Island! We'll only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: Die erste Zutat ist etwas [Snail Slime], das gibt's auf Snail Island! Für das Gericht brauchen wir nur eins.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: Als Nächstes brauchen wir [Voidroot], eine superseltene Wurzel tief aus der Leere. Ich hab gehört, jemand in {p} kann dich da runterbringen.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: Zuletzt brauchen wir [Moonsalt], das bekanntlich schwer zu kriegen ist. Zum Glück sollte der selbsternannte 'Weltraumzauberer' Astralaus welches haben, also schau einfach bei seinem Turm vorbei und frag!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: Das sollte reichen! Ich geb dir ein Rezeptbuch, Rechtsklick zum Öffnen, damit behältst du die Zutaten im Blick. Viel Glück!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: Ugh. Bleib mir aus dem Weg, dann kommen wir bestens klar.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: Mach dich nützlich und besorg mir alles, was wir brauchen. Mir ist nicht nach Plaudern.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: Ich will meinen Ruf nicht von jemandem wie dir ruinieren lassen...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: Hör zu, ich sag das *nicht* noch mal. Schreib mit.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: Die Hauptzutat meines fantastischen Omeletts ist natürlich das [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], was du natürlich nicht wusstest.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: Zweitens brauchen wir [Snail Slime], das es natürlich auf Snail Island gibt. Das könnte dir jeder erfahrene Koch sagen.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: Zuletzt brauchst du einen [Talking Mushroom], den du auf der Sumpf-Himmelsinsel findest, falls deine Augen funktionieren.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.dst: SCHON VERGESSEN?? ICH SAGTE DOCH, SCHREIB MIT!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: Zum Glück ist wenigstens einer von uns kompetent. Ich hab alles in dieses Rezeptbuch geschrieben. Rechtsklick zum Öffnen. Jetzt hol meine Zutaten und verschwinde!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: Mega, mit dir zu kochen, Alter! Wir hauen Hamsey vom Hocker.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: Hmmm, was für 'nen Kuchen sollen wir denn backen?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: Tja, ich bin vielleicht 'n bisschen faul, aber beim Kochen hab ich den Blick. Und für mich, Alter? Siehst du voll aus wie so'n Skyhigh-Pie-Typ! Hehe.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: Tja, du weißt sicher, wie man 'nen einfachen Skyhigh Pie macht, oder? Ab mit dir, ich wart hier, bis du die Zutaten hast.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: Hehe, war nur Spaß, Mann! Hättest dein Gesicht sehen sollen.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: Zuerst brauchen wir irgendein Mehl. 'N bisschen [Sunrise Flour] sollte reichen.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: Ein ordentliches [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] gibt dem Ganzen Pfiff. Aber nich' so viel Pfiff wie die Grooks dir geben, wenn sie dich beim Eierklauen erwischen!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: Zuletzt die Geheimzutat - eine [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Echt gutes Zeug, aber ziemlich weit weg. Bisschen Laufen hat noch keinem geschadet, oder? Nich' dass ich's je versucht hätte.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: Huch, schlechtes Gedächtnis? Ja, ich auch, Mann. Hier ist ein Rezeptbuch, Rechtsklick zum Öffnen, da steht, wo du die Zutaten herkriegst!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: Komm wieder, wenn du alles hast. Peace, Alter!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralaus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Willkommen in Astralaus' Astralhaus! Schaffst du es mit umgekehrter Schwerkraft nach oben?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: Astronomischer Fortschritt! Aber das ist erst der Anfang!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.dst: ...Und warum bist du zu meinem Turm gekommen?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: Mein Moonsalt? Wie absurd! Ich hab meins selbst gesammelt, sammel du deins! Nur fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: Verflixte Menschen, ihr hört nie zu! Ich sagte... Hol. Es. Selbst.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick else, strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: Was bringen dich hierher, Fremdling? Was Benamsung du haben? Mensch? Wir beanspruchen Humyn! Schlecht wählen, nimm anders, Fremdling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Looking for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observes, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: Suchen nach Helfen? Wie viele Zupasskommung! Humyns brauchen Hilfelei! Du sehen, Humyns fehlfliegen in große Kraterfels!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: Brennmilch alle und einzige Richtung zum Holen ist Moonsalt! Wir treffen Glücksklumpen und entdecken Moonsalt auf Kraterfels!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: Raffiniertes Moonsalt geben Brennmilch für Raumsaus! Ungelegenheit, Raumsaus kaputt. Humyns bauen winziges Raumsaus!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps, humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: Nur einzelner Humyn passen in jetziges Raumsaus. Wenn Fremdling helfen, Humyns lassen Fremdling in Raumsaus. Humyns können neues Raumsaus bauen mit Zeit!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: Humyns wohnen jetzt auf Kraterfels, also Warten ist nicht Ergebnis Tod!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt entdeckt in Salzhöhle im Norden, Fremdling folgen Pfad!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: Nur [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] brauchen für Brennmilch, Fremdling kann Übriges nehmen!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: Wenn Fremdling hat Moonsalt, raffinieren an Gerät neben Humyn und sausen in Raumsaus!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: Hallo uuund willkommen auf der Rennstrecke des Jahrhunderts!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: Ein Sieger, ein Verlierer. Und Usnail Bolt verspeist Verlierer zum Frühstück.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: Frühstück? Moment, hab ich gefrühstückt? Ein kleines Frühstück wär jetzt nicht schl-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: Na, egal. Was meinst du, Abenteurer? Tritt im Rennen gegen Usnail Bolt an. Der Hauptpreis ist etwas Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: Schade, hätte ein tolles Rennen werden können. Bis dann, Abenteurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: Na, na, na... sieht aus, als hätte Usnail Bolt das hier gewonnen. Mal wieder.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: Nicht dein Glückstag, Mensch. Na ja, du kennst den Preis fürs Verlieren. Wachen!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: Wahnsinn! In einem unglaublichen Rennen hat der Mensch Usnail Bolt die Führung direkt vor der Nase weggeschnappt!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human, take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: Hier, Mensch, nimm diesen Schleim als Preis.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: IST DAS NICHT EINFACH FANTASTISCH. EIN MENSCH?! WER HÄTTE DAS GEDACHT.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: DU BIST HEUTE SCHON DER SIEBTE, DER HIER VORBEIKOMMT, UND KEIN BISSCHEN ANDERS ALS DIE ANDEREN.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: JEDER EINZELNE MIT DIESEM DÄMLICH VERLEGENEN BLICK, ALS WÄRE EIN SPRECHENDER PILZ AUS HEITEREM HIMMEL GEFALLEN.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: LASS MICH IN RUHE, ICH HAB GENUG VON IDIOTEN, DIE MICH AUFHEBEN UND SO RESPEKTLOS BEHANDELN. PRIVATSPHÄRE, SCHON MAL GEHÖRT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: WARUM VERSUCH ICH'S ÜBERHAUPT. SIEH DICH AN! DER INBEGRIFF DER AHNUNGSLOSIGKEIT. UND JETZT, EIN IRRES ABENTEUER ÜBER DIE HIMMELSINSELN MIT MIR?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: HOFFENTLICH NICHT, FALLS DU DAS DACHTEST. ICH HAB HEUTE SCHON EINEN STIEL VERLOREN, WEIL IRGENDEIN TROTTEL MICH ANBEISSEN WOLLTE... LEBEND!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: SAG NICHTS, NIMMST DU MICH MIT AUF EIN IRRES ABENTEUER ÜBER DIE HIMMELSINSELN? WIE REIZEND.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: EINE KÜCHE, SAGST DU, NA, WENN ES MEIN ELEND SO SCHNELL WIE MÖGLICH BEENDET, WARUM NICHT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: MOMENT, WARUM STOPFST DU MICH IN DEINE TASCHE? WIE SOLL ICH HIER DRIN ATMEN?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: Hallo! Sunrise Flour gesucht? Hab ich mir gleich gebacken... äh, gedacht!
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: Sofort? Kein Ding, Freund, ein Keks... äh, Klacks!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: Ach du dickes Brötchen, es scheint, das Zeug ist mir ausgegangen, nichts mehr da.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I seem to be just loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: Tut mir leid, wenn ich hier nur rumkrümele, aber ich weiß wenigstens, wie man mehr macht.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: Siehst du das Weizenfeld da drüben, neben der Bäckerei? Da kannst du Weizen ernten und in die Mühle tun.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: Hol dir beim Werkzeughändler nebenan eine Sense, und dann ran an den Teig!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: Mach so viel du willst, ich hab mein ganzes Brot für heute schon gebacken.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: Tag auch, Kumpel! Suchst du Skyhigh Raspberries? Die machen sich super im Kuchen!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: Falls du Interesse hast, der Zugang zur Insel kostet nur eine kleine Gebühr von {~} Smaragden.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: Man muss ja von irgendwas leben, also hab ich ein Kanonensystem gebaut, das dich direkt auf die Insel bringt, wo sie wachsen!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: Also, was sagst du? Ein kleiner Preis für ein kleines Abenteuer und so viele Himbeeren, wie du essen kannst!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: Na prima! Geh einfach auf die Insel neben mir und spring in die Kanone - absolut sicher, versprochen!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up to the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon to come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: Finde deinen Weg hinauf auf die Insel und pflück so viele Himbeeren, wie du willst! Wenn du fertig bist, spring in die große Kanone, um zurück ans Ufer zu kommen!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: Na gut, kein Problem. Komm gern wieder, falls du mal Lust drauf hast!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
Recipe For Disaster#110.dst: Bringe die Zutaten zu deinem gewählten Koch.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you step back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: Okay, tritt zurück und lass mich kochen, gib mir einfach die Zutaten!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: Aha! Das sollte es sein! Hoffentlich hab ich alles richtig gemacht... aber wow, sieh dir die Farbe der Suppe an!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: Bring sie zu Hamsey und hör, was er dazu sagt!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.dst: Hast du alles? Hat ja lange genug gedauert.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: Fangen wir an. Alle anderen sind längst fertig. Bleib zurück, während ich zaubere.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: Mwah! Mein Meistergericht ist fertig. Bring es dem Chefkoch, er wird es lieben!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: Und trag es VORSICHTIG rüber. Das Essen könnte HUNDERTE wert sein, sobald ich berühmt bin!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: Ich nehm nur ein gaaanz kleines Stück von der Himbeere - Provision vom Koch, was? Und los geht's!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: Und fertig. Hamsey wird das lieben.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: Bitte schön, Alter. War mir 'ne Freude - zeig das Hamsey, mal sehen, was er sagt. Und dass mir unterwegs nix "verloren geht" - du weißt ja, was man über den Eigenbedarf sagt!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
Recipe For Disaster#123.dst: Sprich mit Hamsey über dein fertiges Gericht.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de gouter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah, du hast dein Gericht fertig? Nun denn, il est temps de gouter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: Gehen wir in mein privates Speisezimmer... hier entlang!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've returned with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: Willkommen zurück, mon ami! Du kommst ja mit einem Gericht in der Hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: Ein Eintopf? Wirkt schlicht, aber auch das Schlichteste kann le meilleur sein!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: Abenteurer, hast du das wirklich selbst gekocht? Es ist so gut, ich könnte mein Restaurant gleich schließen!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: Du überraschst mich immer wieder, Freund. Hier, nimm diese Schürze, unverzichtbar für jeden wahren Koch.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: Ich kann nicht übersehen, dass dein Gericht fertig ist!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: Lass mich dein Gericht kosten, und ich präsentiere dir meins! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. Lieber beiße ich in den derrière eines Maultiers! Dieses Ding... nicht mal ein Gert rührt es an!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: Ich sehe, in der Kochkunst hast du dich nicht verbessert. Lass mich in Ruhe und komm wieder, wenn du weißt, was gutes Essen ist!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: Du bist zurück, und nicht mit leeren Händen. Bitte, zeig mir, was du geschaffen hast!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: Ein Kuchen? Da hat dir sicher Frank geholfen. Er hatte schon immer eine Schwäche für Kuchen!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: Ich sehe, deine compétences culinaires sind sehr gut ausgeprägt!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a master chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: Einen wahren Meisterkoch nenne ich dich noch nicht ganz, aber du bist très bien! Nimm diese Belohnung als Glückwunsch!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#141.src: Adventurer! You haven't talked to Brie, Kale, or Frank yet, make sure to talk to them before choosing who to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#141.dst: Abenteurer! Du hast noch nicht mit Brie, Kale oder Frank gesprochen, tu das unbedingt, bevor du wählst, mit wem du kochst.
Recipe For Disaster#141.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#142.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Pleasure to meet'cha.
Recipe For Disaster#142.dst: Yo, Alter. Ich bin Frank. Freut mich.
Recipe For Disaster#142.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#144.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someoneplease.
Recipe For Disaster#144.dst: Bist du immer noch hier? Geh einfach... mit jemand anderem plaudern, Bist du immer noch hier? Geh einfach... mit jemand anderembitte.
Recipe For Disaster#144.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#145.src: You've talked to all three chefs, you should check back with Hamsey.
Recipe For Disaster#145.dst: Du hast mit allen drei Köchen gesprochen, du solltest zu Hamsey zurück.

Recipe For Disaster#146.src: Which chef you would like to cook with?
Recipe For Disaster#146.dst: Mit welchem Koch möchtest du kochen?

Recipe For Disaster#148.src: Not feeling a vibe with me? No worries! I'm sure you'll do great whoever you work with.
Recipe For Disaster#148.dst: Keine Chemie zwischen uns? Kein Problem! Du machst das bestimmt super, egal mit wem.
Recipe For Disaster#148.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#149.src: Thank grook you didn't choose me. Goodness knows I don't need another ameteur weighing me down.
Recipe For Disaster#149.dst: Grook sei Dank, nicht ich. Weiß der Himmel, ich brauch keinen weiteren Amateur, der mich ausbremst.
Recipe For Disaster#149.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#150.src: Collect [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#150.dst: Sammle [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#151.src: Collect [{~} Voidroot] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#151.dst: Sammle [{~} Voidroot] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#152.src: Collect [{~} Moonsalt] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#152.dst: Sammle [{~} Moonsalt] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#153.src: Collect [{~} Snail Slime] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#153.dst: Sammle [{~} Snail Slime] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#154.src: Collect [{~} Talking Mushroom] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#154.dst: Sammle [{~} Sprechender Pilz] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#155.src: Collect [{~} Sunrise Flour] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#155.dst: Sammle [{~} Sonnenaufgangsmehl] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#156.src: Collect [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#156.dst: Sammle [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] oder sieh in dein Rezeptbuch.

Recipe For Disaster#157.src: You shouldn't go entering private rooms uninvited!
Recipe For Disaster#157.dst: Du solltest nicht ungebeten in private Räume gehen!

Recipe For Disaster#158.src: How is the cooking going?! If you have lost your recipe book, just ask your chef for another copy!
Recipe For Disaster#158.dst: Wie läuft das Kochen?! Falls du dein Rezeptbuch verloren hast, frag deinen Koch einfach nach einem neuen!

Recipe For Disaster#159.src: Follow me into the kitchen, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.dst: Folge mir in die Küche, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#160.src: You need [{~} Sunrise Wheat] to refine using the mill!
Recipe For Disaster#160.dst: Du brauchst [{~} Sunrise Wheat], um es in der Mühle zu mahlen!
Recipe For Disaster#160.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#161.src: You've managed to farm up some Sunrise Wheat - you should go refine it at the Bakers mill.
Recipe For Disaster#161.dst: Du hast etwas Sunrise Wheat geerntet - du solltest es in der Mühle des Bäckers mahlen.

Recipe For Disaster#162.src: Looks like you managed to escape with the egg... that was a close one!
Recipe For Disaster#162.dst: Sieht aus, als wärst du mit dem Ei entkommen... das war knapp!

Recipe For Disaster#163.src: Would you like to collect some Skyhigh Raspberries?

Recipe For Disaster#166.src: You're all paid up for a trip to the island already, just jump in the cannon on the island right beside me!
Recipe For Disaster#166.dst: Deine Fahrt zur Insel ist schon bezahlt, spring einfach in die Kanone auf der Insel direkt neben mir!
Recipe For Disaster#166.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#167.src: You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Frank.
Recipe For Disaster#167.dst: Du hast alle Zutaten gesammelt, du solltest zu Frank zurück.

Recipe For Disaster#168.src: You shouldn't jump onto the islands without talking to the Raspberry Vendor!
Recipe For Disaster#168.dst: Du solltest nicht auf die Inseln springen, ohne mit dem Himbeerverkäufer zu reden!

Recipe For Disaster#169.src: You watch Hamsey start to taste your dish... will it be up to his standards?
Recipe For Disaster#169.dst: Du siehst zu, wie Hamsey dein Gericht kostet... wird es seinen Ansprüchen genügen?

Recipe For Disaster#171.src: Welcome back to my restaurant, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#171.dst: Willkommen zurück in meinem Restaurant, Abenteurer!
Recipe For Disaster#171.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#172.src: Good to see you again, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#172.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#173.src: Ah. You're back. Just stay out of my way, I'm trying to do actual cooking.
Recipe For Disaster#173.dst: Ah. Du bist zurück. Bleib mir einfach aus dem Weg, ich versuche, richtig zu kochen.
Recipe For Disaster#173.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#174.src: Hey! Nice to see you again.
Recipe For Disaster#174.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#175.src: Welcome back, mon ami! Alas, running a restaurant is busy work, so I can't talk for long. Maybe take a seat in the restaurant?
Recipe For Disaster#175.dst: Willkommen zurück, mon ami! Leider macht ein Restaurant viel Arbeit, ich kann nicht lange plaudern. Setz dich doch ins Restaurant?
Recipe For Disaster#175.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#176.src: Hey, again! I'd love to chat, but you should talk to the other chefs before making your decision!
Recipe For Disaster#176.dst: Hallöchen nochmal! Ich würd gern plaudern, aber rede erst mit den anderen Köchen, bevor du dich entscheidest!
Recipe For Disaster#176.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#177.src: Please go and talk to the other chefs first before you decide to weigh me down with your "assistance".
Recipe For Disaster#177.dst: Bitte rede zuerst mit den anderen Köchen, bevor du beschließt, mich mit deiner "Hilfe" auszubremsen.
Recipe For Disaster#177.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#178.src: Can't wait to work with you man, tell the big man we're working together and we can get started.
Recipe For Disaster#178.dst: Freu mich schon, mit dir zu kochen, Mann, sag dem großen Boss, dass wir zusammenarbeiten, dann geht's los.
Recipe For Disaster#178.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#179.src: I still can't believe you chose to "work" with me. Make yourself useful and go and tell the Chef. I certainly won't.
Recipe For Disaster#179.dst: Ich fass es immer noch nicht, dass du mit mir "arbeiten" willst. Mach dich nützlich und sag es dem Chefkoch. Ich mach das sicher nicht.
Recipe For Disaster#179.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#180.src: You should go tell Hamsey who you've chosen to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#180.dst: Sag Hamsey, mit wem du kochen willst!
Recipe For Disaster#180.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#181.src: It is time to cook, mon ami! Head over to your chef and ask them what to do.
Recipe For Disaster#181.dst: Zeit zu kochen, mon ami! Geh zu deinem Koch und frag, was zu tun ist.
Recipe For Disaster#181.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#182.src: No sweat, man, I probably wouldn't choose me either. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#182.dst: Kein Stress, Mann, ich würd mich wohl auch nicht wählen. Viel Glück!
Recipe For Disaster#182.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#184.src: Hey! How's the ingredient gathering going? Remember to check your recipe book if you're stuck!
Recipe For Disaster#184.dst: Hey! Wie läuft das Zutatensammeln? Sieh in dein Rezeptbuch, wenn du nicht weiterkommst!
